articles.title: Drake Responds to Karol G Starring as Bruno Mars’ ‘Juliet’ in Romantic ‘Dance With Me’ Video: ‘This Guy Works Fast’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: There’s some sort of public love triangle brewing between Drake, Karol G and Bruno Mars. It appears to be playful and not anything serious, as the trio are fans of one another, but fans are wondering: Could this all be leading up to a seismic blockbuster collaboration?
paras.zh: Drake、Karol G 和 Bruno Mars 之间正在酝酿某种公开的三角恋。这看起来很有趣，并不严肃，因为三人都是彼此的粉丝，但粉丝们想知道：这一切是否会导致一场轰动一时的合作？

paras.en: Earlier this week, Bruno cast Karol G to play his love interest in the romantic “Dance With Me” music video, which saw the 6 God pop up with a response on Instagram.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，布鲁诺选择卡罗尔·G 在浪漫的《与我共舞》音乐视频中扮演他的爱人，该视频在 Instagram 上引起了热烈反响。

paras.en: “Holy this guy works fast,” he quipped Thursday. The comment has amassed more than 34,000 likes, while Bruno’s post itself has north of a million.
paras.zh: “天哪，这家伙工作得真快，”他周四打趣道。该评论已获得超过 34,000 个点赞，而布鲁诺的帖子本身也有超过 100 万个点赞。

paras.en: This all heated up pretty quickly this week. Drake made a guest appearance at Karol G’s Houston show on Sunday, which saw him passionately dancing with the Colombian superstar as he performed his 2016 Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hit “One Dance.”
paras.zh: 本周这一切都迅速升温。周日，Drake 客串 Karol G 的休斯敦演出，与这位哥伦比亚巨星一起热情地跳舞，表演了 2016 年 Billboard Hot 100 排名第一的单曲《One Dance》。

paras.en: They also teamed up for the live debut of their “Ahí” collaboration, which reached No. 44 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the Hot Latin Songs chart in August.
paras.zh: 他们还合作首次现场演唱了《Ahí》，该歌曲在 Billboard Hot 100 中排名第 44，并在 8 月份登上了热门拉丁歌曲排行榜的榜首。

paras.en: Bruno was left a little jealous after seeing what transpired at Reliant Stadium. The Grammy-winning artist posted a photo from his private jet looking out into the clouds, vowing to make a play to one-up Drizzy and win Karol G back.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺在看到信实体育场发生的事情后感到有点嫉妒。这位格莱美奖得主发布了一张从他的私人飞机上眺望云层的照片，并发誓要与 Drizy 上演一场单挑比赛，赢回 Karol G 的心。

paras.en: That happened to be the steamy “Dance With Me” video, which Bruno knew he had up his sleeve and ready to launch on Thursday. He gushed about Karol G in his heartfelt caption, championing her work ethic and called her the “Juliet” to his Romeo.
paras.zh: 这恰好是热辣的“与我共舞”视频，布鲁诺知道他已经做好了准备，准备在周四推出。他在真诚的标题中滔滔不绝地谈论了 Karol G，拥护她的职业道德，并称她为罗密欧中的“朱丽叶”。

paras.en: “Watching you work has been so inspiring. For those that don’t know this beautiful woman works so hard and loves her fans so much. She calls me and tells me how blessed we both are and reminds me to never forget that,” Bruno wrote on IG. “I’m honored to say we made music together, performed together and now starred in a high drama telenovela together. The world needs your light and your voice Carolina. Thank you for being my Juliet in this music video.”
paras.zh: “看着你工作真是太鼓舞人心了。对于那些不知道这位美丽的女人工作如此努力、如此热爱她的粉丝的人来说。她打电话给我，告诉我我们俩是多么幸福，并提醒我永远不要忘记这一点，”布鲁诺在 IG 上写道。 “我很荣幸地说，我们一起创作音乐，一起表演，现在一起主演了一部精彩的电视剧。世界需要你的光芒和你的声音卡罗莱纳。感谢你在这段音乐视频中成为我的朱丽叶。”

paras.en: There could be something in the works, or perhaps this was all a marketing ploy leading up to the “Dance With Me” visual and Drake just played along. A collaboration would be a first from the trio, and boast some of the most potent star power a song has seen, while taking artists from different genres.
paras.zh: 作品中可能有一些东西，或者这可能只是“与我共舞”视觉效果的营销策略，而德雷克只是配合而已。此次合作将是三人组的首次合作，并拥有歌曲中最强大的明星力量，同时吸引了来自不同流派的艺术家。

paras.en: Like Drake, Bruno Mars also appeared on Karol G’s No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto album in August, as the duo tangled on “Still,” which peaked at No. 41 on the Hot 100. Bruno hit the stage at Karol G’s Aug. 15 show in L.A. at SoFi Stadium, where they performed the live debut of “Still” as well as his The Romatic opener “Risk It All.”
paras.zh: 和 Drake 一样，Bruno Mars 也在 8 月份出现在 Karol G 的 No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto 专辑中，两人在单曲《Still》中纠缠不清，该歌曲在 Hot 100 中最高排名第 41 名。Bruno Mars 于 8 月 15 日在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场举行的 Karol G 演出中登上舞台，在那里他们表演了现场首秀《Still》以及他的 The Romatic 开场曲《Risk It All》。

articles.title: Ye’s Two Russian Stadium Concerts Canceled, Promoters Announce: ‘Sincere Regret’
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: After months of back-and-forth, two planned stadium gigs by Ye at Gazprom Arena in St. Petersburg, Russia have reportedly been canceled. Ye (formerly Kanye West) was slated to perform on Oct. 10 and 11 at the venue, though the reportedly sold-out shows were in question from the time they were announced.
paras.zh: 据报道，经过几个月的反复，叶原计划在俄罗斯圣彼得堡俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司体育场举行的两场体育场演出已被取消。叶（原坎耶·韦斯特）原定于 10 月 10 日至 11 日在该场地演出，但据报道，演出门票自宣布之日起就受到质疑。

paras.en: On Aug. 24, the venue posted on social media that the 80,000-capacity stadium “did not sign any contracts for the stadium rent for the event.” The post adamantly stated that there was “no such agreement” for the shows and that they would not take place at the venue. That came despite the venue hyping the shows on Instagram just a week earlier.
paras.zh: 8月24日，场馆在社交媒体上发文称，这座可容纳8万人的体育场“没有签署任何赛事场馆租金合同”。该帖子坚决表示，演出“没有这样的协议”，并且演出不会在该场地举行。尽管场地一周前还在 Instagram 上大肆宣传演出，但还是出现了这种情况。

paras.en: “Kanye West is at Gazprom Arena! Whaaat??? The legendary artist will be coming to Russia for the first time, performing a world-shaking show at the blue-white-and-blue stadium,” read the post earlier post. “This is no joke! Kanye West, the most influential music artist of our time, will perform two exclusive concerts at Gazprom Arena in St. Petersburg on October 10th and 11th as part of his record-breaking world tour.”
paras.zh: “坎耶·韦斯特来到了俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司体育场！哇？？？这位传奇艺术家将首次来到俄罗斯，在蓝白蓝体育场上演震撼世界的表演，”早些时候的帖子中写道。 “这不是开玩笑！坎耶·韦斯特，我们这个时代最有影响力的音乐艺术家，将于 10 月 10 日和 11 日在圣彼得堡的俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司竞技场举办两场独家音乐会，作为他破纪录的世界巡演的一部分。”

paras.en: According to a Reuters report, the Moscow-based promoter Say Agency expressed its “sincere regret” about the cancellation in a message on Telegram, adding, “The Ye concerts in St Petersburg will not be able to take place on the scheduled dates.”
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，总部位于莫斯科的主办方 Say Agency 在 Telegram 上对取消表示“诚挚的遗憾”，并补充道，“叶在圣彼得堡的演唱会将无法如期举行。”

paras.en: At press time, spokespeople for promoter Say Agency and touring agency Access Opera had not returned Billboard‘s request for confirmation on the cancellation of the concerts.
paras.zh: 截至发稿时，主办方 Say Agency 和巡演机构 Access Opera 的发言人尚未回复 Billboard 确认取消演唱会的请求。

paras.en: If the shows had gone on as planned, Ye would have been the first Western rap star to perform in Russia amid a global cultural boycott enacted in response to the launch in 2022 of Russian dictator Vladimir Putin’s war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 如果演出按计划进行，叶将成为第一位在俄罗斯演出的西方说唱明星，当时俄罗斯独裁者弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 2022 年对乌克兰发动战争，引发了全球文化抵制。

paras.en: Newsweek, citing Russian media reports, said that the decision to pull the plug on the Ye shows was made by Russian authorities, with the Kommersant newspaper reportedly saying that the organizers of the gigs were being investigated for fraud. It also said that local media reported that government officials had not approved the shows and that some politicians had expressed outrage at Ye’s past embrace of Nazi symbols and support for Adolf Hitler, which is a criminal offense in the country.
paras.zh: 《新闻周刊》援引俄罗斯媒体的报道称，俄罗斯当局决定取消叶秀的演出，据报道，《生意人报》称演出的组织者正在接受欺诈调查。报道还称，当地媒体报道说，政府官员并未批准这些演出，一些政界人士对叶过去拥抱纳粹标志和支持阿道夫·希特勒表示愤慨，这在该国是一种刑事犯罪。

paras.en: West has not said much this year as he’s mounted his ambitious stadium show across the world, playing gigs in Turkey, the Netherlands, Georgia, Albania, Portugal, Spain and Kazakhstan this year, as well as U.S. shows in Los Angeles, Tampa Bay, San Antonio, New Orleans and Chicago. Despite playing to huge crowds, West is still dealing with the backlash from years of antisemitic remarks and an embrace of Nazi symbolism and rhetoric which began in 2022 and led to the meltdown of the rapper’s once-formidable music, fashion and design portfolio.
paras.zh: 韦斯特今年没有多说什么，因为他在世界各地举办了雄心勃勃的体育场演出，今年在土耳其、荷兰、格鲁吉亚、阿尔巴尼亚、葡萄牙、西班牙和哈萨克斯坦进行演出，并在美国洛杉矶、坦帕湾、圣安东尼奥、新奥尔良和芝加哥进行演出。尽管在众多观众面前演出，韦斯特仍在应对多年来的反犹太言论以及自 2022 年开始接受纳粹象征主义和言论所带来的强烈抵制，这些言论导致了这位说唱歌手曾经令人敬畏的音乐、时尚和设计组合的崩溃。

paras.en: As part of the lingering unease with booking Ye, this year he’s had concerts in France, Poland and the Czech Republic canceled, as well as a headlining set at London’s Wireless Festival; dates in Italy and India were also waved off citing “security concerns.”
paras.zh: 由于对叶的预订感到挥之不去的不安，今年他取消了在法国、波兰和捷克共和国的音乐会，以及在伦敦无线音乐节上的头条新闻；意大利和印度的日期也因“安全问题”而被取消。

articles.title: Zach Bryan Wears ‘Free Palestine’ Shirt at Robert Kraft’s Gillette Stadium
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Grammy winner Zach Bryan took a pointed fashion stance at Gillette Stadium on Friday night (Oct. 2), wearing a black T-shirt reading “Free Palestine” during the first of two dates on his With Heaven On Tour at the Foxborough, Mass., venue.
paras.zh: 周五晚上（10 月 2 日），格莱美奖得主扎克·布莱恩 (Zach Bryan) 在吉列体育场 (Gillette Stadium) 采取了尖锐的时尚立场，在马萨诸塞州福克斯伯勒 (Foxborough) 场地举行的“With Heaven On”巡演的两次约会中的第一次约会中，他穿着一件写着“自由巴勒斯坦”的黑色 T 恤。

paras.en: Members of Bryan’s band were also spotted in matching shirts, according to TMZ, with fan footage of the moment quickly circulating on social media. Bryan did not appear to address the shirt from the stage.
paras.zh: 据 TMZ 报道，布莱恩乐队的成员也被发现穿着相配的衬衫，这一时刻的粉丝视频在社交媒体上迅速流传。布莱恩似乎没有在台上对这件衬衫发表讲话。

paras.en: The choice of wardrobe — and venue — is hard to read as a coincidence. Gillette Stadium is owned by the Kraft Group, led by New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft, who weeks earlier played a central role in removing Macklemore from the remaining U.S. dates of Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour over the rapper’s pro-Palestinian statements onstage.
paras.zh: 服装和场地的选择很难被视为巧合。吉列体育场归卡夫集团所有，该集团由新英格兰爱国者队老板罗伯特·卡夫领导。几周前，由于说唱歌手在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论，他在将麦克勒莫从艾德·希兰循环巡回演唱会的剩余美国日期中除名的过程中发挥了核心作用。

paras.en: During his opening sets at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, N.J., on Sept. 4 and 5, Macklemore declared “Free Palestine” to the crowd and performed his 2024 protest song “Hind’s Hall.” On the second night, he also spoke directly to Jewish fans in attendance, saying his criticism of the Israeli government was not directed at them.
paras.zh: 9 月 4 日至 5 日，在新泽西州东卢瑟福大都会人寿体育场举行的开场演出中，麦克莫尔向观众宣布“自由巴勒斯坦”，并演唱了他的 2024 年抗议歌曲“Hind’s Hall”。第二天晚上，他还直接对出席的犹太球迷发表讲话，称他对以色列政府的批评并不是针对他们的。

paras.en: The Israeli-American Council launched a petition calling for his removal, and on Sept. 14 tour promoter Messina Touring Group confirmed Macklemore would no longer appear on the remaining U.S. dates after multiple NFL stadium owners reportedly threatened to pull shows if he stayed on the bill.
paras.zh: 以色列-美国委员会发起了一份请愿书，要求将他免职。9月14日，巡演发起人Messina Touring Group证实，麦克勒莫将不再出现在剩余的美国演出中，据报道，多个NFL体育场老板威胁说，如果他继续留在名单上，他们将取消演出。

paras.en: Kraft confirmed his involvement in a statement that same day, saying he felt a responsibility to speak up when he believed a line had been crossed on antisemitism, while acknowledging that Palestinian suffering is real.
paras.zh: 克拉夫特当天在一份声明中证实了他的参与，称当他认为反犹太主义已经越过底线时，他感到有责任大声疾呼，同时承认巴勒斯坦人的苦难是真实的。

paras.en: Sheeran said in his own statement the following day that the removal was the promoter’s decision, not his, and that he had spoken directly with Kraft while trying to find a resolution.
paras.zh: 希兰在第二天的声明中表示，撤职是发起人的决定，而不是他的决定，他在试图找到解决方案时已直接与卡夫进行了交谈。

paras.en: The fallout was swift. Fellow openers Finneas, Aaron Rowe and Lukas Graham exited the tour in solidarity, as did Irish folk band Beoga, who had been performing with Sheeran, while Macklemore responded with a lengthy Instagram post detailing the money, brand deals, festivals and private shows he says his advocacy has cost him.
paras.zh: 后果很快。开场嘉宾芬尼斯 (Finneas)、亚伦·罗 (Aaron Rowe) 和卢卡斯·格雷厄姆 (Lukas Graham) 声援退出巡演，与希兰一起演出的爱尔兰民谣乐队 Beoga 也退出了巡演，而麦克勒莫尔则在 Instagram 上发了一篇长文作为回应，详细说明了他的宣传所带来的金钱、品牌交易、节日和私人演出。

paras.en: He later pledged $1 million from his touring earnings to Palestinian aid organizations and announced a Free Palestine Tour — a short European run hitting Dublin, Paris and London from Oct. 26 to 30 — which he has since said sold out immediately.
paras.zh: 后来他承诺从自己的巡演收入中拿出 100 万美元捐给巴勒斯坦援助组织，并宣布举办“自由巴勒斯坦之旅”——10 月 26 日至 30 日前往都柏林、巴黎和伦敦进行欧洲短途巡演——此后他表示巡演门票立即售空。

paras.en: Sheeran never made it to Foxborough in the end: his two Gillette Stadium dates last weekend were scrapped due to severe weather conditions — despite the tour having bowed to the venue owners’ demands.
paras.zh: 希兰最终未能到达福克斯伯勒：他上周末的两次吉列体育场演出由于恶劣的天气条件而被取消——尽管巡演屈服于场地所有者的要求。

paras.en: Bryan has rarely shied away from friction with powerful figures. In October 2025, a teaser of his song “Bad News” — which references ICE raids — drew public criticism from the Department of Homeland Security and the White House, with Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem saying at the time that she was disappointed by the clip. Bryan pushed back at the time, arguing that the song spoke to both sides of the aisle and urging fans not to let social media narratives divide them. The track ultimately appeared on his album With Heaven on Top, released Jan. 9, 2026.
paras.zh: 布莱恩很少回避与有权势人物的摩擦。 2025 年 10 月，他的歌曲《Bad News》的预告片（其中提到了 ICE 的突袭行动）引起了国土安全部和白宫的公开批评，国土安全部部长克里斯蒂·诺姆当时表示，她对这段视频感到失望。布莱恩当时反驳道，他认为这首歌代表了两党观点，并敦促歌迷不要让社交媒体的叙述分裂他们。这首歌最终出现在他于 2026 年 1 月 9 日发行的专辑《With Heaven on Top》中。

paras.en: Bryan is scheduled to return to Gillette Stadium for the second night of his Foxborough stand on Saturday (Oct. 3) — and all eyes will be on whether the shirt makes a repeat appearance, and whether Kraft, who has yet to publicly respond, takes any action. Representatives for Kraft did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 布莱恩计划于周六（10 月 3 日）返回吉列体育场，参加他在福克斯伯勒站的第二个晚上，所有的目光都集中在这件球衣是否会再次出现，以及尚未公开回应的卡夫是否会采取任何行动。卡夫的代表没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: ‘Behemoth!’ Review: Pedro Pascal Hints at Soulful Depths, but the Drama Keeps Stalling in Tony Gilroy’s Wan Character Study of a Virtuoso Cellist
articles.author: David Rooney

paras.en: Tony Gilroy returns to features after 14 years’ absence — the last three of them spent in the Star Wars TV trenches as creator, showrunner and head writer on Andor — with a movie that makes itself hard to love. Hampered by a fussy hopscotching time structure that too often halts the dramatic momentum and by a central character whose passivity fights against the warmth and magnetism of Pedro Pascal in the role, Behemoth! is an odd duck, alternately intriguing and frustrating. What it does have going for it is a series of thrilling sequences observing the workings of an orchestra employed on Hollywood’s scoring stages.
paras.zh: 托尼·吉尔罗伊 (Tony Gilroy) 阔别 14 年之后重返荧幕——他们最后三年都在《星球大战》电视战壕中担任《安多》的创作者、剧集主管和首席编剧——带来了一部让人难以喜爱的电影。繁琐的跳房子时间结构常常阻碍戏剧性的势头，而且中心人物的消极性与佩德罗·帕斯卡在角色“巨兽”中的温暖和魅力相抗衡！是一只奇怪的鸭子，时而令人着迷，时而令人沮丧。它的真正优点是一系列令人兴奋的序列，观察好莱坞配乐舞台上使用的管弦乐队的运作。

paras.en: That rarely glimpsed milieu and a virtuoso cellist protagonist might make Gilroy’s film sound like Maestro meets Tár. But the story’s internal engine seldom revs hard enough to stand up to either of those comparisons, despite its capable ensemble cast and polished craftsmanship.
paras.zh: 这种罕见的环境和一位演奏家大提琴家的主角可能会让吉尔罗伊的电影听起来就像大师遇见塔尔。但尽管故事的演员阵容强大，制作工艺精湛，但故事的内在引擎很少能经得起这两种比较。

paras.en: Cast: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Alexa Swinton, Kaya Ralls, Erik Griffin, JoBeth Williams, Margarita Levieva, Hank Azaria, Will Arnett
paras.zh: 主演: 佩德罗·帕斯卡 / 奥利维亚·王尔德 / 伊娃·维克多 / 亚历克萨·斯文顿 / 卡亚·拉尔斯 / 埃里克·格里芬 / 乔贝斯·威廉姆斯 / 玛格丽塔·莱维耶娃 / 汉克·阿扎利亚 / 威尔·阿奈特

paras.en: One issue is that the script by Gilroy (an Oscar nominee for screenwriting and direction on Michael Clayton) gives insufficient dimension to Pascal’s character, Alex Serian, for someone meant to carry a film. He’s a sideliner in his own life, which may well be the result of living in the shadow of a family of narcissists, but that is not enough to make him interesting. Nor does it help that Alex’s failed relationships seem less a symptom of his own damage than his poor choice of partners.
paras.zh: 一个问题是，吉尔罗伊（因《迈克尔·克莱顿》的编剧和导演而获得奥斯卡提名）的剧本对于帕斯卡饰演的亚历克斯·塞里安的角色来说，没有给他足够的维度来承载一部电影。他在自己的生活中是一个旁观者，这很可能是生活在一个自恋者家庭的阴影下的结果，但这还不足以让他变得有趣。亚历克斯失败的人际关系与其说是他自己受到伤害的症状，不如说是他对伴侣选择不当的结果，这也无济于事。

paras.en: The women characters generally are not drawn kindly, especially Carol Spedding (Olivia Wilde), a wealthy, married arts patron whose ferocious pursuit of Alex when he ends their affair makes her seem like a soul sister to Glenn Close in Fatal Attraction. Maybe Carol’s $6 million gift to the Chicago Symphony during Alex’s tenure there enables her to feel some kind of ownership, though that’s more implied than explored. “I bleed for you and you shun me?” screeches the manic drama queen after he blocks her calls.
paras.zh: 女性角色通常都不会被描绘得友善，尤其是卡罗尔·斯佩丁（奥利维亚·王尔德饰），她是一位富有的已婚艺术赞助人，当亚历克斯结束了他们的婚外情后，她对亚历克斯进行了猛烈的追求，这让她看起来就像《致命诱惑》中格伦·克洛斯的灵魂姐妹。也许卡罗尔在亚历克斯任职期间向芝加哥交响乐团捐赠了 600 万美元的礼物，让她感受到了某种所有权，尽管这更多的是隐含的，而不是探索出来的。 “我为你流血，你却躲避我？”狂躁的戏剧女王在他阻止她的电话后尖叫道。

paras.en: Alex’s flight from scary Carol lands him back in his hometown, Los Angeles, after 20 years of playing in other cities, looking to get back into session work recording orchestral film scores. It’s in those scenes on studio lots — including the Barbra Streisand Scoring Studio at Sony — that the movie is most dynamic.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯逃离可怕的卡罗尔后，回到了家乡洛杉矶，在其他城市演奏了 20 年之后，他希望重新开始录制管弦乐电影配乐。正是在制片厂的那些场景中——包括索尼的芭芭拉·史翠珊配乐工作室——这部电影才最具活力。

paras.en: That’s in large part due to the staggering range of ravishing original film music we see being performed — from dark drama to suspense to action to soaring romance — written by an assembly of nine respected composers billed as “The Behemoth! Collective.” They include Michael Abels, Emily Bear, Lukas Frank, Michael Giacchino, James Newton Howard, Henry Jackman, Nami Melumad, Brandan Roberts and Alan Silvestri. Much of their work also plays over scenes elsewhere in the movie, including an art rock song, a requiem, a cartoon theme tune, a harp concerto and cello etudes.
paras.zh: 这在很大程度上是由于我们看到正在表演的令人惊叹的原创电影音乐——从黑暗戏剧到悬疑，从动作到飙升的浪漫——由九位受人尊敬的作曲家组成的一个被称为“巨兽！集体”的组合创作。他们包括迈克尔·阿贝尔、艾米丽·贝尔、卢卡斯·弗兰克、迈克尔·吉亚基诺、詹姆斯·牛顿·霍华德、亨利·杰克曼、纳米·梅鲁玛德、布兰登·罗伯茨和艾伦·西尔维斯特里。他们的大部分作品也出现在电影的其他场景中，包括一首艺术摇滚歌曲、一首安魂曲、一首卡通主题曲、一首竖琴协奏曲和大提琴练习曲。

paras.en: For anyone who loves movies, being prompted to think about the experiential role that a great score plays is fascinating, but while Behemoth! feints toward being a celebration of film music, it never fully commits. It seems a missed opportunity that we don’t get to watch music being matched to specific beats on the screen, beyond background shots of fuzzy footage on a monitor.
paras.zh: 对于任何热爱电影的人来说，被提示去思考伟大的配乐所扮演的体验角色是令人着迷的，但虽然《巨兽！》假装是对电影音乐的庆祝，但它从未完全承诺。除了显示器上模糊镜头的背景镜头之外，我们无法在屏幕上观看与特定节拍相匹配的音乐，这似乎是一个错失的机会。

paras.en: Alex’s relationship with his parents was defined by their need to outshine their children. We see video of Alex playing Bach at age 6 on Johnny Carson’s show, but the film seems to suggest their nurturing of their sons’ musical gifts was just another way to burnish their own reputations.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯与父母的关系是因为他们需要超越自己的孩子。我们在约翰尼·卡森的节目中看到亚历克斯六岁时演奏巴赫的视频，但这部电影似乎表明他们培养儿子的音乐天赋只是另一种提升自己声誉的方式。

paras.en: His self-absorbed brother Andy (Will Arnett, who’s in a different movie) became something of a black sheep when he turned his back on classical viola to form a briefly successful rock band in the ‘90s. He now hosts a podcast about the TV and movie themes of their late father Peter (Hank Azaria, in a video cameo). Their mother Ginnie (an unrecognizable JoBeth Williams) was a renowned harpist, fading fast with dementia when Alex stays with her upon first returning to L.A. She once said of her husband, “He was a Peter who really wanted to be a Pierre.”
paras.zh: 他自私的弟弟安迪（威尔·阿奈特，在另一部电影中饰演）在上世纪 90 年代放弃古典中提琴组建了一支短暂成功的摇滚乐队后，成了害群之马。他现在主持一个关于已故父亲彼得（汉克·阿扎利亚，视频客串）的电视和电影主题的播客。他们的母亲吉妮（乔贝斯·威廉姆斯饰）是一位著名的竖琴手，当亚历克斯第一次回到洛杉矶和她在一起时，她的痴呆症很快就消失了。她曾经这样评价她的丈夫：“他是一个真正想成为皮埃尔的彼得。”

paras.en: But those glimmers of insight fail to coalesce into a fleshed-out family mythology — though we do learn that Alex and Andy’s grandfather died from a stroke, immedicately after hitting a high C while playing trumpet on the same MGM stage where Alex now works. There’s simply not enough meat on the bones of the parental background or in Alex and Andy’s conversations about them to give much shape to the supposedly chaotic upbringing that formed them.
paras.zh: 但这些洞察力的曙光未能融合成一个充实的家庭神话——尽管我们确实了解到亚历克斯和安迪的祖父在亚历克斯现在工作的米高梅舞台上吹小号时演奏高音C后立即死于中风。父母背景或亚历克斯和安迪关于他们的谈话中根本没有足够的肉来塑造他们所谓的混乱的成长经历。

paras.en: The movie is more engaged in Alex’s reflections on his own life in the two decades since he left, jumping between fizzled relationships and elite orchestra positions in Boston, Dallas and Chicago. The one woman he appears to have loved is brilliant violinist Nadia (Eva Victor), who bailed to marry a billionaire businessman (Matthew Lillard). Victor (Sorry, Baby) is a vivid screen presence, but Nadia isn’t around long enough to leave much of an impression before Alex’s memories jump to her funeral six years later.
paras.zh: 这部电影更多地讲述了亚历克斯对自己离开后二十年生活的反思，在失败的人际关系和波士顿、达拉斯和芝加哥的精英乐团职位之间跳跃。他似乎爱过的唯一一个女人是才华横溢的小提琴家纳迪亚（伊娃·维克多饰），她放弃嫁给了一位亿万富翁商人（马修·里沃德饰）。维克多（对不起，宝贝）是一个生动的银幕形象，但娜迪亚出现的时间不够长，无法给人留下太多印象，六年后亚历克斯的记忆跳到了她的葬礼上。

paras.en: It’s on that solemn occasion that he first sees Nadia’s prodigiously gifted daughter Viviana when she plays an original piano composition of astonishing maturity. That piques Alex’s curiosity about the possibility that he might be the girl’s father; his paternity sleuthing gives the movie a much-needed kick.
paras.zh: 正是在那个庄严的场合，他第一次见到了纳迪亚（Nadia）才华横溢的女儿维维安娜（Viviana），当时她演奏了一首成熟得惊人的原创钢琴曲。这激起了亚历克斯的好奇心，他想知道他可能是女孩的父亲。他的亲子调查给这部电影带来了急需的动力。

paras.en: While Alex’s romantic past is too thinly outlined to be compelling, Pascal’s internalized performance becomes more affecting once the character’s paternal instincts emerge. This happens first with Bronte (Kaya Ralls), a bright young cellist he coaches for an audition with the prestigious San Francisco Symphony. (Professional musician Ralls is a natural in her first acting role.)
paras.zh: 虽然亚历克斯的浪漫过去被勾勒得太薄弱而无法引人注目，但一旦角色的父亲本能显现出来，帕斯卡的内在表演就会变得更具影响力。这首先发生在勃朗特（卡亚·拉尔斯饰演）身上，他是一位聪明的年轻大提琴家，他指导他参加著名的旧金山交响乐团的试镜。 （专业音乐家拉尔斯在她的第一个表演角色中很自然。）

paras.en: But it’s when he starts following Viviana’s success as a composer and musician across multiple genres that the film finally gains some emotional heft. An interlude during which their professional paths cross, when 15-year-old Viviana (Alexa Swinton, terrific) is hired to take over scoring duties on a major movie from a temperamental Euro-diva (Thomas Kretschmann, amusingly playing a male Lydia Tár), is lovely. But it comes too late in a movie that gives us few reasons to care about its opaque central character.
paras.zh: 但当他开始追随维维安娜作为跨多个流派的作曲家和音乐家的成功时，这部电影终于获得了一些情感分量。当 15 岁的维维安娜（亚历克斯·斯文顿饰）受聘从喜怒无常的欧洲女主角（托马斯·克莱舒曼饰，有趣地扮演男性莉迪亚·塔尔饰）接替一部大片的配乐职责时，他们职业道路上的一段插曲非常可爱。但对于一部让我们没有理由关心其不透明的中心人物的电影来说，它来得太晚了。

paras.en: Behemoth! is handsomely shot by Damián García, who previously worked with Gilroy on Andor, but in the end it’s satisfying only as a sensory experience in which music acquires physical form, an aspect greatly enhanced by the advanced sound technology of Dolby Atmos.
paras.zh: 巨兽！由达米安·加西亚 (Damián García) 拍摄，他曾与吉尔罗伊 (Gilroy) 在《安多》(Andor) 中合作过，但最终它只是作为一种感官体验而令人满意，在这种体验中，音乐获得了物理形式，而杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 的先进声音技术大大增强了这一方面。

articles.title: George Cheeks May Level Up in David Ellison’s TV Empire
articles.author: Erik Hayden

paras.en: The last surviving Paramount Global co-CEO is likely to ascend in a new chapter of the company.
paras.zh: 最后一位幸存的派拉蒙全球联席首席执行官很可能会在公司的新篇章中升任。

paras.en: George Cheeks, who currently oversees the CBS Studios portfolio and Paramount’s linear TV channels, is said to be poised to add oversight of Skydance‘s television studios, including Warner Bros. TV studios and Paramount TV studios, when the deal closes next week. In November of last year, Paramount Skydance reworked its linear TV business under Cheeks, chair of TV media at Paramount, adding cable outlets BET, Comedy Central, MTV and Nickelodeon to Cheeks’ portfolio alongside CBS.
paras.zh: 目前负责哥伦比亚广播公司工作室投资组合和派拉蒙线性电视频道的乔治·奇克斯(George Cheeks)据说将在下周交易完成时增加对Skydance电视工作室的监管，其中包括华纳兄弟电视工作室和派拉蒙电视工作室。去年 11 月，派拉蒙 Skydance 在派拉蒙电视媒体主席 Cheeks 的领导下重组了其线性电视业务，将 BET、Comedy Central、MTV 和 Nickelodeon 等有线电视频道与 CBS 一起纳入 Cheeks 的投资组合中。

paras.en: In the previous Shari Redstone regime, Cheeks was part of a trio titled “the office of the CEO” along with Brian Robbins and Chris McCarthy on an interim basis after CEO Bob Bakish was ousted amid a sale process that ultimately went in the direction of David Ellison’s Skydance Media.
paras.zh: 在之前的沙里·雷石东政权中，奇克斯与布莱恩·罗宾斯和克里斯·麦卡锡一起临时成为“首席执行官办公室”三人组的一员，此前首席执行官鲍勃·巴基什在一次出售过程中被赶下台，最终向大卫·埃里森的 Skydance Media 方向发展。

paras.en: Cheeks’ goal will now be stability, reorganization and to milk those titles for cash, with wide cuts expected across the company as it seeks to harvest the revenue from carriage fees and redistribute to other priorities, like streaming, and paying down debt.
paras.zh: 奇克斯现在的目标将是稳定、重组并从这些头衔中榨取现金，预计整个公司将大幅削减收入，因为该公司寻求从运输费中获得收入，并将其重新分配给其他优先事项，例如流媒体和偿还债务。

paras.en: The combined company, notably, also will have to abide by a consent decree negotiated with the 12 states that sued Ellison’s team. That includes having the Paramount and Warners cable channels (Comedy Central-MTV-BET-Nick and HGTV-Food Network-TNT-CNN-Discovery, respectively) negotiate affiliate agreements separately.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，合并后的公司还必须遵守与起诉埃里森团队的 12 个州谈判达成的同意令。这包括让派拉蒙和华纳有线频道（分别是喜剧中心-MTV-BET-尼克和HGTV-食品网络-TNT-CNN-Discovery）单独谈判附属协议。

paras.en: On Friday, after Ellison shared on X that once Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery combine they will take on the name Skydance, it was also reported Warner Bros. film chiefs Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy were exiting.
paras.zh: 周五，埃里森在 X 上透露，一旦派拉蒙和华纳兄弟探索合并，他们将更名为 Skydance，据报道，华纳兄弟电影首席执行官迈克尔·德·卢卡 (Michael De Luca) 和帕梅拉·阿布迪 (Pamela Abdy) 将退出。

paras.en: Deadline first reported Cheeks’ elevation.
paras.zh: Deadline 首先报道了奇克斯的身高。

articles.title: “Good Heavens”: Kathleen Turner Reacts to Michael Douglas’ Bombshell About Their Secret Romance During ‘Romancing the Stone’
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Michael Douglas revealed in a new excerpt from his memoir One Helluva Ride that he and Kathleen Turner had a secret romantic relationship while filming 1984’s Romancing the Stone, and the actress is responding to his revelation.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·道格拉斯 (Michael Douglas) 在他的回忆录《One Helluva Ride》的新摘录中透露，他和凯瑟琳·特纳 (Kathleen Turner) 在拍摄 1984 年的《浪漫石头》时曾有过一段秘密的浪漫关系，而这位女演员正在对他的爆料做出回应。

paras.en: The Fatal Attraction actor shared an exclusive excerpt from his new memoir with People Thursday, writing that he and his then-wife, Diandra Douglas, were separated and “were both having extramarital affairs.” He wrote that “Kathleen and I fell hard for each other and began a relationship,” and vowed to keep their romance private.
paras.zh: 这位《致命吸引力》演员与《人物》杂志周四分享了他新回忆录的独家摘录，其中写道，他和当时的妻子黛安德拉·道格拉斯已经分居，并且“都有婚外情”。他写道，“凯瑟琳和我深深地爱上了彼此，并开始了恋爱关系”，并发誓要将他们的恋情保密。

paras.en: “The chemistry I had with Kathleen Turner was so strong, audiences have been certain for years that we were in a relationship together while making the film. We both denied it through Romancing The Stone, Jewel of the Nile, War of the Roses, and even while doing press a few years ago for The Kominsky Method,” he said, noting four projects they’ve worked on together.
paras.zh: “我和凯瑟琳·特纳之间的化学反应非常强烈，观众多年来一直确信我们在制作这部电影时就在一起了。我们都通过《浪漫石头》、《尼罗河上的宝石》、《玫瑰战争》，甚至在几年前为《科明斯基方法》做新闻报道时都否认了这一点，”他说，并指出了他们一起合作的四个项目。

paras.en: “The official story went as follows: Yes, we confessed, we had amazing chemistry. Yes, we were both, as Kathleen said, ‘terrible flirts,’ and yes, we were both tempted, but nothing ever happened between us,” Douglas wrote, per the excerpt. “That was a lie.”
paras.zh: “官方的故事是这样的：是的，我们承认，我们有着惊人的化学反应。是的，正如凯瑟琳所说，我们都是‘可怕的调情’，是的，我们都受到了诱惑，但我们之间什么也没发生，”道格拉斯在摘录中写道。 “那是一个谎言。”

paras.en: Turner responded to Douglas’ admission on Friday. “Good heavens what a fuss about something 40 years ago!” the actress wrote in a statement shared with People. “I love Michael and I look forward to enjoying the book.”
paras.zh: 特纳周五对道格拉斯的承认做出了回应。 “天哪，40年前的事情真是大惊小怪啊！”这位女演员在与《人物》杂志分享的一份声明中写道。 “我爱迈克尔，我期待着享受这本书。”

paras.en: Elsewhere in his excerpt, the two-time Oscar winner said they lied about their romance for 40 years “to protect my wife and son.” He said they kept things so under wraps that director Bob Zemeckis and their co-star Danny DeVito “were unaware.”
paras.zh: 这位两届奥斯卡奖得主在摘录的其他地方表示，他们在恋爱问题上撒谎了 40 年，“是为了保护我的妻子和儿子”。他说，他们对事情保密，以至于导演鲍勃·泽米吉斯和联合主演丹尼·德维托“都不知道”。

paras.en: “The truth is that during the production of Romancing the Stone, Kathleen and I fell hard for each other and began a relationship,” Douglas wrote. “It wasn’t a fly-by night affair; it grew naturally from how closely we were working together, how much pressure we were under, how much we respected and cared for one another, and how attracted we were to each other. Like every other guy in the world at the time, I was knocked sideways by Kathleen….”
paras.zh: “事实是，在制作《浪漫石头》期间，凯瑟琳和我深深地爱上了彼此，并开始了恋爱关系，”道格拉斯写道。 “这不是一场不经意间的事情；它是自然而然地发生的，因为我们在一起工作的密切程度，我们承受的压力有多大，我们有多么尊重和关心彼此，以及我们彼此之间有多么吸引。像当时世界上所有其他人一样，我被凯瑟琳击倒了……”

paras.en: Douglas wrote that during a set visit, Diandra “grew suspicious,” and spoke with Turner and “made it clear to her that we were still married.”
paras.zh: 道格拉斯写道，在一次探访期间，黛安德拉“变得可疑”，并与特纳交谈并“向她明确表示我们仍然是婚姻关系”。

paras.en: “Her view of the terms of our separation was different from mine. This gave Kathleen pause. She didn’t want to interfere,” he wrote. “After that visit, Kathleen and I ended things, and I went back to Diandra.”
paras.zh: “她对我们分居条款的看法与我不同。这让凯瑟琳犹豫了。她不想干涉，”他写道。 “那次拜访之后，凯瑟琳和我结束了一切，然后我回到了黛安德拉。”

articles.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell

paras.en: The Department of Justice will not reopen its criminal investigation into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell over the central bank's overbudget multibillion-dollar headquarters renovation a department spokesperson told CNBC.
paras.zh: 司法部发言人告诉 CNBC，司法部不会重新启动对美联储前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔 (Jerome Powell) 的刑事调查，该调查涉及美联储预算超支的数十亿美元总部改造工程。

paras.en: "We're not reopening a criminal investigation into him," Attorney General Todd Blanche told Bloomberg in an interview Friday.
paras.zh: “我们不会重新对他展开刑事调查，”司法部长托德·布兰奇周五在接受彭博社采访时表示。

paras.en: Blanche did not rule out separate Justice Department action related to the renovation in his interview. He told the outlet the independent audit of the renovation could prompt an investigation if it uncovers evidence of criminal wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 布兰奇在采访中并未排除司法部就翻修工程采取单独行动的可能性。他告诉媒体，如果发现犯罪行为的证据，对翻修工程的独立审计可能会引发调查。

paras.en: His comments come days after the Federal Reserve's inspector general found no reasonable grounds to believe that a federal crime had occurred requiring a referral to the attorney general, even as the watchdog faulted the central bank for major management and oversight failures that contributed to the project's soaring costs.
paras.zh: 几天前，美联储监察长发现没有合理的理由相信发生了联邦犯罪，需要将其移交给司法部长，尽管监管机构指责央行存在重大管理和监督失误，导致该项目成本飙升。

paras.en: President Donald Trump slammed the decision, said in a Truth Social post Wednesday after the news, saying that Powell should be "forced to resign" from the central bank's Board of Governors "at a minimum."
paras.zh: 周三消息传出后，唐纳德·特朗普总统在《真相社会》的一篇文章中猛烈抨击了这一决定，称鲍威尔“至少应该”“被迫”辞去央行理事会职务。

paras.en: "He can't manage a Building, and he certainly shouldn't be allowed to manage his High Interest Rate Policy (only on 'TRUMP!')," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他无法管理一座大楼，当然也不应该允许他管理他的高利率政策（仅限于‘特朗普！’）。”

paras.en: The Justice Department opened its investigation into the renovation in January. Prosecutors issued grand jury subpoenas seeking related records but a federal judge quashed those subpoenas in March, finding they had been issued for an improper purpose and that the government had produced essentially no evidence that Powell committed a crime. The DOJ disputed the ruling but later closed its investigation rather than appeal.
paras.zh: 司法部于一月份开始对翻修工程进行调查。检察官向大陪审团发出传票，寻求相关记录，但一名联邦法官在三月份撤销了这些传票，认为这些传票是出于不当目的而发出的，而且政府基本上没有提供鲍威尔犯罪的证据。美国司法部对裁决提出异议，但后来结束了调查而不是上诉。

paras.en: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, who succeeded Powell in May, said the central bank would bring in an independent auditor and strengthen oversight of the project. Powell remains on the Fed's Board of Governors, where his separate term runs through Jan. 31, 2028.
paras.zh: 五月份接替鲍威尔的美联储主席凯文·沃什表示，央行将聘请独立审计员并加强对该项目的监督。鲍威尔仍担任美联储理事会成员，其任期将持续至 2028 年 1 月 31 日。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly pushed Powell to leave the board altogether after years of clashes over interest-rate policy.
paras.zh: 在多年的利率政策冲突后，特朗普多次敦促鲍威尔完全离开董事会。

paras.en: CNBC's Ryan Ruggiero contributed to this report.
paras.zh: CNBC 的 Ryan Ruggiero 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration

paras.en: Cerebras stock plummeted nearly 20% this week to its lowest price since the company's monster IPO in May, after a report that chip giant Nvidia will power a crucial piece of OpenAI's latest model.
paras.zh: 在有报道称芯片巨头英伟达将为 OpenAI 最新型号的关键部件提供动力后，Cerebras 股价本周暴跌近 20%，跌至该公司 5 月份大规模 IPO 以来的最低价格。

paras.en: Research firm SemiAnalysis posted on X on Wednesday that OpenAI will power its "Ultrafast" mode for GPT-6.1 Sol with Nvidia graphics processing units instead of Cerebras hardware. Cerebras shares are now down by more than half since their initial pop that followed the company's debut on the Nasdaq.
paras.zh: 研究公司 SemiAnalysis 周三在 X 上发布消息称，OpenAI 将使用 Nvidia 图形处理单元而不是 Cerebras 硬件为其 GPT-6.1 Sol 的“超快”模式提供支持。自公司在纳斯达克首次亮相以来，Cerebras 股价现已下跌一半以上。

paras.en: The stock, which closed on Friday at $166.43, was also under pressure this week due to the expiration of post-IPO restrictions on some insider shares.
paras.zh: 该股周五收于 166.43 美元，由于一些内部人士股票的 IPO 后限制到期，本周也面临压力。

paras.en: However, it rose almost 3% in extended trading on Friday after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman responded to the "speculation about our partnership with Cerebras."
paras.zh: 然而，在 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 回应“有关我们与 Cerebras 合作的猜测”后，周五盘后交易中该股上涨了近 3%。

paras.en: "Cerebras is a close partner, and we have a deep engagement pushing on the frontiers of speed," Altman wrote in a post on X.
paras.zh: Altman 在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“Cerebras 是一个亲密的合作伙伴，我们在推动速度前沿方面有着深入的合作。”

paras.en: Still, it's been a brutal stretch for Cerebras, which closed at a $95 billion market cap on the first day of trading, just shy of joining the ranks of Meta, Alibaba and now SpaceX, which closed their initial day with valuations over $100 billion.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这对 Cerebras 来说仍然是一个残酷的考验，该公司在交易首日收盘时的市值为 950 亿美元，仅差一点就加入了 Meta、阿里巴巴和现在的 SpaceX 的行列，后者首日收盘时估值超过 1000 亿美元。

paras.en: Cerebras' market cap now sits at just over $39 billion.
paras.zh: Cerebras 的市值目前略高于 390 亿美元。

paras.en: Investors were excited by the prospect of an alternative to Nvidia to power AI. Cerebras makes dinner plate-sized ASICs, or a custom microchip built for inference workloads, and leases them from inside its own data centers as a cloud service. In January, Cerebras struck a deal worth over $10 billion with OpenAI to supply it with 750 megawatts of computing power through 2028.
paras.zh: 投资者对英伟达替代品驱动人工智能的前景感到兴奋。 Cerebras 制造餐盘大小的 ASIC，即为推理工作负载构建的定制微芯片，并从自己的数据中心内部将它们作为云服务出租。今年 1 月，Cerebras 与 OpenAI 达成了一项价值超过 100 亿美元的协议，到 2028 年为其提供 750 兆瓦的计算能力。

paras.en: Losing OpenAI inference to Nvidia has put a damper on that exuberance. According to McKinsey, inference is set to surpass training as the most dominant workload in AI data centers by the end of the decade.
paras.zh: OpenAI 推理功能输给了 Nvidia，这让这种繁荣受到了抑制。麦肯锡表示，到本世纪末，推理将超越训练，成为人工智能数据中心最主要的工作负载。

paras.en: Meanwhile, as more time passes from the IPO, additional shares will hit the market. According to the company's prospectus, up to 19.4 million shares held by directors, officers, non-executive employees, and non-employee holders unlocked on Wednesday. That's equal to 8% of total shares outstanding.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着IPO时间的推移，更多的股票将会上市。根据该公司的招股说明书，周三解锁了董事、管理人员、非执行员工和非员工持有者持有的多达 1940 万股股票。这相当于已发行股票总数的 8%。

paras.en: Prior to that, up to 14.6 million shares have been unlocked for sale every two weeks since Aug. 19.
paras.zh: 此前，自8月19日以来，每两周解锁出售的股票数量高达1460万股。

paras.en: CEO Andrew Feldman and CTO Sean Lie, both minted billionaires by the IPO process, sold over $240 million of Class A shares between Aug. 20 and Sept. 25 under trading plans adopted shortly after the IPO. Other executives have also sold shares valued in the millions.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Andrew Feldman 和首席技术官 Sean Lie 均通过 IPO 成为亿万富翁，根据 IPO 后不久通过的交易计划，他们在 8 月 20 日至 9 月 25 日期间出售了价值超过 2.4 亿美元的 A 类股票。其他高管也出售了价值数百万美元的股票。
