paras.zh: 观看：CNBC 对 Cerebras Systems 首席执行官安德鲁·费尔德曼 (Andrew Feldman) 的完整采访

articles.title: America’s data center fight is a preview of what's to come for the rest of the world

paras.en: As the AI boom becomes a major part of political debate, the public backlash against data centers in the U.S. is spreading to Europe and Asia — raising risks for investors.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能热潮成为政治辩论的主要部分，公众对美国数据中心的强烈反对正在蔓延到欧洲和亚洲，这增加了投资者的风险。

paras.en: Across the Atlantic, negative sentiment is growing in Europe, which has more at stake due to its densely populated countries and higher electricity prices, experts told CNBC.
paras.zh: 专家告诉 CNBC，在大西洋彼岸，欧洲的负面情绪正在加剧，由于人口稠密和电价上涨，欧洲面临的风险更大。

paras.en: Similar tensions are emerging in South Korea, with growing opposition to data centers near residential areas and proposals for tighter local restrictions, even as the national government pushes to accelerate development.
paras.zh: 韩国也出现了类似的紧张局势，尽管韩国政府正在推动加速发展，但人们越来越反对住宅区附近的数据中心，并提议采取更严格的地方限制。

paras.en: Public opposition has already impacted around $42 billion of data center investments in Europe, in account delays and cancellations, according to research from STL Partners. That compares to around $77 billion in the U.S.
paras.zh: 根据 STL Partners 的研究，公众的反对已经影响了欧洲约 420 亿美元的数据中心投资，导致账户延迟和取消。相比之下，美国的这一数字约为 770 亿美元。

paras.en: The pushback could be the "straw that breaks the camel's back," Olivier Darmouni, associate professor at HEC Paris who specializes in the energy transition, told CNBC.
paras.zh: 巴黎高等商学院专门研究能源转型的副教授奥利维尔·达穆尼 (Olivier Darmouni) 告诉 CNBC，这种阻力可能是“压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草”。

paras.en: More than 70 data center projects in Europe were rejected or restricted between January and April — more than in all of 2025, according to the European Data Center Monitor. It found that pushback had snowballed from local town halls to courts, regulators and parliaments.
paras.zh: 据欧洲数据中心监测机构称，1 月至 4 月期间，欧洲有 70 多个数据中心项目被拒绝或限制，这一数字比 2025 年全年的还要多。调查发现，抵制情绪已从当地市政厅滚雪球般蔓延到法院、监管机构和议会。

paras.en: Scotland has paused planning approvals for new hyperscale data centers after campaigners called on the government to avoid the "cautionary tale" of Ireland, where overwhelming power demand led to a moratorium.
paras.zh: 在活动人士呼吁政府避免重蹈爱尔兰的“警世故事”之后，苏格兰暂停了对新超大规模数据中心的规划审批，爱尔兰压倒性的电力需求导致了暂停。

paras.en: Constraints have been rising in the Nordics, where investors were drawn to large tracts of land and renewable energy. After a surge in power applications, Denmark passed an emergency law that could see data centers at the back of the queue for grid power applications.
paras.zh: 北欧地区的限制不断增加，那里的投资者被大片土地和可再生能源所吸引。在电力应用激增之后，丹麦通过了一项紧急法，该法可能使数据中心排在电网电力应用队列的最后。

paras.en: Spain also proposed new data center rules this summer, requiring data centers to source 80% of their electricity from renewables. Projects in the U.K. have stalled after pushback from locals.
paras.zh: 西班牙今年夏天还提出了新的数据中心规则，要求数据中心80%的电力来自可再生能源。在当地人的反对下，英国的项目陷入停滞。

paras.en: Much of the concern centers around water usage, power consumption, electricity prices, and the sheer amount of space that some centers require. There is also little agreement on how many permanent jobs the sector creates, and no precedent for projecting a center's economic value per megawatt.
paras.zh: 大部分问题都集中在用水量、电力消耗、电价以及一些中心所需的巨大空间上。对于该行业创造多少永久性就业机会也没有达成一致，也没有预测一个中心每兆瓦经济价值的先例。

paras.en: "The gains of AI are very diffused," Darmouni told CNBC.
paras.zh: 达穆尼对 CNBC 表示：“人工智能的收益非常分散。”

paras.en: "There's definitely been more understanding of the scale of the potential AI build-out and its geographical spread, and perhaps ... more information about how much bigger these are, and that they're a little bit more like giant ghost warehouses that consume a lot of resources and can hurt local communities in some ways."
paras.zh: “人们肯定对潜在人工智能建设的规模及其地理分布有了更多的了解，也许……更多关于这些规模有多大的信息，以及它们更像是消耗大量资源并可能在某些方面伤害当地社区的巨型幽灵仓库。”

paras.en: Europe's denser population, and the fact that many data center operators are U.S. companies, might mean that the backlash hits harder, the professor added.
paras.zh: 这位教授补充说，欧洲人口密集，而且许多数据中心运营商都是美国公司，这可能意味着这种抵制会更加严重。

paras.en: South Korea, home to tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, sits at the heart of the AI supply chain. In June, its government named AI data centers as one of three major investment projects, alongside semiconductors and physical AI.
paras.zh: 韩国是科技巨头三星电子和 SK 海力士的所在地，位于人工智能供应链的核心。今年六月，中国政府将人工智能数据中心列为三大投资项目之一，与半导体和物理人工智能并列。

paras.en: But its push to build the infrastructure needed is running into resistance at the local level.
paras.zh: 但其建设所需基础设施的努力在地方层面遇到阻力。

paras.en: In the Geumcheon district of southwestern Seoul, residents have called for authorities to revoke the building permit and halt construction of a data center near their homes, according to the local government.
paras.zh: 据当地政府称，在首尔西南部的金川区，居民呼吁当局吊销建筑许可证，并停止在他们家附近建设数据中心。

paras.en: In July, officials announced plans to require consent from a majority of residents living within 200 meters of proposed data center sites and to introduce a three-stage system for reviewing projects and mediating disputes.
paras.zh: 7月，官员们宣布计划要求居住在拟议数据中心地点200米范围内的大多数居民同意，并引入一个三阶段系统来审查项目和调解纠纷。

paras.en: Residents have also gathered outside the local government office on weekday mornings for months to protest against the project. The demonstrations had continued for 172 days as of mid-August, according to local media.
paras.zh: 几个月来，居民们还在工作日早上聚集在当地政府办公室外抗议该项目。据当地媒体报道，截至8月中旬，示威活动已持续172天。

paras.en: In Gwacheon, a city just south of Seoul, a local council member proposed an ordinance aimed at protecting nearby residents from risks associated with data centers operating around the clock, including potential fires involving backup batteries.
paras.zh: 在首尔以南的果川市，当地议会成员提出了一项法令，旨在保护附近居民免受与全天候运行的数据中心相关的风险，包括涉及备用电池的潜在火灾。

paras.en: Despite the pusback, the AI boom shows little sign of slowing down.
paras.zh: 尽管受到阻碍，人工智能的繁荣几乎没有放缓的迹象。

paras.en: But a community's ability "to derail a $10 billion [data center] plan is quite powerful," said Asya Walters, managing director at Alvarez & Marsal.
paras.zh: 但 Alvarez & Marsal 董事总经理 Asya Walters 表示，社区“破坏 100 亿美元（数据中心）计划的能力非常强大”。

paras.en: She told CNBC the business-friendly environment in the U.S. has historically made it easier to overcome pushback.
paras.zh: 她告诉 CNBC，美国的商业友好环境历来更容易克服阻力。

paras.en: But in Europe and Asia, there's some "hot and coldness" at the country level about where demand is going, Walters said. The "push and pull" between favorable conditions for data centers and more restrictive regulation can be challenging for investment.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯说，但在欧洲和亚洲，国家层面的需求走向存在一些“冷热”。数据中心的有利条件和更严格的监管之间的“推拉”可能会给投资带来挑战。

paras.en: Public backlash can also end up raising costs for operators, because even if they pull out of a project before construction starts, money will likely have already been spent.
paras.zh: 公众的强烈反对最终也会增加运营商的成本，因为即使他们在施工开始前退出项目，资金也可能已经被花掉了。

paras.en: Though most capex expenditure happens after the permits are in place, operators spend a lot to reach that point, "so there is some loss that could happen there if they never get the permits," Walters said.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯说，尽管大多数资本支出发生在获得许可证之后，但运营商花费了大量资金才能达到这一点，“因此，如果他们从未获得许可证，可能会发生一些损失。”

paras.en: "Digital infrastructure is becoming more visible and it's understandable that communities want to understand what's being built near them, why it's needed and how local impacts are being managed," said Eulalia Flo, vice president of growth and emerging markets, EMEA at Equinix, one of the biggest data center operators in Europe.
paras.zh: 欧洲最大的数据中心运营商之一 Equinix 欧洲、中东和非洲地区增长和新兴市场副总裁 Eulalia Flo 表示：“数字基础设施正变得越来越明显，社区希望了解附近正在建设什么、为什么需要这些基础设施以及如何管理当地影响，这是可以理解的。”

paras.en: "We don't see this as a structural constraint on growth, but the policy environment is genuinely tightening in some markets," said Flo.
paras.zh: 弗洛表示：“我们并不认为这是对增长的结构性限制，但一些市场的政策环境确实正在收紧。”

paras.en: But the AI buildout has meant "a misunderstanding of the industry in a very broad sense," according to Dominic Ward, CEO of data center operator Verne.
paras.zh: 但数据中心运营商 Verne 首席执行官多米尼克·沃德 (Dominic Ward) 表示，人工智能的发展意味着“在非常广泛的意义上对该行业的误解”。

paras.en: "We used to be a completely unknown part of the economy," Ward told CNBC. "We were just a black box. We were just a building that had stuff that went in that nobody understood. Now we are one of the fundamental layers driving the economy."
paras.zh: “我们曾经是经济中完全不为人所知的一部分，”沃德告诉 CNBC。 “我们只是一个黑匣子。我们只是一座建筑物，里面的东西没人理解。现在我们是推动经济的基本层之一。”

paras.en: He added: "Now everybody knows where they are, so there's kind of no hiding behind this."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“现在每个人都知道自己在哪里，所以这背后没有什么隐藏的了。”

articles.title: Mathematicians name 50 of the highest-stakes problems in math

paras.en: Mathematicians love to collect elegant, profound questions that defy proof: the longer the holdout, the better. And one day in June, groups from around the world gathered to do just that. The goal was a new list of 50 high-stakes questions with an important caveat: there had to be a way to automatically check solutions to the problems. Workshops took place in six cities: London, Toronto, Los Angeles, New York City, Berkeley, Calif., and Cambridge, Mass.
paras.zh: 数学家喜欢收集难以证明的优雅、深刻的问题：坚持的时间越长越好。六月的一天，来自世界各地的团体聚集在一起就是为了实现这一目标。目标是列出 50 个高风险问题的新列表，并附带一个重要警告：必须有一种方法来自动检查问题的解决方案。研讨会在六个城市举行：伦敦、多伦多、洛杉矶、纽约市、加利福尼亚州伯克利和马萨诸塞州剑桥。

paras.en: That morning Yang-Hui He, a mathematician at the London Institute for Mathematical Sciences, was accompanied by a very young guest. His son was on school break, so He brought him along to the workshop. The two entered a room full of mathematicians who were well supplied with lunch, snacks, and coffee and got to work. Under the watchful eye of his cake-munching son, He collaborated with others to submit three problems that touched on fields from knot theory to algebra, topology and number theory. “There’s a big culture in mathematics, which is solving open conjectures,” He says. “Many people get Fields Medals because they solve open conjectures. This is very big.”
paras.zh: 那天早上，伦敦数学科学研究所的数学家何阳辉带着一位非常年轻的客人。他的儿子正在放假，所以他带他一起去车间。两人走进一个满是数学家的房间，他们准备好了午餐、零食和咖啡，然后开始工作。在吃蛋糕的儿子的注视下，他与其他人合作提交了三个问题，涉及从结论到代数、拓扑和数论的领域。 “数学中有一种很大的文化，那就是解决开放的猜想，”他说。 “许多人获得菲尔兹奖是因为他们解决了开放猜想。这是非常重大的。”

paras.en: The event was held at the request of Epoch AI, an organization that benchmarks the progress of artificial intelligence systems. Epoch AI senior researcher Greg Burnham says the problems cover a broad spectrum of topics. Lately AI models from various companies have been cutting through a large swath of math’s biggest challenges. Earlier this month, for instance, OpenAI claimed a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, one of the towering Millennium Prize Problems.
paras.zh: 该活动是应 Epoch AI 的要求举办的，Epoch AI 是一个对人工智能系统进展进行基准测试的组织。 Epoch AI 高级研究员 Greg Burnham 表示，这些问题涵盖了广泛的主题。最近，来自不同公司的人工智能模型已经解决了大量数学难题。例如，本月早些时候，OpenAI 声称找到了纳维-斯托克斯问题的解决方案，这是最高的千年奖问题之一。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: As of late September, a few of the problems from the new list have been solved, including some landmark ones. The official list still remains peppered with unsolved problems, although OpenAI recently announced that its unreleased internal AI model has solved more than 100 open questions. “My guess is that it likely contains at least a few [of these],” Burnham says.
paras.zh: 截至9月底，新清单中的一些问题已经得到解决，其中包括一些具有里程碑意义的问题。尽管 OpenAI 最近宣布其未发布的内部 AI 模型已经解决了 100 多个悬而未决的问题，但官方列表中仍然充满了未解决的问题。 “我的猜测是，它可能至少包含其中的一些，”伯纳姆说。

paras.en: Here are a few of the critical problems the mathematicians identified.
paras.zh: 以下是数学家发现的一些关键问题。

paras.en: Status: Open Mathematicians would like to find integer solutions to polynomial equations that contain three different cubes. “It’s strongly suspected that there are integer solutions to the equation x3 + y3 + z3 = 114,” Burnham says. “But it’s suspected that the smallest solutions have something like 30 digits in them.”
paras.zh: 状态：开放数学家希望找到包含三个不同立方体的多项式方程的整数解。 “强烈怀疑方程 x3 + y3 + z3 = 114 存在整数解，”伯纳姆说。 “但人们怀疑最小的解也有大约 30 位数字。”

paras.en: In 2020, Andrew Booker of the University of Bristol and Andrew Sutherland of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology settled the case for when the sum of x3 + y3 + z3 totals 42. Their efforts consumed 1.3 million computing hours, distributed across volunteer home computers. The next total is 114. Burnham estimated that the same strategy for 114 would cost perhaps $100 million or more, making such a blunt approach unrealistic. Checking the solution simply requires evaluating the equation with the new values.
paras.zh: 2020 年，布里斯托大学的安德鲁·布克 (Andrew Booker) 和麻省理工学院的安德鲁·萨瑟兰 (Andrew Sutherland) 在 x3 + y3 + z3 的总和为 42 时解决了这个问题。他们的努力消耗了 130 万个计算小时，分布在志愿者的家用计算机上。下一个总数是 114。Burnham 估计，对 114 采取同样的策略可能会花费 1 亿美元或更多，因此这种生硬的方法不切实际。检查解只需用新值评估方程即可。

paras.en: Status: Rumors swirl that this has been solved
paras.zh: 状态：有传言称该问题已得到解决

paras.en: Irrational numbers are decimals that can’t be rewritten as a fraction of two integers. Pi and √2 are familiar examples. Although the idea is simple, proving that a number is irrational is notoriously difficult—it took two millennia to prove that pi was irrational.
paras.zh: 无理数是不能重写为两个整数的分数的小数。 Pi 和 √2 是熟悉的例子。虽然这个想法很简单，但证明一个数是无理数却是出了名的困难——证明 pi 是无理数花了两千年的时间。

paras.en: In 1978 the eccentric French mathematician Roger Apéry proved that a number known as zeta(3) was irrational. The zeta numbers originate from Riemann’s famed zeta function, which describes intriguing statistical patterns in the arrangement of the prime numbers. Apéry’s discovery has shaped modern number theory.
paras.zh: 1978 年，古怪的法国数学家 Roger Apéry 证明了一个名为 zeta(3) 的数字是无理数。 Zeta 数源自黎曼著名的 Zeta 函数，该函数描述了素数排列中有趣的统计模式。阿佩里的发现塑造了现代数论。

paras.en: Evaluating the zeta function at 3 gives the sum of the series 1⁄n3: 13 + 1⁄23 + 1⁄33 + 1⁄43+ .... The idea that this series should sum to an irrational number might be come as a surprise, but centuries ago Euler proved that all the even values of the zeta function are tied to powers of pi, making them irrational. This led mathematicians to suspect that the odd values were also likely irrational.
paras.zh: 计算 3 处的 zeta 函数得出级数 1⁄n3 的总和：13 + 1⁄23 + 1⁄33 + 1⁄43+ ...。这个级数之和应为无理数的想法可能会让人感到惊讶，但几个世纪前，欧拉证明了 zeta 函数的所有偶数值都与 pi 的幂相关，使它们成为无理数。这导致数学家怀疑奇数值也可能是无理数。

paras.en: To find the proof for zeta(3), Apéry sandwiched the function between two infinite series that converged at just the right speed to ensure zeta(3) must be irrational. Mathematicians were baffled: How did he find the two series? Frustratingly, Apéry replied that he found them in a flower pot. The mystery of how he located them remains outstanding today. If anyone can reconstruct Apéry’s reasoning, the odd values of zeta may finally be proven irrational.
paras.zh: 为了找到 zeta(3) 的证明，Apéry 将函数夹在两个以适当速度收敛的无穷级数之间，以确保 zeta(3) 一定是无理数。数学家们很困惑：他是如何找到这两个级数的？令人沮丧的是，阿佩里回答说他在花盆里发现了它们。他如何找到它们的谜团至今仍然悬而未决。如果有人能够重建阿佩里的推理，那么 zeta 的奇数值可能最终被证明是不合理的。

paras.en: “A credible solution to Apéry-style irrationality—for one of the relevant numbers, the one called zeta(5) —has been circulating,” Burnham says.
paras.zh: “针对阿佩里式非理性的一种可靠解决方案——针对相关数字之一，即 zeta(5)——一直在流传，”伯纳姆说。

paras.en: Like the previous two problems, the “lonely runner conjecture” seems simple but has deep ties to many fields. On a circular track, place a group of runners, all of whom run at unique, constant speeds. The lonely runner conjecture predicts that, at some point, a runner will be maximally distant from all the other runners—the saddest, loneliest phase of the race. Mathematicians want to rescue this runner with a counterexample: some number and combination of speeds that will break the pattern. The problem has stood since 1967.
paras.zh: 与前两个问题一样，“孤独跑者猜想”看似简单，却与许多领域有着深厚的联系。在圆形跑道上放置一组跑步者，所有人都以独特的恒定速度跑步。孤独跑步者猜想预测，在某个时刻，跑步者将与所有其他跑步者保持最大距离——这是比赛中最悲伤、最孤独的阶段。数学家想用一个反例来拯救这位跑步者：一些可以打破这种模式的数字和速度组合。这个问题自 1967 年以来一直存在。

paras.en: Take a tangled loop of string. Can you tell whether it’s truly knotted or just a circle in disguise?
paras.zh: 拿一圈缠结的绳子。你能看出它是真的打结还是只是一个伪装的圆圈吗？

paras.en: In 1984 the late mathematician Vaughan Jones introduced a new way to assign polynomials to knots, thereby tangling the two fields together. He later won a Fields Medal for the discovery. If two knots have different Jones polynomials, they’re different knots. But the reverse doesn’t hold—different knots might be linked to the same polynomial. In fact, mathematicians already know that knots of two or more links have ambiguous polynomials. But what about the simplest knot, a circle? In knot theory, a circle is known as an “unknot” and has the trivial Jones polynomial 1. Mathematicians strongly suspect that there is a genuinely knotty loop that also has a Jones polynomial 1. It would only take a single example to show that the Jones polynomials can’t reliably detect whether a knot is there at all.
paras.zh: 1984 年，已故数学家沃恩·琼斯 (Vaughan Jones) 引入了一种将多项式分配给结的新方法，从而将两个领域纠缠在一起。后来他因这一发现获得了菲尔兹奖。如果两个结具有不同的琼斯多项式，则它们是不同的结。但反之则不然——不同的结可能与同一个多项式相关联。事实上，数学家已经知道两个或多个链接的结具有不明确的多项式。但是最简单的结，一个圆圈呢？在结理论中，圆被称为“无结”，并且具有平凡的琼斯多项式 1。数学家强烈怀疑存在一个真正的多结环，也具有琼斯多项式 1。只需一个例子即可表明琼斯多项式根本无法可靠地检测是否存在结。

paras.en: The Core in Approval-Based Committee Elections
paras.zh: 批准型委员会选举的核心

paras.en: Status: Recently solved by humans and AI
paras.zh: 状态：最近由人类和人工智能解决

paras.en: Imagine a town of 1,000 people elects a 10-member council. Each citizen can vote for as many candidates as they like. What would make the election fair? One natural answer is proportional representation of the town’s people. For instance, a group of 300 people should wind up with three seats’ worth of influence.
paras.zh: 想象一下，一个有 1,000 人的城镇选举出一个由 10 名成员组成的议会。每个公民可以投票给任意数量的候选人。什么才能使选举公平？一个自然的答案是城镇居民的比例代表制。例如，一个 300 人的团体最终应该具有相当于三个席位的影响力。

paras.en: How do you tell whether a particular voter is well represented? Count how many of the candidates they voted for that end up winning seats.
paras.zh: 您如何判断特定选民是否得到了充分的代表？计算他们投票支持的候选人中有多少最终赢得了席位。

paras.en: Now suppose the group of 300 proposes its own three-person slate. Take a resident who voted for only one of the 10 winners but for two of the slate’s three candidates. The council gives her only one representative. But the slate would give her two. If every member of the group likewise ends up with more of their picks on the slate than on the council, the group has a legitimate reason to complain. With just the three seats the group is owed, it could serve every one of its members better than the entire council.
paras.zh: 现在假设 300 人提出了自己的三人名单。以一位居民为例，他只投票给了 10 名获胜者中的一位，但投票给了名单上三名候选人中的两名。委员会只给了她一名代表。但石板会给她两个。如果该团体的每个成员最终在名单上的选择都多于在理事会上的选择，那么该团体就有合理的理由抱怨。该团体仅拥有三个席位，就可以比整个理事会更好地为每一位成员提供服务。

paras.en: A council that no group can object to is said to be in the “core,” a term borrowed from game theory. In a 2016 preprint paper, a team of computer scientists asked whether every election has at least one council in the core.
paras.zh: 没有任何团体可以反对的理事会被称为“核心”，这是一个借用博弈论的术语。在 2016 年的一篇预印本论文中，一组计算机科学家询问是否每次选举都至少有一个核心理事会。

paras.en: For nearly a decade, progress was slow. Certifying a council as fair means comparing it against every possible group of voters and every slate of candidates that group can claim. As election sizes grow, the number of such combinations explodes. Researchers managed only smaller cases, for instance, 15 candidates in 2025.
paras.zh: 近十年来，进展缓慢。认证一个理事会的公平性意味着将其与每个可能的选民群体以及该群体可以主张的每一个候选人名单进行比较。随着选举规模的扩大，此类组合的数量呈爆炸式增长。研究人员只处理较小的案例，例如 2025 年有 15 名候选人。

paras.en: On September 10 three researchers based in Germany, France and England posted a preprint on arXiv.org that settled the question: every election has a fair council, and there’s an efficient method for finding one. The method doesn’t need to check every group because the proof guarantees that the council it produces is fair. The researchers employed AI as an assistant, alongside their own mathematical intuition, and verified their result using the proof assistant Lean.
paras.zh: 9 月 10 日，来自德国、法国和英国的三名研究人员在 arXiv.org 上发布了一份预印本，解决了这个问题：每次选举都有一个公平的理事会，并且有一种有效的方法来找到一个公平的理事会。该方法不需要检查每个组，因为证据保证了它产生的理事会是公平的。研究人员利用人工智能作为助手，结合他们自己的数学直觉，并使用证明助手 Lean 验证了他们的结果。

articles.title: 2026 has been a record hot year for the U.S.—it can only get worse

paras.en: It’s been a blistering year for the U.S. The first eight months of 2026 were the hottest such period ever recorded in the contiguous U.S. since at least 1895. That puts 2026 on track to being among the hottest years the country has ever seen—if not the hottest.
paras.zh: 对于美国来说，今年是酷热的一年。2026 年前八个月是美国本土自 1895 年以来有记录以来最热的时期。这使得 2026 年有望成为该国有史以来最热的年份之一（即使不是最热的）。

paras.en: Whether or not this year takes the top slot in that bleak ranking is still unclear. But the outlook isn’t good, climate scientists say.
paras.zh: 今年是否能在这个惨淡的排名中名列前茅仍不清楚。但气候科学家表示，前景并不乐观。

paras.en: Right now where 2026 will clock in is a matter of probability. The hottest year the contiguous U.S. has ever recorded was in 2024, at 55.48 degrees Fahrenheit (about 13 degrees Celsius) on average, explains Zeke Hausfather, a climatologist and a lead author of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Seventh Assessment Report.
paras.zh: 目前，2026 年具体时间是概率问题。美国本土有记录以来最热的一年是 2024 年，平均气温为 55.48 华氏度（约 13 摄氏度），气候学家、政府间气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 第七次评估报告的主要作者 Zeke Hausfather 解释道。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: We’re likely set to break that record, he says: January–August 2026 clocked in at 57.98 degrees F (14.43 degrees C) on average, 0.08 degrees F (about 0.04 degrees C) above the previous record of 57.90 degrees F (14.39 degrees C) for that period, which was set in 2012, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
paras.zh: 他说，我们很可能会打破这一记录：2026 年 1 月至 8 月的平均气温为 57.98 华氏度（14.43 摄氏度），比根据国家海洋和大气管理局的数据于 2012 年创下的同期记录 57.90 华氏度（14.39 摄氏度）高出 0.08 华氏度（约 0.04 摄氏度）。

paras.en: If the U.S.’s temperature averages above around 50.5 degrees F (about 10.3 degrees C) this September through December, the country will break the record for its hottest year, Hausfather says. “That is a warm autumn but not an unusual one anymore,” he says.
paras.zh: 豪斯法瑟说，如果今年 9 月到 12 月美国的平均气温高于 50.5 华氏度（约 10.3 摄氏度），该国将打破其最热年份的记录。 “这是一个温暖的秋天，但不再是一个不寻常的秋天，”他说。

paras.en: In the last 10 years, the final four months of the year have averaged about 2.6 degrees F (about 1.4 degrees C) above the historical 20th-century average, Hausfather says. By his calculations, this fall only needs to hit 2.2 degrees F (about 1.2 degrees C) above average to be our hottest year. Data suggest September was anomalously warm.
paras.zh: 豪斯法瑟说，在过去 10 年里，一年中最后四个月的平均气温比 20 世纪的历史平均水平高出约 2.6 华氏度（约 1.4 摄氏度）。根据他的计算，今年秋天只需比平均气温高 2.2 华氏度（约 1.2 摄氏度）即可成为我们最热的一年。数据显示九月异常温暖。

paras.en: “In other words, 2026 only needs a fairly typical recent-era finish to set the record,” Hausfather says, putting the odds at about 80 percent.
paras.zh: “换句话说，2026 年只需要一个相当典型的近代结局就能创造纪录，”豪斯法瑟说，他认为这一可能性约为 80%。

paras.en: “It would take a cooler-than-normal autumn to keep it from happening," he says.
paras.zh: “需要比正常情况凉爽的秋天才能阻止这种情况发生，”他说。

paras.en: Other scientists are more cautious. When asked for comment by Scientific American, a NOAA spokesperson shared an early look at September’s temperatures and pointed to data showing that the agency expects above-normal temperatures across much of the continental U.S. from October through December. But neither source absolutely predicts whether 2026 will be a record-warm year, the spokesperson said, citing NOAA physical scientist Russell Vose.
paras.zh: 其他科学家则更为谨慎。当《科学美国人》寻求评论时，NOAA 发言人分享了对 9 月份气温的初步观察，并指出数据显示该机构预计 10 月至 12 月美国大陆大部分地区的气温将高于正常水平。但发言人援引 NOAA 物理科学家拉塞尔·沃斯 (Russell Vose) 的话说，这两个消息来源都没有绝对预测 2026 年是否将是创纪录的温暖年份。

paras.en: Climate Central scientist Zachary Labe notes that forecasting the weather is complex and variable, which makes such predictions tricky. At this point in 2024, for instance, the year ranked as the second warmest, not the warmest, Labe says. Things could change.
paras.zh: 气候中心科学家扎卡里·拉贝（Zachary Labe）指出，预测天气是复杂且多变的，这使得此类预测变得棘手。拉贝说，例如，2024 年的这个时候，这一年被列为第二温暖的一年，而不是最温暖的一年。事情可能会改变。

paras.en: What scientists do agree on, however, is that 2026 has been extremely—and concerningly—hot. “Average temperatures across the country continue to reach new record levels, which is consistent with the long-term warming driven by human-caused climate change,” Labe says.
paras.zh: 然而，科学家们一致认为，2026 年非常炎热，而且令人担忧。拉贝说：“全国平均气温继续达到新的纪录水平，这与人为气候变化造成的长期变暖是一致的。”

paras.en: “Whether 2026 ultimately ranks as number one or number three doesn’t distract from the bigger story that temperatures are rising across the country and leading to major impacts for communities,” he adds.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“无论 2026 年最终排名第一还是第三，都不会分散人们对全国气温上升并对社区造成重大影响的更大故事的关注。”

paras.en: It seems “more than likely” that 2026 may turn out to be a record hot year for the U.S., says Kim Cobb, a climate scientist and a professor at Brown University. But even if it doesn’t, the country remains at high risk of “fossil-fueled extremes” such as heat waves and extraordinary rainfall.
paras.zh: 布朗大学气候科学家兼教授金·科布 (Kim Cobb) 表示，2026 年“很有可能”成为美国创纪录的炎热年份。但即使没有，该国仍然面临着热浪和异常降雨等“化石燃料极端事件”的高风险。

paras.en: “We do not need a record-breaking year for U.S. temperatures to know that fossil-fueled climate change is threatening our economy, our critical infrastructure, our health and our national security,” she says.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们不需要美国气温破纪录的一年就知道由化石燃料引起的气候变化正在威胁我们的经济、我们的关键基础设施、我们的健康和我们的国家安全。”

paras.en: Then there’s next year. A brewing “Super El Niño” in the Pacific threatens to make 2027 even more destructive for the planet.
paras.zh: 然后就是明年了。太平洋地区正在酝酿的“超级厄尔尼诺”现象可能会使 2027 年对地球造成更大的破坏。

paras.en: “Most climate scientists are looking at the projections for record-shattering global temperatures next year with a profound sense of dread—as hot as 2026 has been, and as horrific in terms of weather and climate extremes, 2027 looks like it could be a lot worse, according to our best projections,” Cobb says.
paras.zh: “大多数气候科学家都怀着深深的恐惧感看待明年全球气温破纪录的预测——根据我们的最佳预测，2026 年的天气和极端气候同样可怕，2027 年的情况可能会更糟，”Cobb 说。

articles.title: Could a giant iceberg really break off Greenland? Scientists check Tom Cruise’s new movie Digger

paras.en: In Tom Cruise’s new movie Digger, the actor plays a crazed oil baron whose irresponsible drilling causes a massive iceberg to split off Greenland. Named Judy by climate scientists in the movie, the marauding ice barrels toward Europe, imperiling lives—but real climate scientists say this may be a little more fantastical than what we’d see if such an event really happened.
paras.zh: 在汤姆·克鲁斯的新片《挖掘者》中，演员扮演一位疯狂的石油大亨，他不负责任的钻探导致格陵兰岛一座巨大的冰山分裂。电影中的气候科学家将其命名为“朱迪”，向欧洲掠夺的冰桶危及生命，但真正的气候科学家表示，这可能比我们在此类事件真的发生时看到的情况更加荒诞。

paras.en: In the movie, Judy threatens to bring a tsunami to Norway. The plot point is dramatic, but it misunderstands how ice shelves work, says Nils Bochow, a climate scientist at the Alfred Wegener Institute in Potsdam, Germany. Ice shelves are already floating on the water, so “if [icebergs] break off, nothing much happens because they don't cause any change in sea level.”
paras.zh: 在电影中，朱迪威胁要给挪威带来海啸。德国波茨坦阿尔弗雷德·韦格纳研究所的气候科学家尼尔斯·博肖 (Nils Bochow) 表示，情节很戏剧性，但它误解了冰架的工作原理。冰架已经漂浮在水面上，因此“如果[冰山]破裂，不会发生任何事情，因为它们不会导致海平面发生任何变化。”

paras.en: Icebergs can make waves if they break off ice shelves or glaciers, but these are typically confined to a range of a few kilometers (one km is 0.6 mile), Borchow says. “And they’re also moving very, very slowly. It’s not very spectacular.”
paras.zh: Borchow 说，如果冰山从冰架或冰川上脱落，就会产生波浪，但这些波浪通常仅限于几公里的范围内（一公里等于 0.6 英里）。 “而且它们移动得非常非常缓慢。这不是很壮观。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Judy’s size is about 400 square miles—that’s likely much larger than any possible Greenland iceberg, Borchow says. For example, a recent large iceberg that broke free of Greenland’s Petermann Glacier was 29 square miles; it eventually collided with the country’s Joe Island. The largest Greenland iceberg in recent history broke off Petermann Glacier in 2010, and it was only a quarter the size of Judy.
paras.zh: 博尔乔说，朱迪的大小约为 400 平方英里，这可能比任何可能的格陵兰冰山都要大得多。例如，最近脱离格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川的一座大冰山面积为 29 平方英里；它最终与该国的乔岛相撞。近代历史上最大的格陵兰冰山于 2010 年从彼得曼冰川上脱落，它的大小只有朱迪岛的四分之一。

paras.en: In Antarctica, however, icebergs much larger than Judy break off ice shelves regularly. But again, these aren’t known to cause havoc to humans on land. (They have been known to trouble penguins, though.) In fact, many of these events are a natural part of an ice shelf's life cycle rather than the result of climate change or human activity. For instance, in 2023 an iceberg 1.5 times as big as Judy broke off of Antarctica's Brunt Ice Shelf. It was the fourth in a succession of large calving events off Antarctica—and it wasn’t even the largest: one iceberg that broke off another Antarctic ice shelf in 2017 was about 2,240 square miles.
paras.zh: 然而，在南极洲，比朱迪大得多的冰山经常从冰架上脱落。但同样，目前还不知道这些会对陆地上的人类造成严重破坏。 （不过，众所周知，它们会给企鹅带来麻烦。）事实上，许多这些事件都是冰架生命周期的自然组成部分，而不是气候变化或人类活动的结果。例如，2023 年，一座 1.5 倍于朱迪大小的冰山从南极洲的布伦特冰架上脱落。这是南极洲附近一系列大型冰山崩解事件中的第四次，而且它甚至还不是最大的一次：2017 年从另一个南极冰架上脱落的一座冰山面积约为 2,240 平方英里。

paras.en: “It’s unlikely that an iceberg would make its way to a major populated area [because icebergs] usually melt as they enter the warmer waters away from the ice sheet,” says Chris Stokes, who studies glaciers at the Durham University in England.
paras.zh: 英国达勒姆大学冰川研究人员克里斯·斯托克斯 (Chris Stokes) 表示：“冰山不太可能到达主要人口稠密地区，因为冰山通常会在进入远离冰盖的温暖水域时融化。”

paras.en: “However, they pose a serious hazard to shipping and other maritime human activities and there may be some local impacts on coastal settlements or tourist activities near the ice sheets,” he adds.
paras.zh: “然而，它们对航运和其他海上人类活动构成严重危害，并且可能对冰盖附近的沿海定居点或旅游活动产生一些局部影响，”他补充道。

paras.en: Icebergs aside, what is true is that human-driven climate change is causing ice at the planet’s poles to melt. The resulting destruction of critical ice sheets in Greenland and Antarctica will raise global sea levels.
paras.zh: 撇开冰山不谈，人类造成的气候变化确实正在导致地球两极的冰融化。由此造成的格陵兰岛和南极洲关键冰盖的破坏将导致全球海平面上升。

paras.en: Digger is, first and foremost, a parable—without spoiling the plot, its events are intentionally exaggerated to make a point about humans and climate change. But Borchow says that the movie misses one of the least recognized truths about climate change.
paras.zh: 《挖掘者》首先是一个寓言——在不破坏情节的情况下，它的事件被故意夸大，以表达关于人类和气候变化的观点。但博乔表示，这部电影忽略了有关气候变化的最不为人所知的真相之一。

paras.en: “I think a lot of people think that [climate change] is happening very fast, but these ice sheets are very, very slow,” he says. “We see this change, but it doesn’t seem urgent to most people… But everything that we do today has an influence on the future. It’s really hard to put that in a movie.”
paras.zh: “我认为很多人认为（气候变化）发生得非常快，但这些冰盖的速度非常非常慢，”他说。 “我们看到了这种变化，但对大多数人来说似乎并不紧迫......但我们今天所做的一切都会对未来产生影响。很难将其放入电影中。”

articles.title: Can AI reason without words? A small model puts the idea to the test
articles.author: Sascha Brodsky

paras.en: AI may be able to reason without putting every step into words.
paras.zh: 人工智能也许能够进行推理，而无需将每一步都用语言表达出来。

paras.en: Many of today’s AI systems tackle difficult problems by generating intermediate steps in lengthy, chains of words before arriving at an answer— a technique often called chain-of-thought reasoning. That approach can improve performance on some tasks, but it also means an AI model may generate many words, or tokens, on the way to a relatively short answer. Each token takes computing power to produce, so longer reasoning can make answers slower and more expensive to generate.
paras.zh: 当今的许多人工智能系统通过在得出答案之前生成冗长的单词链中的中间步骤来解决难题，这种技术通常称为思维链推理。这种方法可以提高某些任务的性能，但这也意味着人工智能模型可能会生成许多单词或标记，以获得相对较短的答案。每个令牌都需要计算能力来生成，因此较长的推理可能会使生成速度更慢且成本更高。

paras.en: A small, experimental AI system called BDH-CQ takes a different approach. It can solve some reasoning puzzles without spelling out its intermediate thinking, researchers report in a paper submitted August 10 to arXiv.org. The work asks whether AI needs language at every step of reasoning, and whether doing more internally could make some reasoning cheaper.
paras.zh: 一个名为 BDH-CQ 的小型实验性人工智能系统采用了不同的方法。研究人员在 8 月 10 日提交给 arXiv.org 的论文中报告称，它可以解决一些推理难题，而无需阐明其中间思维。这项工作询问人工智能是否在推理的每一步都需要语言，以及在内部做更多的事情是否可以使某些推理变得更便宜。

paras.en: In training, AI models are often shown a few examples before they try a new problem. Many keep those examples in front of them as they work. But on reasoning tests, BDH-CQ (DH is short for Dragon Hatchling) instead uses each example to update a fixed-size memory, which stays the same size as it takes in more examples, so it does not have to keep going back through everything it has already seen.
paras.zh: 在训练中，人工智能模型在尝试新问题之前通常会展示一些示例。许多人在工作时都会把这些例子放在面前。但在推理测试中，BDH-CQ（DH 是 Dragon Hatchling 的缩写）而是使用每个示例来更新固定大小的内存，该内存在更多示例中保持相同的大小，因此它不必不断回溯它已经看到的所有内容。

paras.en: “Once the query arrives, the model doesn’t write out its thinking in words at all,” says complexity scientist Zuzanna Stamirowska, CEO of AI company Pathway. Stamirowska says the model works through a problem internally without turning each step into words. “Nothing in between ever converts into language,” she says.
paras.zh: 人工智能公司 Pathway 的首席执行官、复杂性科学家 Zuzanna Stamirowska 表示：“查询到达后，模型根本不会用文字写出其思维。”斯塔米罗斯卡表示，该模型在内部解决问题，而无需将每个步骤转化为文字。 “介于两者之间的任何东西都不会转化为语言，”她说。

paras.en: Stamirowska and colleagues said the model solved nearly three in 10 puzzles on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set when given two attempts. The result showed that a small model could solve some new reasoning problems without spelling out its intermediate steps. The benchmark tests ask AI systems to infer visual rules from a few examples and apply them to new puzzles. The tests are like human student exams.
paras.zh: Stamirowska 及其同事表示，在进行两次尝试时，该模型解决了公共 ARC-AGI-1 评估集上近十分之三的难题。结果表明，一个小模型可以解决一些新的推理问题，而无需阐明其中间步骤。基准测试要求人工智能系统从几个例子中推断出视觉规则，并将其应用于新的谜题。这些测试就像人类学生的考试一样。

paras.en: The model did better on some puzzles than others. For example, it handled some tasks involving turning or moving shapes but struggled more with color changes and some combinations of rules. On harder ordering and nesting puzzles, the model did better after seeing an example of similar difficulty.
paras.zh: 该模型在某些谜题上的表现比其他谜题更好。例如，它处理了一些涉及转动或移动形状的任务，但在颜色变化和某些规则组合方面遇到了更多困难。在较难的排序和嵌套难题上，模型在看到类似难度的示例后表现更好。

paras.en: The process with fewer words may help keep computing costs down, Stamirowska and colleagues say. They estimate that each puzzle query costs about $0.00070 to run, about one-eleventh as much as GPT-5.6 Luna on the same benchmark test, though the two costs were calculated differently. The study has not been peer-reviewed.
paras.zh: 斯塔米罗斯卡和同事说，这个过程用更少的文字可能有助于降低计算成本。他们估计每个谜题查询的运行成本约为 0.00070 美元，在同一基准测试中约为 GPT-5.6 Luna 的十一分之一，尽管这两种成本的计算方式不同。该研究尚未经过同行评审。

paras.en: The finding is “an interesting efficiency result,” says computer scientist Yuntian Deng of the University of Waterloo in Canada. But he says it does not show that BDH-CQ’s underlying architecture is better than other approaches.
paras.zh: 加拿大滑铁卢大学的计算机科学家 Yuntian Deng 表示，这一发现是“一个有趣的效率结果”。但他表示，这并不表明 BDH-CQ 的底层架构比其他方法更好。

paras.en: “Specialized small models [like BDH-CQ] are a promising route to efficient reasoning,” Deng says. But more testing is needed to separate the effects of the model’s design from how it was trained, he says. Without written-out reasoning, the model is harder to inspect, Deng says. But even a written chain of thought may not faithfully show how the model reached its answer.
paras.zh: “专门的小型模型 [如 BDH-CQ] 是实现高效推理的一条有前途的途径，”邓说。但他表示，还需要进行更多的测试来区分模型设计的效果与训练方式的影响。邓说，如果没有书面推理，模型就很难检查。但即使是书面的思想链也可能无法忠实地表明模型是如何得出答案的。

paras.en: The BDH-CQ model was built specifically for ARC-style problems, which makes it hard to compare directly with general-purpose AI systems, says machine learning researcher Jonas Geiping of the ELLIS Institute Tübingen and the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in Germany. But he called the approach “neat” and noted that it can tackle test problems without retraining.
paras.zh: 德国蒂宾根埃利斯研究所和马克斯普朗克智能系统研究所的机器学习研究员 Jonas Geiping 表示，BDH-CQ 模型是专门针对 ARC 类型的问题而构建的，这使得它很难与通用人工智能系统进行直接比较。但他称这种方法“简洁”，并指出它可以解决测试问题而无需重新培训。

paras.en: For Deng, the study raises a broader question: Does AI need to put all of its reasoning into words?. “Human language is useful for communicating reasoning, but it need not be the most efficient representation for every intermediate computation,” Deng says.
paras.zh: 对于邓来说，这项研究提出了一个更广泛的问题：人工智能是否需要将其所有推理都用文字表达出来？ “人类语言对于交流推理很有用，但它不一定是每个中间计算的最有效表示，”邓说。

articles.title: First series of adult T. rex footprints hints at its walking speed
articles.author: Erin Garcia de Jesús

paras.en: Four ancient footprints are helping scientists step into a T. rex’s shoes.
paras.zh: 四个古老的脚印正在帮助科学家们扮演霸王龙的角色。

paras.en: The prints form the first set of tracks probably left behind by an adult Tyrannosaurus rex, researchers report September 8 in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology. Measurements of the 7-meter-long trackway suggest the ancient predator was ambling along at about 1.6 meters per second, roughly equivalent to a person’s quick walking pace.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 8 日在《古脊椎动物学杂志》上报道称，这些脚印可能是成年霸王龙留下的第一组足迹。对 7 米长的轨道的测量表明，这种古代掠食者的行走速度约为每秒 1.6 米，大致相当于一个人的快走速度。

paras.en: A few single adult T. rex footprints exist in the fossil record, as do trackways possibly from T. rex juveniles or other dinosaur species, says Peter Falkingham, a paleontologist at Liverpool John Moores University in England. “But an individual track doesn’t tell you a lot. A trackway tells you more about foot placement as the animal’s moving along.” And younger and older dinosaurs probably walked differently, just as human toddlers and adults do.
paras.zh: 英国利物浦约翰摩尔斯大学的古生物学家彼得·法尔金厄姆说，化石记录中存在一些单独的成年霸王龙足迹，还有可能来自幼年霸王龙或其他恐龙物种的足迹。 “但是单独的足迹并不能告诉你很多信息。足迹可以告诉你更多关于动物移动时脚的位置的信息。”年轻和年长的恐龙的行走方式可能不同，就像人类幼儿和成年人一样。

paras.en: “Finding an adult trackway is cool,” Falkingham says. “It’s unique. It brings something new.”
paras.zh: “找到成人跑道很酷，”法金厄姆说。 “它很独特。它带来了新的东西。”

paras.en: High school teacher and paleontologist Kent Hups stumbled on the footprints in 2025, while fossil hunting along a steep incline in the Hell Creek Formation in North Dakota. The tracks stick up out of the ground because sediment filled in the originally muddy footprints, which then eroded away more slowly than the surrounding rock.
paras.zh: 2025 年，高中教师兼古生物学家肯特·哈普斯 (Kent Hups) 在北达科他州地狱溪地层的陡峭斜坡上寻找化石时偶然发现了这些脚印。这些脚印从地面上突出来，是因为沉积物填满了原本泥泞的脚印，然后这些脚印的侵蚀速度比周围的岩石要慢。

paras.en: When Hups saw the first track, he noted that it was three-toed and enormous, measuring 80 centimeters across. “I’m going, ‘this has to be a T. rex,’” says Hups, of Northglenn High School in Colo. and the Denver Museum of Nature and Science.
paras.zh: 当哈普斯看到第一条足迹时，他注意到它是三趾的，而且巨大，宽 80 厘米。 “我想，‘这一定是霸王龙，’”科罗拉多州北格伦高中和丹佛自然科学博物馆的哈普斯说。

paras.en: Slender toe impressions and fossils unearthed in the area signal a T. rex left behind the footprints roughly 66.5 million years ago. “There’s always the possibility that we haven’t found the skeletons of some species that we don’t know about,” Falkingham says. “But as far as our knowledge goes, T. rex is about the only track maker that could have made these.”
paras.zh: 该地区出土的细长脚趾印和化石表明，霸王龙在大约 6650 万年前留下了脚印。 “我们总是有可能没有找到一些我们不知道的物种的骨骼，”法金厄姆说。 “但据我们所知，霸王龙是唯一可以制造这些的轨道制造商。”

paras.en: The team used stride length and body size to calculate the dinosaur’s speed. Unfortunately, the footprints aren’t well-preserved and estimating speed from tracks is tricky, so the T. rex may have been walking slightly faster or slower than calculated. Better tracks could have revealed whether the foot landed flat or toe-to-heel, or how foot pads supported the predator’s weight.
paras.zh: 研究小组利用步幅和体型来计算恐龙的速度。不幸的是，这些脚印保存得并不好，而且根据足迹估计速度也很棘手，因此霸王龙的行走速度可能比计算的稍快或稍慢。更好的足迹可以揭示脚是平着地还是脚趾着地，或者脚垫如何支撑捕食者的体重。

paras.en: More tracks are sure to follow. In fact, a fifth step may be concealed in the hill. But the team is waiting for Mother Nature to wear away the surrounding rock, Hups says. “I can’t wait to get back out there and keep looking for more.”
paras.zh: 更多曲目肯定会随之而来。事实上，第五级台阶可能隐藏在山中。但哈普斯说，研究小组正在等待大自然磨损周围的岩石。 “我迫不及待地想回到那里并继续寻找更多。”

articles.title: Finally, a true blue rose exists
articles.author: Tina Hesman Saey

paras.en: This development could change poetry forever. Roses are red and now they’re also blue.
paras.zh: 这一发展可能永远改变诗歌。玫瑰是红色的，现在也变成了蓝色。

paras.en: True blue roses were once thought impossible. Roses can make red and yellow pigments but don’t have an enzyme needed to make blue pigments. At least they didn’t until 2004, when researchers at the Suntory Global Innovation Center in Kyoto, Japan, genetically modified a rose to produce blue pigments. The team inserted the gene for an enzyme that can produce a blue pigment called delphinidin. But those roses were purplish, suggesting it takes more than blue pigment to make flowers blue.
paras.zh: 真正的蓝玫瑰曾经被认为是不可能的。玫瑰可以产生红色和黄色颜料，但没有产生蓝色颜料所需的酶。至少直到 2004 年，日本京都三得利全球创新中心的研究人员对玫瑰进行了基因改造，以产生蓝色色素。研究小组插入了一种酶的基因，这种酶可以产生一种叫做飞燕草素的蓝色色素。但这些玫瑰是紫色的，这表明需要蓝色色素才能使花朵变成蓝色。

paras.en: Naturally blue flowers, such as irises, make blue pigments like delphinidin. But they also need almost colorless “co-pigment” molecules called flavone C-glycosides to create their blue hue. Those helper molecules stabilize pigments and make them appear deeper blue. Roses also lack genes for making the co-pigments.
paras.zh: 天然的蓝色花朵，例如鸢尾花，会产生蓝色色素，例如飞燕草素。但它们还需要称为黄酮 C-糖苷的几乎无色的“辅助色素”分子来产生蓝色调。这些辅助分子可以稳定色素并使它们呈现更深的蓝色。玫瑰也缺乏制造辅色素的基因。

paras.en: This time, Suntory researchers inserted four genes from other blue flower species into a light pink rose. A gene from Canterbury bells (Campanula medium) allowed the engineered roses to produce multiple blue pigments. Two genes from wishbone flowers (Torenia x hybrida) and one from clustered gentian (Gentiana triflora) made enzymes that produce the colorless helper molecules. The combination of the blue pigment malvidin with a helper called isoorientin made bluer flowers than roses producing only delphinidin, the company announced August 25 at the 32nd International Horticultural Congress in Kyoto. The higher the level of co-pigments in the petals, the bluer the flowers, the researchers found.
paras.zh: 这次，三得利研究人员将来自其他蓝色花种的四个基因插入到浅粉色玫瑰中。来自坎特伯雷钟（风铃培养基）的基因使工程玫瑰能够产生多种蓝色色素。两个来自叉骨花（Torenia x Hybrida）的基因和一个来自簇状龙胆（Gentiana triflora）的基因可以产生产生无色辅助分子的酶。该公司于 8 月 25 日在京都举行的第 32 届国际园艺大会上宣布，将蓝色色素锦葵素与异荠草素相结合，可以比仅产生飞燕草素的玫瑰花更蓝。研究人员发现，花瓣中的辅色素含量越高，花朵就越蓝。

paras.en: Roses making the co-pigments are rated as violet blue based on a flower color chart. The rose bushes continued to produce blue flowers for seven years in greenhouse tests in Japan and three years growing in fields in Colombia.
paras.zh: 根据花色表，制作复合颜料的玫瑰被评定为紫蓝色。这些玫瑰花丛在日本的温室测试中持续开出蓝色花朵七年，并在哥伦比亚的田地中生长了三年。

paras.en: The achievement is sweet. And the team hopes to further enhance the hue.
paras.zh: 成就是甜蜜的。团队希望进一步增强色调。

articles.title: Scientists Discover a Genius Use For Leftover Steel Waste – And It Could Save Lives
articles.author: Starre Vartan

paras.en: We all love a win-win. Well here's one better–a potential win-win-win.
paras.zh: 我们都喜欢双赢。嗯，还有一个更好的方案——潜在的双赢。

paras.en: By using what would otherwise be an industrial waste in new road pavements, the future of highways and byways could reduce impacts on climate change and potentially save lives.
paras.zh: 通过在新路面中使用工业废物，高速公路和小道的未来可以减少对气候变化的影响，并有可能拯救生命。

paras.en: A new analysis suggests that replacing conventional urban pavement with roads made partly from recycled steel slag could substantially cut greenhouse gas and air-pollution emissions, while also reducing road maintenance (so fewer annoying road-repair traffic jams, too!).
paras.zh: 一项新的分析表明，用部分由回收钢渣制成的道路取代传统的城市路面可以大大减少温室气体和空气污染的排放，同时还可以减少道路维护（因此也可以减少恼人的修路交通拥堵！）。

paras.en: If you've never heard of steel slag, you're not alone. It's actually a waste product that comes out of the process of melting iron ore or scrap metal to make steel.
paras.zh: 如果您从未听说过钢渣，那么您并不孤单。它实际上是熔化铁矿石或废金属炼钢过程中产生的废物。

paras.en: This leftover stuff is a mix of silicon dioxide and metal oxides and it can be used to make steel slag epoxy asphalt mixture, or SEAM.
paras.zh: 这种剩余物是二氧化硅和金属氧化物的混合物，可用于制造钢渣环氧沥青混合物（SEAM）。

paras.en: Steel slag is kind of ideal for pavement because its high strength and angular structure make it useful for creating a durable road material.
paras.zh: 钢渣是路面的理想选择，因为它的高强度和棱角结构使其可用于制造耐用的道路材料。

paras.en: In this study, the researchers combined the SEAM with an epoxy-modified asphalt binder, producing a material designed to withstand wear and deformation better than conventional pavement.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，研究人员将 SEAM 与环氧改性沥青结合料相结合，生产出一种比传统路面更好地承受磨损和变形的材料。

paras.en: A more durable road reduces the social annoyance and air pollution of road-construction-related congestion.
paras.zh: 更耐用的道路可以减少与道路建设相关的拥堵造成的社会烦恼和空气污染。

paras.en: But also, as pavement deteriorates, vehicles actually use more fuel (costly on its own both financially and in emissions). So if a road deteriorates less often, it also saves the vehicles that ride on it gas, diesel, and wear-and-tear.
paras.zh: 而且，随着路面的恶化，车辆实际上会使用更多的燃料（其本身的经济和排放成本都很高）。因此，如果道路恶化的情况较少，也可以节省在该道路上行驶的车辆的汽油、柴油和磨损。

paras.en: In the researchers' model, all these use-phase effects accounted for about 95 percent of emissions and 60 percent of the lifetime costs of the road in the baseline scenarios.
paras.zh: 在研究人员的模型中，所有这些使用阶段的影响约占基线情景中排放量的 95% 和道路生命周期成本的 60%。

paras.en: Even though most of the costs for any roadway happen in the use phase, the researchers do show that SEAM costs more to build, produces more emissions and generates more fine particulate pollution during its early years of use. But crucially, just when a conventional roadway surface needs replacement (generating those emissions again), the SEAM-based roadway emissions keep going.
paras.zh: 尽管任何道路的大部分成本都发生在使用阶段，但研究人员确实表明，SEAM 的建设成本更高，在使用初期会产生更多排放并产生更多细颗粒污染。但至关重要的是，当传统道路表面需要更换（再次产生这些排放）时，基于 SEAM 的道路排放仍在继续。

paras.en: This significant durability of the SEAM-based roadways changes the equation.
paras.zh: 基于 SEAM 的道路的显着耐用性改变了这一现状。

paras.en: The researchers modeled three versions containing 20, 35 or 50 percent epoxy. Conventional pavement and 20 percent epoxy SEAM were assumed to last six years, while the 35-percent epoxy version lasted an estimated 15 years and the 50-percent version 20 years.
paras.zh: 研究人员模拟了含有 20%、35% 或 50% 环氧树脂的三个版本。传统路面和 20% 环氧树脂 SEAM 的使用寿命预计为 6 年，而 35% 环氧树脂版本预计可使用 15 年，50% 环氧树脂版本可使用 20 年。

paras.en: By spreading the emissions and costs of construction over a longer service life – and reducing the fuel and maintenance penalties associated with deteriorating roads – the longer-lasting pavement could eventually make up for its higher upfront footprint.
paras.zh: 通过在更长的使用寿命内分摊排放和建设成本，并减少与道路恶化相关的燃料和维护处罚，更持久的路面最终可以弥补其较高的前期足迹。

paras.en: The researchers identified the 35-percent epoxy formulation as the best balance within their modeled scenarios: More epoxy extended pavement life, but beyond roughly 35 percent, the additional environmental gains leveled off while costs continued to rise.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，35% 的环氧树脂配方是他们建模场景中的最佳平衡：更多的环氧树脂可以延长路面寿命，但超过大约 35% 后，额外的环境收益就会趋于平稳，而成本则继续上升。

paras.en: They then scaled the model up to China's urban road network, testing scenarios in which 25, 50, 75 or 100 percent of existing urban asphalt pavement was replaced. At the highest replacement level, the model projected reductions of about 1.74 billion tonnes of CO2-equivalent emissions and 1.23 billion kilograms of PM2.5 over the assessment period.
paras.zh: 然后，他们将该模型扩展到中国的城市道路网络，测试了替换 25%、50%、75% 或 100% 的现有城市沥青路面的场景。在最高替代水平下，该模型预计在评估期内将减少约 17.4 亿吨二氧化碳当量排放量和 12.3 亿公斤 PM2.5 排放量。

paras.en: PM2.5 is the fine particulate pollution that's linked to deaths from heart disease, kidney disease, dementia, hypertension, lung cancer, and other diseases.
paras.zh: PM2.5 是一种细颗粒污染，与心脏病、肾病、痴呆、高血压、肺癌和其他疾病导致的死亡有关。

paras.en: Those numbers add up to create a pretty serious impact. Across the replacement scenarios, the researchers estimated 31,802 to 128,980 premature deaths could be avoided as a result of reduced PM2.5 exposure alone.
paras.zh: 这些数字加起来会产生相当严重的影响。在替代方案中，研究人员估计，仅减少 PM2.5 暴露即可避免 31,802 至 128,980 人过早死亡。

paras.en: Those health figures come from a model linking modeled reductions in fine particulate pollution with established relationships between PM2.5 exposure and mortality. The authors explicitly describe the results as system-level estimates rather than precise epidemiological predictions.
paras.zh: 这些健康数据来自一个模型，该模型将模拟的细颗粒物污染减少量与 PM2.5 暴露和死亡率之间的既定关系联系起来。作者明确地将结果描述为系统级估计，而不是精确的流行病学预测。

paras.en: Not to be overlooked, SEAM could also save some serious money: It could generate 3.48–15.01 trillion Chinese Yuan ($519.14 billion to $2.24 trillion US Dollars) according to the study.
paras.zh: 不容忽视的是，SEAM 还可以节省大量资金：根据研究，它可以产生 3.48-15.01 万亿元人民币（5191.4 亿美元至 2.24 万亿美元）的收入。

paras.en: These kinds of system-level material performance changes could have even larger implications as they're "broadly transferable to other rapidly urbanizing economies with significant steel industries," the study's researchers write.
paras.zh: 该研究的研究人员写道，这些系统级材料性能变化可能会产生更大的影响，因为它们“可以广泛转移到其他拥有重要钢铁工业的快速城市化经济体”。

paras.en: "Countries such as India, along with several nations in Southeast Asia and Africa, generate large volumes of [steel slag] while facing accelerating transport demand and mounting environmental constraints." Those countries could also benefit from the climate, public health, and economic gains of the SEAM roadways.
paras.zh: “印度等国家以及东南亚和非洲的几个国家产生了大量的[钢渣]，同时面临着日益增长的运输需求和日益严峻的环境限制。”这些国家还可以从 SEAM 公路的气候、公共卫生和经济收益中受益。

paras.en: There are logistical complications to account for: Steel slag isn't produced evenly across China, so the researchers modeled shipping it between provinces. That adds emissions – but in their model, the additional transport still produced a large net reduction in CO2-equivalent emissions and PM2.5.
paras.zh: 需要考虑物流方面的复杂性：中国各地的钢渣产量并不均匀，因此研究人员模拟了各省之间的运输情况。这增加了排放量，但在他们的模型中，额外的运输仍然导致二氧化碳当量排放量和 PM2.5 的净减少量大幅增加。

paras.en: The study also doesn't model whether today's industrial infrastructure could immediately produce and distribute enough material to meet nationwide demand. And one of the biggest drawbacks is that this new pavement requires seven days of curing before it can fully open to traffic.
paras.zh: 该研究也没有模拟当今的工业基础设施是否可以立即生产和分配足够的材料来满足全国需求。而最大的缺点之一是，这条新路面需要养护7天才能完全通车。

paras.en: It's interesting to think that a more sustainable roadway may not necessarily be the one that takes the least energy to build. It could be one that spends the longest time being boringly, gloriously roadlike – smooth, durable, and in need of fewer repairs.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，一条更可持续的道路不一定是建造能耗最少的道路。它可能是一个花费最长时间的无聊、光荣的道路——光滑、耐用，并且需要更少的维修。

paras.en: The research has been published in Communications Earth & Environment.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上。

articles.title: Ozempic Rival Delivers 25% Weight Loss at Highest Dose in Phase 3 Trial
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A flight of stairs can become a challenge for aching knees. Sleep can be broken by repeated breathing problems. For people living with obesity, the effects of the disease can reach far beyond the number on a bathroom scale.
paras.zh: 爬楼梯可能会对疼痛的膝盖构成挑战。反复出现呼吸问题可能会破坏睡眠。对于肥胖症患者来说，这种疾病的影响可能远远超出浴室体重秤上的数字。

paras.en: Researchers testing an experimental weekly injection therefore tracked more than kilograms lost. They also examined changes in knee pain and breathing disruptions during sleep.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员测试了每周一次的实验性注射，追踪到的体重损失超过公斤。他们还检查了睡眠期间膝盖疼痛和呼吸中断的变化。

paras.en: The results showed improvements across all three areas. At the highest dose, participants lost an average of 25 percent of their starting weight after 80 weeks. Knee pain and sleep apnea events decreased more than with placebo.
paras.zh: 结果显示所有三个领域都有所改善。在最高剂量下，80 周后，参与者的体重平均减轻了初始体重的 25%。与安慰剂相比，膝盖疼痛和睡眠呼吸暂停事件减少更多。

paras.en: In a smaller group followed for two years, average weight loss approached 30 percent.
paras.zh: 在为期两年的跟踪调查中，一小群人的平均体重减轻了近 30%。

paras.en: Retatrutide remains experimental. But the phase 3 study, published in The New England Journal of Medicine, provides evidence of its effects on obesity and some accompanying health problems.
paras.zh: 瑞他鲁肽仍处于实验阶段。但发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上的第三阶段研究提供了其对肥胖和一些伴随健康问题的影响的证据。

paras.en: Led by obesity researcher Ania Jastreboff at Yale University, the trial enrolled 2,339 adults with obesity but without diabetes.
paras.zh: 该试验由耶鲁大学肥胖症研究人员 Ania Jastreboff 领导，招募了 2,339 名患有肥胖症但没有糖尿病的成年人。

paras.en: Participants were randomly assigned to weekly injections of 4, 9, or 12 milligrams of retatrutide, or a placebo containing no active drug. Neither participants nor investigators knew which treatment they received.
paras.zh: 参与者被随机分配每周注射 4、9 或 12 毫克瑞他鲁肽，或不含活性药物的安慰剂。参与者和研究人员都不知道他们接受了哪种治疗。

paras.en: The drug's development rests on the idea that targeting several biological signals together could produce greater benefits.
paras.zh: 该药物的开发基于这样的想法：同时针对多个生物信号可以产生更大的益处。

paras.en: After a meal, hormones help the body manage nutrients, blood sugar, and appetite. Retatrutide activates receptors for three of these chemical messengers: GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon.
paras.zh: 饭后，激素帮助身体管理营养、血糖和食欲。瑞他鲁肽可激活其中三种化学信使的受体：GLP-1、GIP 和胰高血糖素。

paras.en: GLP-1 helps regulate appetite and stimulates insulin release when blood sugar rises. GIP also supports the insulin response after eating. Glucagon helps the liver release glucose, while activating its receptor can also increase energy expenditure.
paras.zh: GLP-1 有助于调节食欲并在血糖升高时刺激胰岛素释放。 GIP 还支持餐后胰岛素反应。胰高血糖素帮助肝脏释放葡萄糖，同时激活其受体也可以增加能量消耗。

paras.en: The aim is to combine effects that reduce food intake with effects that could increase energy use. Earlier experiments in obese mice linked this combination to both lower food consumption and higher energy expenditure. The new human trial examined clinical outcomes rather than measuring each pathway's contribution separately.
paras.zh: 目的是将减少食物摄入的效果与增加能量消耗的效果结合起来。早期对肥胖小鼠进行的实验将这种组合与较低的食物消耗和较高的能量消耗联系起来。新的人体试验检查了临床结果，而不是单独测量每个途径的贡献。

paras.en: An earlier phase 2 study offered evidence: participants receiving the highest dose lost an average of 24.2 percent of their starting weight after 48 weeks. The larger trial tracked how that effect developed over a longer period.
paras.zh: 早期的 2 期研究提供了证据：接受最高剂量的参与者在 48 周后平均减轻了起始体重的 24.2%。更大规模的试验追踪了这种效应在较长时间内如何发展。

paras.en: After 80 weeks, average weight reductions were 17.6 percent in the 4-milligram group, 23.7 percent with 9 milligrams, and 25 percent with 12 milligrams. The placebo group lost 3.9 percent.
paras.zh: 80 周后，4 毫克组平均体重减轻 17.6%，9 毫克组平均体重减轻 23.7%，12 毫克组平均体重减轻 25%。安慰剂组的体重下降了 3.9%。

paras.en: These calculations accounted for participants stopping treatment or starting prohibited weight-management therapies. They describe averages, so individual experiences varied.
paras.zh: 这些计算考虑了参与者停止治疗或开始禁止的体重管理疗法的情况。它们描述的是平均值，因此个人经历各不相同。

paras.en: To examine what happened with longer treatment, researchers enrolled the first eligible participants who completed the 80-week treatment period into a 24-week extension. This phase included 532 participants.
paras.zh: 为了研究长期治疗会发生什么情况，研究人员将第一批完成 80 周治疗期的合格参与者纳入了 24 周的延长治疗期。这一阶段有 532 名参与者。

paras.en: Those originally assigned 12 milligrams continued at a maximum tolerated dose of 9 or 12 milligrams. In this 12-milligram group, average weight loss reached 29.9 percent after 104 weeks.
paras.zh: 最初分配 12 毫克的患者继续服用最大耐受剂量 9 或 12 毫克。在这个 12 毫克剂量组中，104 周后平均体重减轻了 29.9%。

paras.en: A separate analysis estimated outcomes if participants continued treatment as intended without certain events, such as starting prohibited weight-management therapies. It estimated a loss of 30.3 percent in the same group. For the full 12-milligram group in the main trial, the estimate using that same method was 28.3 percent at 80 weeks.
paras.zh: 一项单独的分析估计了如果参与者继续按预期治疗而没有发生某些事件（例如开始禁止的体重管理疗法）的结果。据估计，同一组的损失率为 30.3%。对于主要试验中的完整 12 毫克组，使用相同方法的估计结果在 80 周时为 28.3%。

paras.en: The different figures reflect different statistical assumptions. The two-year results come from participants who entered the extension, not from everyone originally enrolled.
paras.zh: 不同的数字反映了不同的统计假设。两年的结果来自进入延期的参与者，而不是来自最初注册的每个人。

paras.en: People initially receiving placebo switched to retatrutide during the extension. The results therefore do not compare two years of drug treatment with two years of placebo.
paras.zh: 最初接受安慰剂的人在延长期间改用瑞他鲁肽。因此，结果并未将两年的药物治疗与两年的安慰剂进行比较。

paras.en: The trial also tracked two common obesity-related complications.
paras.zh: 该试验还追踪了两种常见的与肥胖相关的并发症。

paras.en: Among 574 participants with knee osteoarthritis, which involves damage to joint cartilage and surrounding tissues, pain decreased. In the analysis accounting for treatment discontinuation and other events, pain scores fell by an average of 4.1 points on a 0–10 scale with 12 milligrams, compared with 2.5 points with placebo.
paras.zh: 在 574 名患有膝骨关节炎（涉及关节软骨和周围组织损伤）的参与者中，疼痛有所减轻。在考虑治疗中断和其他事件的分析中，服用 12 毫克后，疼痛评分在 0-10 级上平均下降 4.1 分，而安慰剂组则下降 2.5 分。

paras.en: Another 243 participants had obstructive sleep apnea, in which the upper airway repeatedly narrows or closes during sleep. At the highest dose, episodes of stopped or shallow breathing decreased by an average of 32.1 per hour, compared with 9.6 with placebo.
paras.zh: 另外 243 名参与者患有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停，即上呼吸道在睡眠期间反复狭窄或关闭。在最高剂量下，呼吸停止或浅呼吸的次数平均每小时减少 32.1 次，而安慰剂组为 9.6 次。

paras.en: However, side effects accompanied these improvements. Gastrointestinal problems were most common, generally mild or moderate and occurring mainly during dose increases.
paras.zh: 然而，这些改进也伴随着副作用。胃肠道问题最常见，一般为轻度或中度，主要发生在剂量增加期间。

paras.en: Around 42 percent of the highest-dose group reported nausea. Adverse events led around 11 percent to stop treatment, compared with 4.6 percent receiving placebo. Serious adverse events occurred in 10.5 percent and 5.5 percent, respectively; recording an event does not prove the drug caused it.
paras.zh: 最高剂量组中约 42% 的人报告出现恶心。不良事件导致约 11% 的人停止治疗，而接受安慰剂的人为 4.6%。严重不良事件发生率分别为 10.5% 和 5.5%；记录事件并不能证明是药物引起的。

paras.en: The trial was not designed to establish cardiovascular safety. It also did not directly compare retatrutide with existing medications such as semaglutide or tirzepatide.
paras.zh: 该试验的目的不是为了确定心血管安全性。它还没有直接将瑞他鲁肽与现有药物（如索马鲁肽或替泽帕肽）进行比较。

paras.en: Manufacturer Eli Lilly funded the research and collected and analyzed the data.
paras.zh: 制造商礼来公司资助了这项研究并收集和分析了数据。

paras.en: The research has been published in The New England Journal of Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上。

articles.title: LASIK Alternative Promises to Improve Vision Without Scalpel or Lasers
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Recognizing a familiar face across the street. Reading a distant sign without squinting. For people with myopia, a clear view often depends on glasses, contact lenses, or laser surgery.
paras.zh: 认出了街对面一张熟悉的面孔。不眯眼就能读出远处的标志。对于近视患者来说，清晰的视野通常依赖于框架眼镜、隐形眼镜或激光手术。

paras.en: But what if the eye's light-focusing surface could be reshaped without cutting away any tissue?
paras.zh: 但是，如果可以在不切除任何组织的情况下重塑眼睛的光聚焦表面呢？

paras.en: Researchers are exploring that possibility using a platinum mold resembling a contact lens and a small electrical potential. In early experiments, isolated rabbit eyeballs adopted the mold's shape in about a minute.
paras.zh: 研究人员正在使用类似于隐形眼镜的铂模具和小电势来探索这种可能性。在早期的实验中，离体的兔子眼球在大约一分钟内就适应了模具的形状。

paras.en: All 10 eyes treated with a correction intended for nearsightedness reached the targeted focusing power.
paras.zh: 接受近视矫正治疗的10只眼睛全部达到目标聚焦力。

paras.en: The idea is to make the cornea temporarily moldable, then allow it to retain its new shape.
paras.zh: 这个想法是让角膜暂时可塑，然后让它保持新的形状。

paras.en: Chemist Michael Hill of Occidental College and surgeon Brian Wong of the University of California, Irvine, conducted the research, which Hill presented at the American Chemical Society's fall meeting in August 2025.
paras.zh: 西方学院的化学家 Michael Hill 和加州大学欧文分校的外科医生 Brian Wong 进行了这项研究，Hill 在 2025 年 8 月的美国化学会秋季会议上介绍了该研究。

paras.en: The announcement describes a conference presentation and does not identify a peer-reviewed publication.
paras.zh: 该公告描述了一次会议演示，并未指明同行评审的出版物。

paras.en: To understand the approach, start with the eye's transparent, curved front surface. The cornea bends incoming light, helping focus it onto the retina. Changing its curvature changes how light travels through the eye, potentially altering how clearly objects appear.
paras.zh: 要了解这种方法，请从眼睛透明、弯曲的前表面开始。角膜使入射光弯曲，帮助其聚焦到视网膜上。改变其曲率会改变光线穿过眼睛的方式，从而可能改变物体显示的清晰度。

paras.en: LASIK adjusts that curvature by removing precise amounts of corneal tissue with a laser. The experimental alternative, called electromechanical reshaping, or EMR, instead changes the chemical interactions that help the tissue hold its shape.
paras.zh: LASIK 通过用激光去除精确数量的角膜组织来调整曲率。另一种实验性替代方案称为机电重塑（EMR），它改变了帮助组织保持其形状的化学相互作用。

paras.en: "LASIK is just a fancy way of doing traditional surgery. It's still carving tissue – it's just carving with a laser," Hill says.
paras.zh: “LASIK 只是一种传统手术的奇特方式。它仍然是雕刻组织——它只是用激光进行雕刻，”希尔说。

paras.en: Hill and Wong's method exploits a property of collagen-containing tissues such as the cornea. Attractions between oppositely charged components help maintain their structure. Because these tissues contain water, applying an electrical potential can alter their chemical environment.
paras.zh: Hill 和 Wong 的方法利用了角膜等含胶原蛋白组织的特性。带相反电荷的成分之间的吸引力有助于维持其结构。由于这些组织含有水，施加电势可以改变它们的化学环境。

paras.en: Specifically, the researchers lower the tissue's pH, making it more acidic and loosening some interactions that keep it rigid. During this window, the cornea becomes malleable enough to conform to a mold.
paras.zh: 具体来说，研究人员降低了组织的 pH 值，使其变得更加酸性，并放松了一些保持其刚性的相互作用。在此期间，角膜变得足够有延展性以符合模具。

paras.en: When its original pH returns, those interactions are restored, holding the tissue in its new shape. The goal is to change its optical properties without removing material.
paras.zh: 当其原始 pH 值恢复时，这些相互作用就会恢复，使组织保持新的形状。目标是在不去除材料的情况下改变其光学特性。

paras.en: "The whole effect was discovered by accident," Wong says. "I was looking at living tissues as moldable materials and discovered this whole process of chemical modification."
paras.zh: “整个效应是偶然发现的，”黄说。 “我将活体组织视为可模制材料，并发现了化学修饰的整个过程。”

paras.en: To control the process, the researchers built specialized platinum "contact lenses". Each carried the curvature they wanted the cornea to adopt, serving as a template for reshaping.
paras.zh: 为了控制这个过程，研究人员制造了专门的铂金“隐形眼镜”。每个都具有他们希望角膜采用的曲率，作为重塑的模板。

paras.en: Each lens also acted as an electrode, allowing the team to apply the electrical potential. The same device therefore helped initiate the chemical change and determine the resulting shape.
paras.zh: 每个镜片还充当电极，使团队能够施加电势。因此，同一装置有助于引发化学变化并确定最终的形状。

paras.en: The researchers placed rabbit eyeballs in a saline solution intended to mimic natural tears, positioned the platinum lenses over them, and applied a small electrical potential. The controlled pH change allowed the corneas to match the lenses' curvature.
paras.zh: 研究人员将兔子眼球放入模拟自然泪液的盐溶液中，将铂金镜片放在眼球上，并施加一个小电位。受控的 pH 值变化使角膜能够与镜片的曲率相匹配。

paras.en: A cross-sectional image released by ACS illustrates the result: A white line marks the original corneal profile, while a yellow line shows the flatter shape achieved after treatment.
paras.zh: ACS 发布的横截面图像说明了结果：白线标记了原始角膜轮廓，而黄线显示了治疗后实现的更平坦的形状。

paras.en: The setup was tested on 12 isolated rabbit eyeballs. Ten received a correction intended for myopia, or nearsightedness. All 10 reached the desired focusing power, indicating that their optical properties had changed as intended.
paras.zh: 该装置在 12 个离体兔子眼球上进行了测试。十人接受了近视矫正。所有 10 个都达到了所需的聚焦能力，表明它们的光学特性已按预期发生变化。

paras.en: The reshaping took roughly a minute. The researchers suggest the approach could require fewer steps and less expensive equipment than LASIK, although that experimental timing does not establish how long a future clinical procedure would take.
paras.zh: 重塑过程大约需要一分钟。研究人员表示，与 LASIK 相比，该方法可能需要更少的步骤和更便宜的设备，尽管实验时间并没有确定未来的临床手术需要多长时间。

paras.en: Cell survival was another consideration. According to ACS, cells in the eyes survived because the team carefully controlled the pH gradient. That finding is encouraging, but does not establish long-term safety in a living eye.
paras.zh: 细胞存活是另一个考虑因素。据 ACS 称，由于团队仔细控制了 pH 梯度，眼睛中的细胞得以存活。这一发现令人鼓舞，但并不能确定活体眼睛的长期安全性。

paras.en: Separate experiments also suggested the technique might reverse some chemically induced corneal cloudiness, raising another possibility for future investigation.
paras.zh: 单独的实验还表明，该技术可能会逆转一些化学引起的角膜浑浊，为未来的研究提出了另一种可能性。

paras.en: The team had previously explored EMR in rabbit ears and in pig skin and scars.
paras.zh: 该团队此前曾在兔耳、猪皮和疤痕中探索过 EMR。

paras.en: These reported experiments used eyes removed from animals, so they do not demonstrate improved vision in a living rabbit or person. How long the reshaping would last and how living eyes would respond remain questions beyond the findings described in the announcement.
paras.zh: 这些报道的实验使用的是从动物身上摘除的眼睛，因此它们并没有证明活体兔子或人的视力有所改善。重塑会持续多长时间以及活体眼睛将如何反应仍然是公告中描述的调查结果之外的问题。

paras.en: Next, the team planned to test the technique in living rabbits and determine the range of vision corrections possible with EMR, including nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism. Funding uncertainty had put those steps on hold. The announcement does not establish whether those experiments have since begun.
paras.zh: 接下来，该团队计划在活体兔子身上测试该技术，并确定 EMR 可能矫正视力的范围，包括近视、远视和散光。资金的不确定性使这些步骤被搁置。该公告没有确定这些实验是否已经开始。

paras.en: "There's a long road between what we've done and the clinic," Hill says. "But, if we get there, this technique is widely applicable, vastly cheaper and potentially even reversible."
paras.zh: “我们所做的事情和诊所之间还有很长的路要走，”希尔说。 “但是，如果我们做到了这一点，这项技术将得到广泛应用，成本大大降低，甚至可能是可逆的。”

paras.en: For now, reshaping the eye without removing tissue remains an intriguing possibility requiring further testing. Whether this becomes a practical alternative to LASIK will depend on what those future studies reveal.
paras.zh: 目前，在不去除组织的情况下重塑眼睛仍然是一个有趣的可能性，需要进一步测试。这是否成为 LASIK 的实用替代方案将取决于未来的研究结果。

articles.title: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover finds groundwater, lakes, and hot fluids in one place

paras.en: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover finds groundwater, lakes, and hot fluids in one place
paras.zh: 美国宇航局毅力号火星探测器在一处发现地下水、湖泊和热流体

paras.en: - NASAâs Perseverance rover has uncovered a surprisingly complicated history of water in Jezero Crater. Scientists expected the craterâs Margin Unit to contain lake sediments, but instead found ancient igneous rocks that were altered by water on at least three separate occasions.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局的毅力号火星车在杰泽罗陨石坑发现了令人惊讶的复杂的水历史。科学家们原本预计陨石坑的边缘单元含有湖泊沉积物，但结果却发现了至少在三次不同的情况下被水改变的古代火成岩。

paras.en: A new study suggests that Jezero Crater's mysterious "Margin Unit" records a far more complicated history of water than scientists expected, involving ancient lakes, groundwater, and later hydrothermal activity.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，杰泽罗陨石坑神秘的“边缘单元”记录了比科学家预期复杂得多的水历史，涉及古代湖泊、地下水和后来的热液活动。

paras.en: When NASA's Perseverance rover arrived at the inner rim of Mars' Jezero Crater in September 2023, researchers expected to encounter sedimentary rocks along what was once the shoreline of a Martian lake. Such rocks form as layers of material accumulate over long periods of time. On Earth, sedimentary rocks made from clay and silt can be especially valuable because they are capable of preserving evidence of ancient microbial life.
paras.zh: 当 NASA 的毅力号火星车于 2023 年 9 月抵达火星 Jezero 陨石坑的内缘时，研究人员预计会在曾经的火星湖海岸线遇到沉积岩。这些岩石是随着物质层经过长时间的积累而形成的。在地球上，由粘土和淤泥制成的沉积岩尤其有价值，因为它们能够保存古代微生物生命的证据。

paras.en: Scientists were also interested in the area because Mars orbiters had detected strong signatures of carbonate minerals there. On Earth, carbonates commonly develop in shallow lakes and oceans, including environments that can support life.
paras.zh: 科学家们对该地区也很感兴趣，因为火星轨道飞行器在那里检测到了碳酸盐矿物的强烈特征。在地球上，碳酸盐通常形成于浅湖和海洋，包括可以支持生命的环境。

paras.en: Instead of the expected sedimentary deposits, Perseverance encountered igneous rock. These rocks can form when magma cools underground or when volcanic material solidifies at the surface. Because the minerals inside igneous rocks can preserve information about the conditions present when they formed, they can provide exceptionally detailed geological records.
paras.zh: 毅力号没有遇到预期的沉积物，而是遇到了火成岩。当岩浆在地下冷却或火山物质在地表凝固时，就会形成这些岩石。由于火成岩内部的矿物可以保存有关其形成时的条件的信息，因此它们可以提供异常详细的地质记录。

paras.en: In the Margin Unit, those rocks revealed an unexpectedly complicated history. The evidence indicates that they interacted with water on at least three separate occasions, and each episode changed their chemistry and physical appearance in different ways. The findings were published in the journal Communications Earth & Environment.
paras.zh: 在边缘单元中，那些岩石揭示了一段意想不到的复杂历史。证据表明，它们至少在三个不同的场合与水相互作用，并且每个事件都以不同的方式改变了它们的化学和物理外观。研究结果发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上。

paras.en: SuperCam Reveals Mars' Hidden Water History
paras.zh: SuperCam 揭示火星隐藏水的历史

paras.en: Much of this evidence came from SuperCam, an instrument mounted high on Perseverance's mast. SuperCam can identify the mineral composition of geological features by analyzing the light they reflect.
paras.zh: 这些证据大部分来自超级摄像机，这是一种安装在毅力号桅杆上的仪器。 SuperCam 可以通过分析地质特征反射的光来识别它们的矿物成分。

paras.en: When mission scientists identify a promising target, they can direct SuperCam to fire its laser from as far as 21 feet (6.5 meters) away. The laser creates a small burst of plasma, and the spectrum of that plasma reveals the chemical makeup of the rock. Using this technique, Perseverance has studied more than 185 bedrock targets across the Margin Unit.
paras.zh: 当任务科学家发现有希望的目标时，他们可以指示 SuperCam 从最远 21 英尺（6.5 米）外发射激光。激光产生一小股等离子体，等离子体的光谱揭示了岩石的化学成分。使用这项技术，Perseverance 已经研究了 Margin Unit 内超过 185 个基岩目标。

paras.en: "Before we arrived at the Margin Unit, the main hypothesis -- derived from orbital observations -- was that the carbonate seen from orbit formed from interaction with the lake that existed in Jezero Crater," said Candice Bedford, a research scientist at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana, and the study's lead author. "But now we know that this location became a sort of crossroads for aqueous systems. The Margin Unit findings are important because Jezero Crater sits inside one of the largest exposures of carbonate on Mars, so what we learn here reaches well beyond this crater."
paras.zh: “在我们到达边缘单元之前，基于轨道观测的主要假设是，从轨道上看到的碳酸盐是由与杰泽罗陨石坑中存在的湖泊相互作用形成的，”印第安纳州西拉斐特普渡大学的研究科学家、该研究的主要作者坎迪斯贝德福德说。 “但现在我们知道这个位置成为了水系统的十字路口。边缘单位的发现很重要，因为杰泽罗陨石坑位于火星上最大的碳酸盐暴露区域之一，所以我们在这里学到的东西远远超出了这个陨石坑。”

paras.en: Perseverance examined the Margin Unit over approximately 870 feet (265 meters) of elevation. At the higher parts of the area, the rover encountered coarse, crystalline rock rich in olivine. These rocks showed almost no evidence of having been altered by water.
paras.zh: 毅力号在大约 870 英尺（265 米）的高度上检查了边缘单元。在该地区的较高部分，火星车遇到了富含橄榄石的粗糙结晶岩石。这些岩石几乎没有被水改变的证据。

paras.en: Olivine contains magnesium and iron. The researchers concluded that this olivine-rich unit originally formed inside a mass of magma deep beneath the Martian surface. The magma cooled slowly enough for large mineral grains to develop. Much later, erosion removed the material above it and exposed the rock at the surface.
paras.zh: 橄榄石含有镁和铁。研究人员得出的结论是，这个富含橄榄石的单元最初是在火星表面深处的岩浆团内部形成的。岩浆冷却得足够慢，足以形成大的矿物颗粒。很久以后，侵蚀去除了上面的物质，露出了地表的岩石。

paras.en: The situation was very different farther down the Margin Unit, near the ancient lakebed. There, the olivine appears heavily altered. Its grains are fractured, and silica fills spaces between them.
paras.zh: 边缘单元更深处、靠近古老湖床的地方，情况就大不相同了。在那里，橄榄石似乎发生了严重的改变。它的颗粒破裂，二氧化硅填充颗粒之间的空间。

paras.en: Carbonate and silica are especially interesting to scientists searching for signs of ancient habitability. On Earth, when water reacts with olivine, the process can produce hydrogen that certain microbes can use as an energy source. The same reactions can also create carbonate and silica, minerals that are capable of preserving traces left behind by past microbial activity.
paras.zh: 碳酸盐和二氧化硅对于寻找古代宜居迹象的科学家来说特别有趣。在地球上，当水与橄榄石发生反应时，该过程会产生氢气，某些微生物可以将其用作能源。同样的反应还可以产生碳酸盐和二氧化硅，这些矿物质能够保留过去微生物活动留下的痕迹。

paras.en: Researchers can reconstruct the order in which water altered the Margin Unit, although they cannot yet determine exactly when each episode happened.
paras.zh: 研究人员可以重建水改变保证金单位的顺序，尽管他们还不能准确确定每个事件发生的时间。

paras.en: The first known episode involved groundwater rich in carbon dioxide. As this water moved through the rock, it reacted with olivine and produced carbonate inside fractures at lower elevations. Over time, erosion removed some of the softer surrounding material, leaving the harder carbonate-filled fractures standing out as ridges.
paras.zh: 第一个已知事件涉及富含二氧化碳的地下水。当水流过岩石时，它与橄榄石发生反应，并在较低海拔的裂缝内产生碳酸盐。随着时间的推移，侵蚀去除了周围一些较软的物质，留下了较硬的碳酸盐填充裂缝，形成山脊。

paras.en: A second period of water activity may have been connected to the ancient lake that once filled Jezero Crater.
paras.zh: 第二个时期的水活动可能与曾经充满杰泽罗火山口的古老湖泊有关。

paras.en: "Some of the Margin Unit rocks also contain silica," said Eleni Ravanis, a planetary scientist at the University of Hawaii at Manoa and a coauthor of the study. "Turning olivine into carbonate can leave silica behind, and we see more of that silica in rocks that sat below the water line."
paras.zh: “一些边缘单元岩石也含有二氧化硅，”夏威夷大学马诺阿分校的行星科学家、该研究的合著者埃莱妮·拉瓦尼斯 (Eleni Ravanis) 说。 “将橄榄石转化为碳酸盐会留下二氧化硅，我们在水位线以下的岩石中看到了更多的二氧化硅。”

paras.en: A third and later episode appears to have involved heated water moving underground.
paras.zh: 第三次及以后的事件似乎涉及热水在地下流动。

paras.en: At one site in the eastern Margin Unit, Perseverance found mineral veins roughly 10 inches (25 centimeters) thick. These veins contain minerals including calcium sulfate and fluorite.
paras.zh: 在东部边缘单元的一处地点，Perseverance 发现了大约 10 英寸（25 厘米）厚的矿脉。这些矿脉含有硫酸钙和萤石等矿物质。

paras.en: The presence of fluorite provides an important clue about the conditions that produced them. Fluorite commonly forms when hot water circulates through volcanic rock, indicating that Jezero Crater experienced a later period of heated groundwater activity after the earlier interactions with groundwater and the lake.
paras.zh: 萤石的存在提供了有关产生萤石的条件的重要线索。萤石通常在热水循环穿过火山岩时形成，这表明杰泽罗火山口在与地下水和湖泊的早期相互作用之后经历了后期的地下水加热活动。

paras.en: Together, the observations show that the Margin Unit was not shaped by a single lake environment. Instead, it became a meeting point for several different water systems that altered the same rocks at different stages of Mars' history.
paras.zh: 总之，观察结果表明，边缘单位并不是由单一湖泊环境塑造的。相反，它成为了几个不同水系统的交汇点，这些水系统在火星历史的不同阶段改变了相同的岩石。

paras.en: "If there is one thing I have learned after 10 years working with Mars rovers, it is that Mars constantly throws surprises at you," said Bedford. "It is very rare that things are as we expect them to be from orbital data. I hope this work helps reshape how scientists view the history of water in Jezero Crater and across Mars. Ultimately, I hope it helps planetary scientists reconstruct the changing climate and habitability of early Mars."
paras.zh: 贝德福德说：“如果说我在火星漫游车工作十年后学到了一件事，那就是火星不断地给你带来惊喜。” “事情很少像我们从轨道数据中预期的那样。我希望这项工作有助于重塑科学家们对杰泽罗陨石坑和火星上水的历史的看法。最终，我希望它能帮助行星科学家重建早期火星不断变化的气候和宜居性。”

paras.en: Materials provided by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NASA 喷气推进实验室提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。
