articles.title: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know
articles.author: Catherine Osborn

paras.en: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know
paras.zh: 巴西的大型政治重赛：需要了解什么

paras.en: RIO DE JANEIRO — Brazil's presidential election is a rematch of the country's bitter 2022 contest — but with a twist. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is facing Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of the man he narrowly defeated four years ago, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 里约热内卢——巴西总统选举是该国 2022 年激烈竞选的重演，但也有一些转折。总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦的对手是弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，他是四年前以微弱优势击败的雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子。

paras.en: Flávio, a 45-year-old senator, is carrying his father's political movement into Sunday's election. Jair Bolsonaro is now serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup to overturn that loss. His son has promised to pardon him if elected.
paras.zh: 45 岁的参议员弗拉维奥正在将他父亲的政治运动带入周日的选举。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗因策划政变推翻这一失败而被判 27 年徒刑，目前正在服刑。他的儿子承诺如果当选将赦免他。

paras.en: The younger Bolsonaro says he is "a more moderate Bolsonaro," but has voiced few policy differences from his father. He pledges to pardon his father over the coup conviction, has cast doubt on humans' responsibility for climate change, and supports making it easier for Brazilians to buy guns.
paras.zh: 年轻的博尔索纳罗表示，他是“一个更温和的博尔索纳罗”，但与他的父亲在政策上没有什么不同。他承诺赦免父亲的政变罪名，对人类对气候变化的责任表示怀疑，并支持让巴西人更容易购买枪支。

paras.en: Lula, 80, is seeking a fourth presidential term. The result will determine whether Brazil stays with Lula's left-leaning government or returns the Bolsonaro movement to the presidency.
paras.zh: 80 岁的卢拉正在寻求第四次总统任期。结果将决定巴西是继续支持卢拉的左倾政府，还是让博尔索纳罗运动重返总统宝座。

paras.en: The stakes extend well beyond the two families.
paras.zh: 赌注远远超出了两个家庭的范围。

paras.en: The next president is expected to nominate four of 11 Supreme Court justices, giving the winner a significant influence over the court for years to come.
paras.zh: 下一任总统预计将提名最高法院 11 名法官中的 4 名，获胜者将在未来几年对最高法院产生重大影响。

paras.en: The next president will also shape Brazil's economy and environmental policy, its relationship with the United States, and the future of its young democracy.
paras.zh: 下一任总统还将塑造巴西的经济和环境政策、与美国的关系以及年轻民主国家的未来。

paras.en: Here's what you need to know about Brazil's Oct. 4 election.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的有关巴西 10 月 4 日选举的信息。

paras.en: The election could stretch into late October
paras.zh: 选举可能会持续到十月下旬

paras.en: Polls suggest a tight race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro among a field of presidential candidates. Federal and state legislative seats and state governorships are also up for grabs. If no candidate for president or governor receives more than 50% of the valid votes Sunday, the two candidates with the most votes will continue to a runoff on Oct. 25.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，卢拉和弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在总统候选人中的竞争十分激烈。联邦和州立法席位以及州州长职位也都在争夺之中。如果周日没有总统或州长候选人获得超过 50% 的有效选票，则得票最多的两名候选人将在 10 月 25 日继续进行决选。

paras.en: Brazil uses electronic voting machines and typically counts the results within hours. By Sunday night, it will likely be clear who is headed to a runoff — and how strongly each candidate performed in the first round.
paras.zh: 巴西使用电子投票机，通常在数小时内计算结果。到周日晚上，谁将进入决选，以及每位候选人在第一轮的表现有多强，可能就会一目了然。

paras.en: The Bolsonaro name is carrying a lot of baggage
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗这个名字背负着很多包袱

paras.en: Jair Bolsonaro lost the 2022 election to Lula by a narrow margin and then became the central figure in an effort to reject the result. He is now serving a sentence for plotting a coup to overturn that loss, a scheme that included a plan to assassinate Lula, according to police.
paras.zh: 雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 在 2022 年大选中以微弱优势输给了卢拉，随后成为试图拒绝选举结果的核心人物。据警方称，他目前正在服刑，罪名是策划政变以推翻这一损失，该计划包括暗杀卢拉的计划。

paras.en: The younger Bolsonaro has made clear that he intends to stand by his father. His pledge to pardon Jair if elected has turned the former president's legal fate into a campaign issue — and raised broader questions about the consequences of a Bolsonaro return to power for Brazil's democratic institutions.
paras.zh: 小博尔索纳罗明确表示，他打算支持父亲。他承诺如果当选将赦免雅伊尔，这将这位前总统的法律命运变成了竞选问题，并引发了有关博尔索纳罗重新掌权对巴西民主机构的影响的更广泛问题。

paras.en: Lula was jailed on corruption and money laundering charges in 2018, but the Supreme Court annulled his convictions in 2021 on procedural grounds. The episode remains a point of contention in Brazilian politics. His supporters point to other parts of his record, including reductions in poverty and efforts to protect the Amazon rainforest.
paras.zh: 卢拉于 2018 年因腐败和洗钱指控被判入狱，但最高法院于 2021 年以程序为由撤销了对他的定罪。这一事件仍然是巴西政坛争论的焦点。他的支持者提到了他的其他记录，包括减少贫困和保护亚马逊雨林的努力。

paras.en: Both political camps inspire intensely loyal supporters — and fierce opposition. Polarization has remained high since the political and economic crisis of the mid-2010s, after which, said Federal University of Paraná political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos, "it became very difficult for any president to reach the higher approval ratings of previous decades."
paras.zh: 两个政治阵营都激发了极其忠诚的支持者和激烈的反对派。巴拉那联邦大学政治学家法比奥·瓦斯康塞洛斯 (Fábio Vasconcellos) 表示，自 2010 年代中期政治和经济危机以来，两极分化一直居高不下，此后“任何一位总统都很难达到前几十年更高的支持率”。

paras.en: For all the attention on the Bolsonaro family and the battle over Brazil's political direction, voters are also focused on problems much closer to home.
paras.zh: 尽管所有注意力都集中在博尔索纳罗家族和巴西政治方向之争上，但选民们也将注意力集中在离自己更近的问题上。

paras.en: Insecurity is a top issue for voters. Bolsonaro supports a hardline approach to crime-fighting that he's suggested could include joint work with the U.S. military, while Lula has favored operations targeting the financiers of gangs and voiced skepticism of outside countries influencing Brazil's security policies.
paras.zh: 不安全感是选民面临的首要问题。博尔索纳罗支持采取强硬的打击犯罪方法，他建议这可能包括与美国军方合作，而卢拉则倾向于针对帮派资助者的行动，并对外部国家影响巴西安全政策表示怀疑。

paras.en: Voters also worry about corruption. Media and police investigations in recent weeks have revealed allegedly improper ties between a jailed ex-banker known for bribery and Supreme Court justices and other top politicians. Bolsonaro himself took money from the banker and is being investigated on money laundering charges, which he denies.
paras.zh: 选民还担心腐败问题。最近几周的媒体和警方调查显示，一名因行贿而闻名的入狱前银行家与最高法院法官和其他高级政客之间涉嫌存在不当关系。博尔索纳罗本人从银行家那里拿走了钱，并正在接受洗钱指控的调查，但他否认了这一点。

paras.en: And voters worry about Brazil's economy. Lula's embrace of public spending helped drive economic growth early in his government, but growth has since slowed.
paras.zh: 选民担心巴西的经济。卢拉对公共支出的支持有助于推动其政府早期的经济增长，但此后增长放缓。

paras.en: Bolsonaro argues Brazil's hefty national debt is holding back the economy and a top campaign adviser has pledged to reduce it by slashing spending along the lines of Argentina's Javier Milei.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗认为，巴西沉重的国债正在拖累经济，一位高级竞选顾问已承诺通过像阿根廷的哈维尔·米雷那样削减支出来减少债务。

paras.en: The United States has become an unusually visible presence in this year's campaign. Rallies for Flávio have featured U.S. flags, reflecting his pledge to align more closely with the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 美国在今年的竞选活动中异常引人注目。弗拉维奥的集会以美国国旗为特色，反映出他承诺与特朗普政府更加紧密地保持一致。

paras.en: A September cover of a leading Brazilian political magazine captured the perceived U.S. interest in the election with an image of a giant U.S. spaceship hovering over a small Brazilian polling site.
paras.zh: 巴西一家主要政治杂志九月份的封面上刊登了一艘巨大的美国太空飞船盘旋在巴西一个小型投票站上空的图片，凸显了美国对此次选举的兴趣。

paras.en: The Bolsonaros have for years sought close ties to Trump.
paras.zh: 博索纳罗家族多年来一直寻求与特朗普建立密切关系。

paras.en: Flávio's brother, Eduardo, is living in the United States, where he has urged Trump to take action against Supreme Court justices who oversaw his father's coup-plot trial. Last year, Trump cited that trial as a justification for hiking tariffs on Brazil by 40%.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥的兄弟爱德华多目前居住在美国，他敦促特朗普对监督其父亲政变阴谋审判的最高法院法官采取行动。去年，特朗普以该审判为由，将巴西关税提高了 40%。

paras.en: Lula, meanwhile, has pushed back against Trump's pressure. He negotiated with the U.S. president to reduce some tariffs while saying Brazil's judicial independence was not negotiable. Lula has also criticized U.S. policy toward Venezuela, including the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卢拉顶住了特朗普的压力。他与美国总统谈判降低部分关税，同时表示巴西的司法独立是不容谈判的。卢拉还批评美国对委内瑞拉的政策，包括一月份逮捕委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

paras.en: In July, Lula publicly accused Washington of trying to meddle in Brazil's election. Brazilian officials said U.S. officials planned to travel to Brazil to spread doubt about the reliability of Brazilian voting machines. The State Department called the accusation "a baseless lie."
paras.zh: 7月，卢拉公开指责华盛顿试图干预巴西大选。巴西官员表示，美国官员计划前往巴西，散布人们对巴西投票机可靠性的怀疑。美国国务院称这一指控是“毫无根据的谎言”。

paras.en: That relationship could become especially consequential if the election is close.
paras.zh: 如果选举结果接近，这种关系可能会变得尤其重要。

paras.en: Yuri Sanches, head of political analysis at Brazilian polling and analysis firm AtlasIntel, says a narrow Lula victory could prompt Bolsonaro supporters to challenge the result.
paras.zh: 巴西民意调查和分析公司 AtlasIntel 的政治分析主管尤里·桑切斯 (Yuri Sanches) 表示，卢拉以微弱优势获胜可能会促使博尔索纳罗的支持者对选举结果提出质疑。

paras.en: "If Lula wins the election by a close margin, then almost for sure we would have some Bolsonaro supporters questioning the results," Sanches says.
paras.zh: 桑切斯说：“如果卢拉以微弱优势赢得选举，那么几乎可以肯定，一些博尔索纳罗的支持者会对选举结果提出质疑。”

paras.en: "They may ask for help from Trump, from Rubio, from the United States, saying that the election was rigged, that the electoral system, the electronic voting machines are not reliable."
paras.zh: “他们可能会向特朗普、卢比奥、美国寻求帮助，说选举被操纵，选举制度、电子投票机不可靠。”

paras.en: A victory for Flávio would also give greater political weight to the conservative movement that has gained ground across South America in recent years.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥的胜利还将给近年来在南美各地取得进展的保守派运动带来更大的政治影响力。

paras.en: This is a sensitive moment for Brazil's democracy
paras.zh: 这是巴西民主的敏感时刻

paras.en: Brazil emerged from military dictatorship in 1985 and has since developed into one of the world's largest democracies. According to V-Dem, an academic democracy research institute at the University of Gothenburg, Brazil ranks 28th on its Liberal Democracy Index, compared with 51st for the United States. The index measures factors including checks on executive power.
paras.zh: 巴西于 1985 年摆脱军事独裁，现已发展成为世界上最大的民主国家之一。根据哥德堡大学学术民主研究机构 V-Dem 的数据，巴西的自由民主指数排名第 28 位，而美国排名第 51 位。该指数衡量的因素包括对行政权力的检查。

paras.en: Brazil's 2025 prosecution and conviction of Jair Bolsonaro over the coup plot marked a significant test of its democratic institutions. The pledge by his son, Flávio, to pardon him has since raised questions about the durability of those institutions.
paras.zh: 巴西 2025 年因政变阴谋对雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 进行起诉并定罪，标志着其民主制度面临重大考验。他的儿子弗拉维奥承诺赦免他，此后引发了人们对这些机构的持久性的质疑。

paras.en: But the stakes extend beyond Brazil. As Latin America's largest economy and most populous country, Brazil belongs to the G20, a forum of major economies, and BRICS, a bloc of emerging powers.
paras.zh: 但利害关系不仅限于巴西。作为拉丁美洲最大的经济体和人口最多的国家，巴西属于主要经济体论坛G20和新兴大国金砖国家集团的成员。

paras.en: The expanded BRICS countries account for nearly half the world's population and about 39% of global GDP, measured by purchasing power parity.
paras.zh: 扩大后的金砖国家人口占世界近一半，按购买力平价衡量，GDP约占全球39%。

paras.en: The election will therefore be closely watched not only for what it says about Brazil's democracy, but also for what it could mean for the country's role in global trade, climate policy, security and the balance between the United States and the wider Global South.
paras.zh: 因此，此次选举将受到密切关注，不仅因为它对巴西民主的评价，而且还因为它对该国在全球贸易、气候政策、安全以及美国与更广泛的全球南方之间的平衡中的作用可能意味着什么。

articles.title: Three college students face federal charges over alleged threats against Trump ahead of campus rally

paras.en: Three University of South Alabama students were arrested Friday over alleged threats against President Donald Trump ahead of his evening rally on the Mobile campus, a source familiar with the matter told Fox News.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉福克斯新闻，周五，南阿拉巴马大学的三名学生因涉嫌在莫比尔校园晚间集会前威胁唐纳德·特朗普总统而被捕。

paras.en: The students were each charged with threatening the president over social media posts allegedly made in the days leading up to Trump's visit, according to the Lagniappe Daily.
paras.zh: 据《拉尼亚普日报》报道，这些学生均被指控因特朗普访问前几天在社交媒体上发布的帖子而威胁总统。

paras.en: The federal cases were unsealed Friday afternoon, just hours before Trump was scheduled to take the stage at the university's Mitchell Center, the outlet reported.
paras.zh: 据该媒体报道，联邦案件于周五下午启封，就在特朗普计划在该大学米切尔中心发表演讲的几个小时前。

paras.en: Federal investigators discovered the posts while conducting social media intelligence searches ahead of the president's visit and used emergency disclosure requests and information from University of South Alabama police to identify the individuals, according to FBI affidavits cited by Lagniappe.
paras.zh: 拉尼亚普援引联邦调查局的证词称，联邦调查人员在总统访问之前进行社交媒体情报搜索时发现了这些帖子，并利用紧急披露请求和南阿拉巴马大学警方的信息来识别这些人的身份。

paras.en: One student allegedly wrote a threatening remark toward Trump under a TikTok post about the president's planned visit to the campus, according to an FBI affidavit cited by the outlet.
paras.zh: 该媒体援引联邦调查局的一份证词称，据称一名学生在 TikTok 帖子下针对总统计划访问校园发表了对特朗普的威胁言论。

paras.en: Another student allegedly posted on X that people would "remember the University of South Alabama the same way they remember Utah Valley University," according to the outlet’s account of the FBI affidavit.
paras.zh: 根据该媒体对联邦调查局证词的描述，据称另一名学生在 X 上发帖称，人们会“像记住犹他谷大学一样记住南阿拉巴马大学”。

paras.en: Investigators noted that Utah Valley University was where conservative activist Charlie Kirk was fatally shot last year.
paras.zh: 调查人员指出，保守派活动家查理·柯克去年在犹他谷大学被枪杀。

paras.en: A third student allegedly replied to a TikTok post about Trump’s appearance.
paras.zh: 据称，第三名学生回复了有关特朗普外貌的 TikTok 帖子。

paras.en: Mobile County Sheriff Paul Burch said earlier in the week that his office was assisting federal authorities as they monitored social media activity related to the president's upcoming appearance.
paras.zh: 莫比尔县警长保罗·伯奇本周早些时候表示，他的办公室正在协助联邦当局监控与总统即将露面相关的社交媒体活动。

paras.en: The University of South Alabama said ahead of the event that the rally was not university-sponsored and that the Mitchell Center had been rented by the Republican National Committee (RNC).
paras.zh: 南阿拉巴马大学在活动前表示，这次集会不是由大学赞助的，米切尔中心是由共和党全国委员会（RNC）租用的。

paras.en: "The University of South Alabama unequivocally condemns any form of threats directed at elected officials or any individual with whom we disagree," the university said in a statement to Fox News Digital. "We encourage open dialogue and active civic participation, and having a difference of opinion is a natural part of any vibrant community.
paras.zh: “南阿拉巴马大学明确谴责针对民选官员或任何与我们意见不同的个人的任何形式的威胁，”该大学在给福克斯新闻数字频道的一份声明中表示。 “我们鼓励公开对话和积极的公民参与，意见分歧是任何充满活力的社区的自然组成部分。

paras.en: "However, there is a clear line between exercising free expression and engaging in intimidation or unlawful conduct."
paras.zh: “然而，行使言论自由与从事恐吓或非法行为之间存在明确的界限。”

paras.en: Trump took the stage for the midterm campaign rally Friday evening as scheduled, returning to Mobile roughly 11 years after his 2015 rally in the city during the opening months of his first presidential campaign.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，特朗普如期登上了中期竞选集会的舞台，在 2015 年他第一次总统竞选的头几个月期间在莫比尔举行集会大约 11 年后，他回到了莫比尔。

paras.en: "It sort of all began here," Trump told the crowd Friday, recalling the 2015 event.
paras.zh: “这一切似乎都是从这里开始的，”特朗普周五对人群说道，回忆起 2015 年的事件。

paras.en: He also recognized Burch and University of South Alabama President Jo Bonner from the stage.
paras.zh: 他还在台上认可了伯奇和南阿拉巴马大学校长乔·邦纳。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to the Department of Justice, FBI, Secret Service and the University of South Alabama for additional information.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字联系了司法部、联邦调查局、特勤局和南阿拉巴马大学以获取更多信息。

articles.title: Northwestern Wildcats christen new Ryan Field with impressive win over Penn State Nittany Lions

paras.en: After spending some time playing in a (very cool) makeshift stadium on the shores of Lake Michigan, the Northwestern Wildcats finally christened the new Ryan Field in an important Big Ten clash with Penn State.
paras.zh: 在密歇根湖畔的一个（非常酷的）临时体育场度过了一段时间后，西北野猫队最终在与宾夕法尼亚州立大学的一场重要的十大联盟比赛中为新的瑞安球场命名。

paras.en: Both teams came in with one loss, and another would almost certainly tank any hopes of getting into the Big Ten Championship conversation.
paras.zh: 两支球队都以一场失利告终，而另一支球队几乎肯定会挫败进入十大锦标赛的希望。

paras.en: The Wildcats came in off of an impressive showing against Indiana, and it became evident that that was no fluke, thanks to a 34-13 win over the Nittany Lions.
paras.zh: 野猫队在对阵印第安纳队的比赛中表现出色，最终以 34-13 战胜尼塔尼雄狮队，这显然不是侥幸。

paras.en: But before the game, Northwestern took a second to show off their new $875 million home — which opened its doors 100 years to the day after its predecessor debuted — and it was spectacular.
paras.zh: 但在比赛之前，西北大学花了一秒钟时间展示了他们耗资 8.75 亿美元的新住宅——在其前身首次亮相 100 年后才开门迎客——场面非常壮观。

paras.en: The first points at the new Ryan Field went to — fittingly enough — the Wildcats when Jackson Kleather booted a 50-yarder between the uprights to cap off Northwestern's maiden drive in their new home.
paras.zh: 在新瑞安球场，野猫队拿下了第一分，杰克逊·克莱瑟 (Jackson Kleather) 在立柱之间踢出一记 50 码的球，结束了西北大学在新主场的首次进攻。

paras.en: The Nittany Lions were forced to punt on their opening drive, and OC Chip Kelly's Wildcats offense went right back to work.
paras.zh: 尼塔尼雄狮队在开局时被迫弃踢，而 OC Chip Kelly 的野猫队进攻又开始发挥作用。

paras.en: Running back Joseph Himon II threw down a massive 47-yard run to put the Wildcats on the Penn State 4-yard line. Two plays later, quarterback Aidan Chiles used his legs to power into the end zone for six.
paras.zh: 跑卫约瑟夫·希蒙二世 (Joseph Himon II) 完成了一次 47 码的冲球，将野猫队带到了宾夕法尼亚州立大学的 4 码线上。两场比赛后，四分卫艾丹·奇利斯（Aidan Chiles）用他的双腿冲入达阵区，打进六球。

paras.en: The Wildcats couldn't have asked for a better opening quarter with 144 yards of total offense, 109 of those coming on the ground.
paras.zh: 野猫队开局取得了完美的成绩，总进攻码数为 144 码，其中 109 码来自地面。

paras.en: However, in the second quarter, Penn State forced a fumble on the Wildcats' second drive and recovered, giving them prime field position.
paras.zh: 然而，在第二节，宾夕法尼亚州立大学在野猫队的第二次进攻中被迫掉球，并恢复过来，使他们占据了领先的位置。

paras.en: That eventually led to an 8-yard rushing touchdown for running back Carson Hansen.
paras.zh: 最终跑卫卡森·汉森 (Carson Hansen) 冲球 8 码达阵。

paras.en: Northwestern struck right back with a quick touchdown on the ensuing possession, which stood after a flag for a block in the back was picked up.
paras.zh: 西北航空队在随后的控球中快速达阵，进行了右路反击，在后面的拦网旗被拿起后，球队站了起来。

paras.en: Northwestern tacked on another touchdown to go up 24-7.
paras.zh: 西北大学再次达阵，以24-7领先。

paras.en: On their final drive of the half, Penn State looked like they were going to at least put three points on the board; however, kicker Ryan Barker — who was staring down the barrel of Northwestern's new, European soccer-style "Wildcat Wall" — missed a crucial 45-yard field goal attempt.
paras.zh: 在半场的最后一攻中，宾夕法尼亚州立大学看起来至少要拿下三分；然而，踢球手瑞恩·巴克(Ryan Barker)——当时正盯着西北大学新的欧洲足球风格的“野猫墙”——错过了一次关键的45码射门尝试。

paras.en: David Braun's Wildcats dominated in that first half with 278 yards of offense.
paras.zh: 大卫·布劳恩 (David Braun) 的野猫队在上半场以 278 码的进攻占据主导地位。

paras.en: That trend continued in the second half. The Nittany Lions continued to struggle to get anything going offensively, while on defense, they couldn't find a way to contain the Wildcats' running game.
paras.zh: 这种趋势在下半年继续延续。尼塔尼雄狮队在进攻上继续努力取得进展，而在防守上，他们找不到遏制野猫队跑动的方法。

paras.en: If you thought it couldn't get worse for Penn State, it did. On the first play of the fourth quarter, Nittany Lions quarterback Rocco Becht threw an interception at midfield, leaving a possible scoring opportunity on the table.
paras.zh: 如果你认为宾夕法尼亚州立大学的情况不会变得更糟，那么事实确实如此。第四节第一回合，尼塔尼狮队四分卫罗科·贝希特在中场拦截，留下了一个可能的得分机会。

paras.en: While Penn State was able to put some points on the board, there was never a doubt that the Wildcats were in control.
paras.zh: 虽然宾夕法尼亚州立大学能够在董事会上取得一些成绩，但毫无疑问野猫队处于控制地位。

paras.en: While the 34-13 final is enough to get the Wildcats some attention, the fact that they put up 506 yards of total offense, 413 of them on the ground, is going to make defensive coordinators a bit nervous moving forward.
paras.zh: 虽然 34-13 的决赛足以引起野猫队的一些关注，但事实上他们总共进攻了 506 码，其中 413 码在地面上，这会让防守协调员在前进时感到有点紧张。

paras.en: Penn State will head home to host USC next weekend, while Northwestern will spend another week at their new digs and will welcome Ball State.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学将于下周末主场迎战南加州大学，而西北大学将在新址再呆一周，并欢迎鲍尔州立大学。

articles.title: Golden State Valkyries erase 16-point deficit, stun Dallas Wings to reach WNBA semifinals

paras.en: The Golden State Valkyries’ second season has brought historic success on and off the court. The WNBA expansion franchise received the league’s highest valuation from Forbes, just before the WNBA tipped off its milestone 30th season.
paras.zh: 金州女武神队的第二个赛季在球场内外都取得了历史性的成功。就在 WNBA 即将迎来其具有里程碑意义的第 30 个赛季之前，这支 WNBA 扩张球队获得了《福布斯》杂志的联盟最高估值。

paras.en: In 2025, the Valkyries became the first expansion franchise in league history to reach the playoffs in its inaugural season. They also sold out every regular season home game and set a league attendance record, averaging more than 18,000 fans per contest. The Valkyries built on that successful debut Friday night, rallying past the Dallas Wings in Game 3 to secure the first playoff series victory in franchise history.
paras.zh: 2025 年，瓦尔基里队成为联盟历史上第一支在首个赛季就进入季后赛的扩张球队。他们还创造了联盟每场常规赛主场比赛门票全部售罄的记录，平均每场比赛有超过 18,000 名球迷。瓦尔基里队在周五晚上的成功首秀基础上再接再厉，在第三场比赛中击败达拉斯翼队，取得了球队历史上的首个季后赛系列赛胜利。

paras.en: Valkyries forward Gabby Williams scored 19 points as Golden State rallied from a 16-point deficit to beat Dallas 77-73 in a dramatic, winner-take-all Game 3.
paras.zh: 瓦尔基里队前锋加比·威廉姆斯拿下 19 分，金州勇士队在落后 16 分的情况下奋起直追，以 77-73 击败达拉斯小牛队，完成了一场戏剧性的赢者通吃的第三场比赛。

paras.en: The game’s decisive moment came with 13.1 seconds remaining and Golden State holding a one-point lead. Williams leaped back inbounds to secure her own miss on a play initially ruled Dallas’ ball, but Valkyries coach Natalie Nakase successfully challenged the call.
paras.zh: 比赛的决定性时刻到来了，比赛还剩 13.1 秒，金州勇士队领先一分。威廉姆斯向后跳出界内，以确保自己在最初统治达拉斯的比赛中失手，但瓦尔基里队教练娜塔莉·中濑成功挑战了这一判罚。

paras.en: Nakase had fallen to her knees moments earlier and needed help getting up before being escorted off the court by a staff member after the final buzzer as her team celebrated at midcourt.
paras.zh: 中濑早些时候跪倒在地，需要帮助才能站起来，直到终场哨声响起后，她的球队在中场庆祝，中濑才被一名工作人员护送出球场。

paras.en: Arike Ogunbowale knocked down an off-balance jumper with 3:13 to play that put Dallas up by five and finished with 30 points to follow up a 45-point performance in the Wings’ overtime win Wednesday night at home.
paras.zh: 阿里克·奥贡博瓦勒 (Arike Ogunbowale) 在比赛还剩 3 分 13 秒时投中一记失去平衡的跳投，帮助达拉斯队领先 5 分，并在周三晚上主场加时赛中拿下 45 分的表现，拿下 30 分。

paras.en: Williams scored all but two of her points after halftime. Veronica Burton had 16 points, 10 rebounds and six assists. Burton’s layup with 8:19 to play pulled the Valkyries within 61-59, Williams hit two 3-pointers late in the third and they both willed Golden State into the best-of-five semifinals against the defending WNBA champion Las Vegas Aces.
paras.zh: 半场结束后，威廉姆斯只得了两分。维罗妮卡·伯顿得到16分、10个篮板和6次助攻。比赛还剩 8 分 19 秒时，伯顿的上篮帮助瓦尔基里队将比分追至 61-59，威廉姆斯在第三节末命中两记三分球，两人都带领金州勇士队进入半决赛，对阵卫冕 WNBA 冠军拉斯维加斯王牌队。

paras.en: Tiffany Hayes scored 18 points off the bench, Kaila Charles hit a tying 3-pointer with 6:51 left and Kiah Stokes pulled down 13 rebounds.
paras.zh: 替补出场的蒂芙尼·海耶斯拿下 18 分，凯拉·查尔斯在还剩 6 分 51 秒时命中三分球，基亚·斯托克斯拿下 13 个篮板。

paras.en: Paige Bueckers had 17 points with six assists but shot only 3 for 14 for Dallas, making all 10 of her free throws.
paras.zh: 佩奇·布克斯得到17分和6次助攻，但达拉斯队14投仅3中，罚球10罚全中。

paras.en: Before the hard fought game, Nakase challenged the Valkyries to deliver a complete performance. "We made a promise to ourselves we are going to play the best four quarters of our lives."
paras.zh: 激烈的比赛开始前，中濑向女武神们发起了一场完整的挑战。 “我们向自己承诺，我们将打出人生中最好的四个季度。”

paras.en: The Valkyries are scheduled to host the defending champion Las Vegas Aces on Sunday in Game 1 of the semifinals. The Atlanta Dream will host the New York Liberty in the other semifinal matchup.
paras.zh: 女武神队定于周日在半决赛第一场比赛中迎战卫冕冠军拉斯维加斯王牌队。亚特兰大梦想队将在另一场半决赛中迎战纽约自由队。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Five-year-old girl and man, 67, in critical condition after car hits crowd in Newcastle
articles.author: Nino Bucci

paras.en: Ten people have been injured, two critically, after a car crashed into a crowd of people in Newcastle waiting to farewell the Knights team bus before the NRL grand final.
paras.zh: 在纽卡斯尔举行 NRL 总决赛之前，一辆汽车冲撞了等待告别骑士队巴士的人群，造成 10 人受伤，其中两人伤势严重。

paras.en: New South Wales police said a five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man were in a critical condition, with eight others in a stable condition after the crash on Saturday morning.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方表示，周六早上发生车祸后，一名 5 岁女孩和一名 67 岁男子情况危急，另外八人情况稳定。

paras.en: Those in a stable condition included a two-year-old girl and another five-year-old girl.
paras.zh: 情况稳定的包括一名两岁女孩和另一名五岁女孩。

paras.en: The injured were treated on the scene by NSW ambulance paramedics, before being taken to John Hunter hospital.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州救护车护理人员在现场对伤者进行了治疗，然后被送往约翰亨特医院。

paras.en: The P-plate driver was an 18-year-old man who was arrested at the scene and taken to hospital for mandatory testing, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，P牌司机是一名18岁男子，他在现场被捕，并被送往医院接受强制检测。

paras.en: The assistant commissioner David Waddell said there were reports the man was driving erratically before losing control and careening into the crowd. It was expected he would be charged later on Saturday.
paras.zh: 助理专员大卫·沃德尔表示，有报道称，该男子驾驶不稳，然后失去控制并冲入人群。预计他将在周六晚些时候受到指控。

paras.en: The man had two others in the car with him.
paras.zh: 该男子车上还有另外两人。

paras.en: “We had to get them out of there because the crowd did turn on them,” Waddell said.
paras.zh: 瓦德尔说：“我们必须把他们从那里救出来，因为人群确实攻击了他们。”

paras.en: The police minister, Yasmin Catley, said so many lives had been affected by a split-second decision, as she urged other drivers to take care over the NSW long weekend.
paras.zh: 警察部长亚斯明·卡特利 (Yasmin Catley) 表示，这一瞬间的决定影响了很多人的生命，她敦促其他司机在新南威尔士州长周末要小心。

paras.en: “We have already started Saturday morning with this devastation,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们已经从周六早上开始遭受这种破坏，”她说。

paras.en: “Nobody can comprehend what has happened with this terrible tragedy.”
paras.zh: “没有人能够理解这场可怕的悲剧发生了什么。”

paras.en: The roads minister, Jenny Aitchison, said the incident could have been worse, with more than 1,000 people gathered in the area where it occurred.
paras.zh: 道路部长珍妮·艾奇森 (Jenny Aitchison) 表示，事件本来可能更严重，事发地区聚集了 1000 多人。

paras.en: Emergency services were called to Newcastle Link Road at the Transfield Drive roundabout in Wallsend about 9.30am on Saturday after reports a vehicle struck multiple people in a crowd.
paras.zh: 周六上午 9 点 30 分左右，有报道称一辆汽车撞到了人群中的多人，紧急服务人员接到电话前往位于 Wallsend Transfield Drive 环岛的 Newcastle Link Road。

paras.en: “Several people have been injured and are currently receiving treatment at the scene,” police said.
paras.zh: 警方称：“已有多人受伤，目前正在现场接受治疗。”

paras.en: “Police have commenced an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident, with initial inquiries indicating it is not believed to be terror related.”
paras.zh: “警方已开始调查该事件的情况，初步调查表明，据信该事件与恐怖活动无关。”

paras.en: Gavin Morris, the mayor of Newcastle, told the ABC that the driver, who he said was a Knights fan, lost control while revving his car shortly before the team arrived.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔市市长加文·莫里斯告诉美国广播公司，这名司机自称是骑士队球迷，在球队抵达前不久，他在加速时失去了控制。

paras.en: “I’ve spoken to the authorities, a number of which, and look, first of all, it is under investigation, and the young driver is now with police, so it appears that he was revving the car in some form. He was excited. He was a supporter. He was, you know, a fan,” Morris said.
paras.zh: 莫里斯说：“我已经与当局进行了多次交谈，首先，事情正在接受调查，这名年轻的司机现在已经和警察在一起了，所以他似乎以某种形式加速了汽车。他很兴奋。他是一名支持者。你知道，他是一名粉丝。”

paras.en: “It appears that he’s lost control of the car, and he’s gone … sideways into the crowd.”
paras.zh: “他似乎失去了对汽车的控制，然后他……侧身进入了人群。”

paras.en: Footage posted on social media appeared to show the car being driven quickly around a roundabout shortly before the crash.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的视频似乎显示，事故发生前不久，这辆车正在环形交叉路口快速行驶。

paras.en: Other images showed it had careened off the road soon afterwards.
paras.zh: 其他图像显示，该车很快就偏离了道路。

paras.en: A witness to the incident, Dylan Prior told ABC News that the car was “revving a bit” before it ran into a group of people.
paras.zh: 该事件的目击者迪伦·普赖尔告诉美国广播公司新闻，汽车在撞上一群人之前“稍微加速”。

paras.en: “I saw some young kids go flying, and people running to help the victims,” he said.
paras.zh: “我看到一些小孩飞了起来，人们跑去帮助受害者，”他说。

paras.en: “Everyone was yelling and hysterical, yelling at the driver.
paras.zh: “每个人都歇斯底里地大喊大叫，对司机大喊大叫。

paras.en: The Newcastle Link Road was closed in both directions, leading to the diversion of the Knights grand final procession.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔连接路双向封闭，导致骑士队总决赛游行队伍改道。

paras.en: The club confirmed in an Instagram post that it had changed its route, apologising to fans who may have missed farewelling the team but saying “public safety is our priority”.
paras.zh: 俱乐部在 Instagram 上发帖证实，它已经改变了路线，向可能错过送别球队的球迷道歉，但表示“公共安全是我们的首要任务”。

paras.en: Police appealed for fans to leave the area.
paras.zh: 警方呼吁球迷离开该地区。

paras.en: “Police acknowledge many loyal supporters may have missed the opportunity to see the team and show their support.
paras.zh: “警方承认，许多忠实的支持者可能错过了见到球队并表达支持的机会。

paras.en: “Members of the public are asked to safely disperse from the area and keep roadways clear to assist emergency services and traffic management efforts.
paras.zh: “要求公众安全地撤离该地区，并保持道路畅通，以协助紧急服务和交通管理工作。

paras.en: “Police thank the community for their patience, cooperation and assistance.”
paras.zh: “警方感谢社会各界的耐心、合作和帮助。”

paras.en: The NSW premier, Chris Minns, said his thoughts were with the families and friends of those injured.
paras.zh: 新州州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 表示，他的心与伤者的家人和朋友同在。

paras.en: “It’s heartbreaking to see fans who were sending off their grand final team involved in such a terrible incident,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“看到送走总决赛球队的球迷卷入如此可怕的事件，真是令人心碎。”

paras.en: “We’ve seen how this grand final has brought Newcastle together, and I hope the whole community remains united as we continue to respond.”
paras.zh: “我们已经看到了这场盛大的决赛如何让纽卡斯尔团结起来，我希望整个社区在我们继续应对的同时保持团结。”

paras.en: The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, said he had spoken with Minns and offered the federal government’s support.
paras.zh: 总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯表示，他已与明斯队进行了交谈，并表示愿意提供联邦政府的支持。

paras.en: “My thoughts are with everyone injured or involved in the horrible incident this morning in Newcastle,” Albanese said in a statement.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞在一份声明中说：“我的心与今天早上在纽卡斯尔发生的可怕事件中受伤或卷入的所有人同在。”

paras.en: “I want to acknowledge and thank emergency services and police for responding so quickly, and their ongoing work in treating the injured.
paras.zh: “我要感谢紧急服务部门和警察如此迅速的反应，以及他们在治疗伤者方面所做的持续工作。

paras.en: “Rugby league brings people together, and this should have been a weekend of excitement and pride for Newcastle fans.”
paras.zh: “橄榄球联赛将人们聚集在一起，这对纽卡斯尔球迷来说应该是一个激动和自豪的周末。”

articles.title: ‘We swept a lot under the carpet’: Vichy regime film hits home in France of 2026
articles.author: Angelique Chrisafis in Paris

paras.en: It is the story of how a lowly state administrator unthinkingly becomes a cog in the machine of an authoritarian regime, embracing the bureaucracy and logistics of sending people to their deaths – and it is drawing in audiences to French cinemas.
paras.zh: 这个故事讲述了一个地位低下的国家行政官员如何不假思索地成为独裁政权机器上的一个齿轮，利用官僚主义和后勤手段将人们送上死亡之地——它吸引了观众前往法国电影院。

paras.en: The French film Notre Salut (Our Salvation), with its modern lighting, improvised scenes and anachronistic 1980s Europop soundtrack, is far from the standard historical costume drama about the second world war.
paras.zh: 法国电影《Notre Salut》（我们的救赎）以其现代的灯光、即兴的场景和不合时宜的 20 世纪 80 年代欧洲流行音乐配乐，与有关第二次世界大战的标准历史古装剧相去甚远。

paras.en: But the award-winning film about the daily lives of ordinary people participating in the puppet Vichy regime that collaborated with the Nazis – and ensured the deportation of a quarter of France’s Jewish population to concentration camps – is poised to become a box office hit.
paras.zh: 但这部获奖影片讲述了参与维希傀儡政权的普通人的日常生活，该政权与纳粹勾结，并确保将法国四分之一的犹太人驱逐到集中营，有望成为票房热门。

paras.en: The film, which has been given the English-language title A Man of His Time, had a strong cinema opening in France this week, particularly among young audiences, at a time when the country is soul-searching ahead of next spring’s presidential election.
paras.zh: 这部电影的英文名为《时代风云人物》，本周在法国上映，尤其是在年轻观众中表现强劲，而此时法国正为明年春天的总统选举进行深刻反省。

paras.en: Marine Le Pen of the far-right, anti-immigration National Rally (RN) continues to top the polls for the presidential race despite the political fallout from an investigation by Mediapart alleging that her party leader, Jordan Bardella, published antisemitic comments as a young party member, which he denies.
paras.zh: 极右翼、反移民的全国集会 (RN) 的马琳·勒庞 (Marine Le Pen) 继续在总统竞选民意调查中名列前茅，尽管 Mediapart 的一项调查指控她的政党领袖乔丹·巴尔德拉 (Jordan Bardella) 在年轻党员时发表反犹太主义言论，产生了政治影响，但他否认了这一点。

paras.en: Notre Salut comes amid a boom in films about France during the second world war, including more than 5m ticket sales for the two-part biopic of Charles de Gaulle, as well the controversial Les Rayons et les Ombres about the press baron and Nazi collaborator Jean Luchaire, and the forthcoming Moulin, about the last days of the French resistance leader Jean Moulin.
paras.zh: 《致敬》上映之际，有关二战期间法国的电影蓬勃发展，其中包括售出超过 500 万张票房的戴高乐传记片，分为两部分，还有备受争议的关于新闻大亨和纳粹合作者让·卢谢尔 (Jean Luchaire) 的《光与暗》(Les Rayons et les Ombres)，以及即将上映的关于法国抵抗运动领袖让·穆兰 (Jean Moulin) 生命最后日子的《红磨坊》(Moulin)。

paras.en: But rather than tackling well-known heroes or monsters, Notre Salut focuses instead on the role of ordinary people in the Vichy regime that, under Marshal Philippe Pétain, collaborated in the deportation of 76,000 Jewish people to Nazi concentration camps.
paras.zh: 但《Notre Salut》并没有讲述众所周知的英雄或怪物，而是关注维希政权中普通民众的角色，维希政权在菲利普·贝当元帅的领导下，参与将 76,000 名犹太人驱逐到纳粹集中营。

paras.en: The film was inspired by a stash of family letters found by its writer and director, Emmanuel Marre, that gave insight into the life of his great-grandfather Henri Marre, who worked as an administrator under the authoritarian puppet regime.
paras.zh: 这部电影的灵感来自于编剧兼导演伊曼纽尔·马尔 (Emmanuel Marre) 发现的一堆家庭信件，这些信件让我们深入了解了他的曾祖父亨利·马尔 (Henri Marre) 的生活，亨利·马尔曾在独裁傀儡政权下担任行政官员。

paras.en: “There are great figures who make history, but history is also made by the second-players, the grassroots who act on the ground, and that is what is interesting about this film,” said Marc Olivier Baruch, a historian and specialist on state administrators in the Vichy regime.
paras.zh: “有创造历史的伟大人物，但历史也是由二线人物、基层行动者创造的，这就是这部电影的有趣之处，”历史学家、维希政权国家行政人员专家马克·奥利维尔·巴鲁克(Marc Olivier Baruch)说。

paras.en: For Baruch, the most chilling scene in the film is the bureaucratic nitpicking about the costs incurred by providing Jews on cattle trucks with straw and chamber pots. The central character in the film, the administrator Henri Marre, “never chooses to reflect on things or look at what he’s doing, to wonder what his room for manoeuvre is”.
paras.zh: 对于巴鲁克来说，影片中最令人毛骨悚然的场景是官僚机构对为运牛车上的犹太人提供稻草和夜壶所产生的费用的挑剔。影片的中心人物亨利·马尔（Henri Marre）“从不选择反思事物或审视自己在做什么，想知道他的回旋余地是什么”。

paras.en: Baruch said the film’s sense of unease was a pull for modern of audiences because today France was “in a time of great uncertainty … There’s a strong lack of confidence among French people in their elites and in their state and that has been going on for a long time.”
paras.zh: 巴鲁克表示，这部电影的不安感对现代观众来说很有吸引力，因为今天的法国“正处于一个充满不确定性的时代……法国人民对他们的精英和国家严重缺乏信心，而且这种情况已经持续了很长时间。”

paras.en: He said the Vichy regime had resonance today as a period in history. “The Pétain dictatorship is the only moment when the far right was in power since 1820. There were these four years at the heart of the 20th century when the far right was in power and clearly for French people in 2026 and 2027 that is interesting … There has been a certain unease in modern France that it would be better to stop talking about Vichy, to draw a line under it, stop the masochism [of looking back]. That of course is stupid, and not possible.”
paras.zh: 他说维希政权作为一个历史时期在今天引起了共鸣。 “贝当独裁统治是自 1820 年以来极右翼掌权的唯一时刻。在 20 世纪的中心这四年，极右翼掌权，对于 2026 年和 2027 年的法国人来说显然很有趣……现代法国存在某种不安，认为最好停止谈论维希，与其划清界限，停止[回顾]受虐狂。那当然是愚蠢的，不可能的。”

paras.en: Film critics suggested modern audiences were seeking to better understand the rise of the far right across Europe and in France.
paras.zh: 影评人表示，现代观众正在寻求更好地了解欧洲和法国极右翼的崛起。

paras.en: Henry Rousso, a historian who has studied the place of the Vichy regime in collective memory, wrote of the film in Le Monde: “The RN is not the fascism of the 1930s, nor a resurgence of the Pétain regime, but knowing this history allows an understanding of what [the RN] is the heir to, and how the mechanisms of gradually renouncing democratic and republican values led to disaster.”
paras.zh: 研究维希政权在集体记忆中的地位的历史学家亨利·鲁索（Henry Rousso）在《世界报》上这样评价这部电影：“RN 不是 1930 年代的法西斯主义，也不是贝当政权的复兴，但了解这段历史可以让我们了解 [RN] 的继承人是什么，以及逐渐放弃民主和共和价值观的机制如何导致灾难。”

paras.en: Emmanuel Marre, the film’s writer-director, who won the best Screenplay prize at the Cannes film festival, began working on the story more than a decade ago after the discovery of the letters from his great-grandfather that his family had kept in a drawer.
paras.zh: 该片的编剧兼导演伊曼纽尔·马尔 (Emmanuel Marre) 获得了戛纳电影节最佳编剧奖，十多年前，他发现家人放在抽屉里的曾祖父的信件后，就开始创作这个故事。

paras.en: He told France Inter radio: “There are [similar] drawers everywhere in France … there is a phantom memory of the collaboration. With this film, we wanted to prise open those drawers and allow all families to look at that – not as flagellation, [but] because after the war France pushed a lot of it under the carpet to survive.”
paras.zh: 他告诉法国国际广播电台：“法国到处都有（类似的）抽屉……我们对这次合作有一种幻影记忆。通过这部电影，我们想撬开这些抽屉，让所有家庭都能看到它——不是鞭打，而是因为战后法国为了生存而将很多东西隐藏起来。”

paras.en: He said it was crucial to look at the nuance of what led people to collaborate or take a stand. “In between resistance and in collaboration, there is a whole range of human emotions, even the most ambiguous.”
paras.zh: 他表示，重要的是要了解促使人们合作或表明立场的细微差别。 “在抵抗和合作之间，存在着各种各样的人类情感，甚至是最模糊的情感。”

articles.title: Half want to rejoin EU and backing it could drive up Labour vote, megapoll finds
articles.author: Pippa Crerar and Rowena Mason

paras.en: Andy Burnham’s personal preference to rejoin the European Union after the next election is supported by almost half of all voters, a new megapoll has found, although cabinet ministers concerned about reopening Brexit divides are privately urging him to proceed with caution.
paras.zh: 一项新的大型民意调查发现，安迪·伯纳姆个人倾向于在下一次选举后重新加入欧盟，这一倾向得到了近一半选民的支持，尽管担心重新引发脱欧分歧的内阁部长们私下敦促他谨慎行事。

paras.en: The poll by the Messina Group (TMG) found that renegotiating the UK’s relationship with the EU could boost Labour’s vote share by as much as seven points, if the prime minister offered a fresh referendum in which he campaigned to re-enter the bloc.
paras.zh: 墨西拿集团 (TMG) 的民意调查发现，如果首相提出重新举行公投以重新加入欧盟，那么重新谈判英国与欧盟的关系可能会使工党的得票率提高多达 7 个百分点。

paras.en: Almost a third of voters said an in-out referendum would be needed first, while more than one in six felt that a general election mandate would be sufficient, and the same proportion thought parliament could make the decision.
paras.zh: 近三分之一的选民表示，首先需要进行公投，而超过六分之一的选民认为大选授权就足够了，同样比例的选民认为议会可以做出决定。

paras.en: The overall findings will bolster the case of those inside Downing Street who want to promise at the next election that Labour would at least negotiate over re-entry, which the prime minister has said he wants to see “in his lifetime”.
paras.zh: 总体调查结果将支持唐宁街内部人士的观点，他们希望在下一次选举中承诺工党至少会就重新入职问题进行谈判，首相表示他希望“在他有生之年”看到这一点。

paras.en: Burnham used his first Labour conference speech as leader on Tuesday to announce a review of the options for Britain’s future relationship with Europe, and subsequently added that these should include rejoining entirely.
paras.zh: 周二，伯纳姆以工党领袖身份首次在工党会议上发表讲话，宣布对英国与欧洲未来关系的选择进行审查，并随后补充说，这些选择应包括完全重新加入。

paras.en: However, there are nerves among some Labour MPs, especially those with constituencies that voted for Brexit, that even testing out public support for the move would be fraught with political risk and a potential boost to Reform.
paras.zh: 然而，一些工党议员，尤其是那些投票支持脱欧的选区的工党议员感到紧张，他们认为即使测试公众对此举的支持也将充满政治风险，并可能推动改革。

paras.en: Two-thirds of cabinet ministers, including Burnham himself, his first secretary, Louise Haigh, chancellor, John Healey, and foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, represent seats that backed Brexit, and previously said they would respect the 2016 vote. However, public opinion has shifted.
paras.zh: 三分之二的内阁部长，包括伯纳姆本人、他的第一秘书路易丝·黑格、财政大臣约翰·希利和外交大臣埃德·米利班德，都代表了支持英国脱欧的席位，此前他们曾表示将尊重 2016 年的投票。然而，公众舆论已经发生转变。

paras.en: Before Burnham’s speech, several ministers had publicly cautioned against the move. Lucy Powell, Labour’s deputy leader, said while the defence and security relationship could be better, going beyond EU reset plans inherited from Keir Starmer was “not possible nor desirable”.
paras.zh: 在伯纳姆发表讲话之前，几位部长公开警告不要采取这一行动。工党副领袖露西·鲍威尔表示，虽然国防和安全关系可能会更好，但超越基尔·斯塔默继承的欧盟重置计划“不可能也不可取”。

paras.en: The trade secretary, Jonathan Reynolds, said “constitutional questions” around Britain’s EU relationship were causing uncertainty for business. The home secretary, Shabana Mahmood, said rejoining was “not a simple, straightforward thing” and the costs might be unacceptable.
paras.zh: 英国贸易大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹表示，围绕英国与欧盟关系的“宪法问题”正在给企业带来不确定性。内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德表示，重新加入“不是一件简单直接的事情”，而且成本可能令人无法接受。

paras.en: Downing Street’s strategy appears to be to put the focus on those who made big promises on Brexit but then failed to deliver, rather than accusing those who voted to leave the EU of making the wrong decision. But the government’s shift in position has caused some anxiety among Burnham’s team.
paras.zh: 唐宁街的策略似乎是将焦点放在那些对英国脱欧做出重大承诺但最终未能兑现的人身上，而不是指责那些投票脱欧的人做出了错误的决定。但政府立场的转变引起了伯纳姆团队的一些焦虑。

paras.en: One cabinet minister told the Guardian: “Brexit clearly hasn’t worked and the promises made haven’t been kept so Andy is right to open up the question of what the future relationship looks like. But he definitely needs to proceed with caution because we don’t want to restoke division”.
paras.zh: 一位内阁部长告诉《卫报》：“英国脱欧显然没有奏效，做出的承诺也没有兑现，所以安迪提出未来关系是什么样子的问题是正确的。但他绝对需要谨慎行事，因为我们不想重新引发分裂”。

paras.en: A second said: “Andy is right to say we need some clarity around our long-term relationship. Security and trade cooperation are higher up the agenda than they were 10 years ago. But whether that adds up to a real desire for big change in the population I don’t know. My constituents will be cautious.”
paras.zh: 另一位人士表示：“安迪的说法是正确的，我们需要明确我们的长期关系。与十年前相比，安全和贸易合作在议程上更加重要。但我不知道这是否会真正推动人口发生巨大变化。我的选民会持谨慎态度。”

paras.en: A third added: “There are obviously different views across cabinet about it, but the Made in Europe agenda means we do need to talk to the EU about what relationship they want with us long term, as what they are currently proposing is very challenging.”
paras.zh: 第三位补充道：“内阁对此显然有不同的看法，但欧洲制造议程意味着我们确实需要与欧盟讨论他们希望与我们建立什么样的长期关系，因为他们目前提出的建议非常具有挑战性。”

paras.en: Another cabinet source said: “There’s an awareness among a number of cabinet ministers with leave voting seats that opinions are going to differ and the arguments about the future will have to be carefully made about the national interest.”
paras.zh: 另一位内阁消息人士表示：“一些拥有投票席位的内阁部长意识到，意见将会有所不同，关于未来的争论必须谨慎考虑国家利益。”

paras.en: A fifth said there were genuine questions about the best option on the table. “I’m sceptical if we go back in, about the terms we’d be going back in on, and whether that can really resolve the problems in people’s lives. But if you look at the global context you cannot start to solve things for people without having a closer relationship with the EU.”
paras.zh: 五分之一的人表示，对于桌面上的最佳选择存在真正的疑问。 “我对我们是否重返欧盟、我们将遵守的条款以及这是否能真正解决人们生活中的问题持怀疑态度。但如果你看看全球背景，如果不与欧盟建立更密切的关系，你就无法开始为人们解决问题。”

paras.en: TMG polled 11,461 people, weighted by referendum result, from 12-24 September on seven different options for relationships with the EU. The most popular was rejoin, with 49% in favour and 28.5% against.
paras.zh: TMG 于 9 月 12 日至 24 日对 11,461 人进行了民意调查，并根据公投结果加权，就与欧盟关系的七种不同选择进行了调查。最受欢迎的是“重新加入”，49%的人支持，28.5%的人反对。

paras.en: The second was to keep the existing relationship but cut as many trade barriers as possible – as the government is attempting to do with its reset – and which was supported by 48.2%, with 20.9% against. A customs union came next, on 47.1% versus 20.7%.
paras.zh: 第二个是保持现有关系，但尽可能减少贸易壁垒 — — 正如政府正在尝试重置的那样 — — 该建议得到了 48.2% 的支持，20.9% 的反对。其次是关税同盟，分别为 47.1% 和 20.7%。

paras.en: Joining the single market and associate membership were virtually neck and neck – 45.1% and 45.5% of respondents respectively support them – while sticking with the existing relationship was backed by 42%. The seventh option – the UK moving further away from the EU – was supported by only 27.9%, with 41.2% against.
paras.zh: 加入单一市场和准会员几乎不相上下——分别有 45.1% 和 45.5% 的受访者支持——而坚持现有关系则有 42% 的人支持。第七个选项——英国进一步远离欧盟——仅得到 27.9% 的支持，41.2% 的反对。

paras.en: A plurality of voters – 25.9% – said they wanted the UK to rejoin the EU immediately, while a slightly lower proportion – 22.9% – said it should happen in the next three years, and 8.4% over the next decade, while 23% said they did not want a closer relationship at all.
paras.zh: 多数选民（25.9%）表示他们希望英国立即重新加入欧盟，而略低的比例（22.9%）表示这应该在未来三年内实现，8.4%的选民表示在未来十年内实现，而23%的选民表示他们根本不希望建立更密切的关系。

paras.en: TMG also tested political messaging for each of the options to see how they could affect Labour’s vote share in an election, and found that it went up – by between 4.3 and 7.4 percentage points – for all the scenarios that resulted in closer ties, with most votes coming from the Greens and Lib Dems.
paras.zh: TMG 还测试了每种选项的政治信息，以了解它们如何影响工党在选举中的选票份额，结果发现，在所有导致更紧密联系的方案中，选票份额都上升了 4.3 至 7.4 个百分点，其中大多数选票来自绿党和自由民主党。

paras.en: The polling showed that more than two-thirds of voters thought that trading with the EU was more important than the US or China, in the event the UK had to choose; four in five people want to keep the pound; and a majority want to stay in the ECHR – 53.4% versus 24.2% against.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，超过三分之二的选民认为，如果英国必须做出选择，与欧盟的贸易比美国或中国更重要；五分之四的人希望保留英镑；大多数人希望留在欧洲人权法院——53.4% 的人反对，24.2% 的人反对。

paras.en: However, it also found that Brexit arguments over immigration control and sovereignty still resonated.
paras.zh: 然而，它还发现，英国脱欧有关移民控制和主权的争论仍然引起共鸣。

paras.en: Senior Downing Street officials have been in contact with thinktanks and pollsters as they look to test public support for the UK rejoining the EU. The TMG research is expected to be shared with the current operation.
paras.zh: 唐宁街高级官员一直在与智囊团和民意调查机构保持联系，以测试公众对英国重新加入欧盟的支持程度。 TMG 的研究预计将与当前的运营共享。

paras.en: Some inside No 10 are nervous, however, that promising to renegotiate entry into the bloc could revive the flagging political fortunes of Nigel Farage, who said on Thursday Burnham had given him “the biggest boost in my career” by reviving the Brexit debate.
paras.zh: 然而，10号内部的一些人感到紧张，因为承诺重新谈判加入欧盟可能会重振奈杰尔·法拉奇(Nigel Farage)萎靡不振的政治命运，法拉奇周四表示，伯纳姆通过重启英国退欧辩论给了他“我职业生涯中最大的推动”。

paras.en: The TMG research found that 29.7% people thought the UK had been right to leave the EU, while 52.4% said it had been wrong, and 17.9% didn’t know. On whether it had been a success or failure, 12.2% said a success, 54.9% a failure, 23.2% said neither and 9.7% did not know.
paras.zh: TMG的研究发现，29.7%的人认为英国脱欧是正确的，52.4%的人认为英国脱欧是错误的，17.9%的人不知道。对于成功还是失败，12.2%的人表示成功，54.9%的人表示失败，23.2%的人表示都不成功，9.7%的人表示不知道。

paras.en: Ben Judah, a visiting fellow at Chatham House who was an adviser to David Lammy as foreign secretary, told the Guardian: “These polls are a massive validation of Andy Burnham’s boldness on Europe. There is close to a national consensus that Brexit was not a success.
paras.zh: 查塔姆研究所客座研究员、担任​​外交大臣大卫·拉米的顾问本·犹达告诉《卫报》：“这些民意调查是对安迪·伯纳姆对欧洲大胆态度的大规模验证。几乎全国都一致认为英国脱欧并不成功。

paras.en: “Against this background these results show that Europe as an issue has a unique ability to unite the left and grow the Labour vote share among swing voters. The bolder the stance towards rejoin, the bigger Labour’s reward.”
paras.zh: “在此背景下，这些结果表明，欧洲作为一个问题具有独特的能力来团结左翼并增加摇摆选民中工党的投票比例。重新加入的立场越大胆，工党的回报就越大。”

articles.title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

paras.en: "I witness men hitting women all the time," says Kgomotso Mathekga, 30. "Especially when they are both drunk."
paras.zh: “我经常看到男人打女人，”30 岁的 Kgomotso Mathekga 说，“尤其是当他们都喝醉了的时候。”

paras.en: "I once had an argument with my girlfriend," he admits, "and I grabbed and slapped her."
paras.zh: “我曾经和女朋友吵架，”他承认，“我抓住她，打了她一巴掌。”

paras.en: Mathekga is speaking frankly during a gathering of men aimed at helping reduce the high levels of violence against women in South Africa.
paras.zh: 马泰克加在一次旨在帮助减少南非针对妇女的暴力行为的男性聚会上坦率地说。

paras.en: The meeting is held in a narrow street in a Johannesburg informal settlement known as Organic Market. It is a maze of corrugated metal shacks and unpaved roads, close to Alexandra township.
paras.zh: 会议在约翰内斯堡一个名为“有机市场”的非正式定居点的一条狭窄街道上举行。这是一个由波纹金属棚屋和未铺砌的道路组成的迷宫，靠近亚历山德拉镇。

paras.en: "Now I feel pain," Mathekga continues. "We broke up and I no longer see my child. I feel like I've contributed to the problems in South Africa, instead of being the gentleman that I know I am."
paras.zh: “现在我感到疼痛，”马泰加继续说道。 “我们分手了，我再也见不到我的孩子了。我觉得我对南非的问题负有责任，而不是像我所认识的那样是个绅士。”

paras.en: At a nearby tavern, a group of men have pulled their chairs into a circle in the dust.
paras.zh: 在附近的一家小酒馆里，一群男人把椅子在灰尘中围成一圈。

paras.en: At the centre stands Itumeleng Stephen Tamaga, known locally as Bra Steve.
paras.zh: 中心矗立着 Itumeleng Stephen Tamaga，当地人称为 Bra Steve。

paras.en: The group clap and cheers. Some sip bottled beer.
paras.zh: 小组鼓掌欢呼。有些人喝瓶装啤酒。

paras.en: "Listen guys," Bra Steve says. "We must stand together to fight against gender-based violence and femicide."
paras.zh: “听着，伙计们，”布拉史蒂夫说。 “我们必须团结起来，打击基于性别的暴力和杀害女性行为。”

paras.en: Bra Steve is the local organiser of Father A Nation, a non-profit that works with men and boys to promote positive masculinity and help end violence against women.
paras.zh: 布拉·史蒂夫 (Bra Steve) 是 Father A Nation 的当地组织者，这是一个非营利组织，致力于与男性和男孩合作，促进积极的男子气概并帮助结束针对女性的暴力行为。

paras.en: The group's meeting comes as South Africa grapples with renewed anger over renewed cases of femicide and violence against women.
paras.zh: 该组织召开会议之际，南非正努力应对新发生的杀害女性和暴力侵害妇女案件的愤怒情绪。

paras.en: The discovery of the bodies of 12 women over three months, in the city of Ekurhuleni, near Johannesburg has reignited questions about the scale of what many people see as being a crisis of violence against women.
paras.zh: 三个月内，约翰内斯堡附近的艾库莱尼市发现了 12 具女性尸体，这再次引发了人们对暴力侵害妇女危机规模的质疑。

paras.en: South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has acknowledged that his government has not done enough and announced measures he hopes can make women feel safer.
paras.zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨承认，他的政府做得还不够，并宣布了他希望能让女性感到更安全的措施。

paras.en: The country has one of the highest murder rates in the world, with 5,427 people murdered between April and June this year alone.
paras.zh: 该国是世界上谋杀率最高的国家之一，仅今年 4 月至 6 月就有 5,427 人被谋杀。

paras.en: In that period, according to the South African Human Rights Commission, 569 women were killed, an average of six a day, and 1,052 others survived attempted murder.
paras.zh: 据南非人权委员会称，在此期间，有 569 名妇女被杀，平均每天有 6 名妇女被杀，另有 1,052 名妇女在未遂谋杀中幸存。

paras.en: A report in 2022 by the Human Sciences Research Council found that more than 35% of South African women experienced physical or sexual violence, many from their own intimate partners.
paras.zh: 人类科学研究委员会 2022 年的一份报告发现，超过 35% 的南非女性遭受过身体暴力或性暴力，其中许多来自她们自己的亲密伴侣。

paras.en: For Bra Steve, part of the solution to the crisis is helping men to understand the issue and take responsibility for their actions.
paras.zh: 对于布拉·史蒂夫（Bra Steve）来说，解决危机的部分方法是帮助男性了解问题并为自己的行为负责。

paras.en: "We are a lost generation," he says. "We must restore dignity to the men around here."
paras.zh: “我们是迷失的一代，”他说。 “我们必须恢复这里的人们的尊严。”

paras.en: Amongst the group of men outside the tavern is Zizipho Mtwesi, the project co-ordinator of Father A Nation.
paras.zh: 酒馆外的一群人中有 Zizipho Mtwesi，他是“国家之父”的项目协调员。

paras.en: Reflecting on recent weeks, he says more should be done.
paras.zh: 回顾最近几周，他说应该做更多的事情。

paras.en: The latest measures announced by Ramaphosa, including better street lighting and a review of unsolved cases, are too little, he says, and too late.
paras.zh: 拉马福萨宣布的最新措施，包括改善街道照明和审查未解决的案件，他说，力度太小，也太晚了。

paras.en: "When I think about all of these recent murders in Johannesburg, I get angry. Why do we have to wait for this to happen for us to act?"
paras.zh: “当我想到约翰内斯堡最近发生的所有这些谋杀案时，我很生气。为什么我们必须等到这件事发生才能采取行动？”

paras.en: He looks around and gestures at the meeting. "We are trying to reach men before things like these murders happen again."
paras.zh: 他环顾四周，对会议做出了手势。 “我们正努力在此类谋杀案再次发生之前联系到人们。”

paras.en: Craig Wilkinson is the founder of the group. "We get men to talk, to process their feelings," he explains.
paras.zh: 克雷格·威尔金森是该集团的创始人。 “我们让男人说话，处理他们的感受，”他解释道。

paras.en: "And as they do, this healing takes place. And the second phase is teaching and training positive masculinity.
paras.zh: “当他们这样做时，这种治愈就会发生。第二阶段是教导和训练积极的男子气概。

paras.en: "We ultimately hope that this will eliminate the scourge of gender-based violence."
paras.zh: “我们最终希望这将消除性别暴力的祸害。”

paras.en: He stands up, moving into the centre of the group, calling out to the men.
paras.zh: 他站起来，走到人群中央，向那些人喊道。

paras.en: "You as a man are a powerful force for good," he tells them. "You choose what kind of man you want to be. Women need to be safe."
paras.zh: “作为一个男人，你是一股强大的善良力量，”他告诉他们。 “你可以选择自己想成为什么样的男人。女人需要安全。”

paras.en: Father A Nation operates across South Africa, teaching healthy masculinity and running training programmes across dozens of schools and colleges.
paras.zh: Father A Nation 在南非各地开展业务，在数十所学校和学院教授健康的男子气概并开展培训项目。

paras.en: Mystery surrounds the spate of murders which has sparked South Africa's latest moment of soul-searching about the safety of its women.
paras.zh: 一系列谋杀案充满谜团，这引发了南非对其妇女安全的最新反省。

paras.en: Police have not ruled out potential links between some of the Ekurhuleni deaths but have not said they are investigating a serial killer. Suspects in some of the cases have appeared in court.
paras.zh: 警方尚未排除埃库胡莱尼死亡事件之间的潜在联系，但并未表示他们正在调查一名连环杀手。部分案件的嫌疑人已出庭。

paras.en: But the spate of deaths has sparked new concerns and in Organic Market some women are more fearful than ever.
paras.zh: 但大量的死亡引发了新的担忧，在有机市场，一些女性比以往任何时候都更加恐惧。

paras.en: Outside a nearby shack Linkie listens with interest as she cleans clothes in a large metal bucket.
paras.zh: 在附近的一个小屋外，林基饶有兴趣地听着她在一个大金属桶里清洗衣服。

paras.en: "We are not safe when we are outside our place," she says.
paras.zh: “当我们离开自己的住处时，我们并不安全，”她说。

paras.en: "We are afraid when we see a car behind us when we walk. We feel afraid. We feel scared. What if this guy's going to kidnap me or do something to me?"
paras.zh: “当我们走路时看到身后有车时，我们会感到害怕。我们感到害怕。我们感到害怕。如果这个人要绑架我或对我做什么怎么办？”

paras.en: It is a feeling shared by many women here. In the local hair salon, sporting a mane of thick pink braids, is Providence Maseko.
paras.zh: 这是这里许多女性的共同感受。在当地的美发沙龙里，普罗维登斯·马塞科（Providence Maseko）留着一头浓密的粉红色辫子。

paras.en: She comes to the door to speak to Bra Steve.
paras.zh: 她走到门口跟史蒂夫布拉说话。

paras.en: "Safety here is very bad," she says, "Maybe you are the serial killer. How do I know who to trust?"
paras.zh: “这里的安全非常糟糕，”她说，“也许你就是连环杀手。我怎么知道该相信谁呢？”

paras.en: Bra Steve laughs. "We must talk about these things," he urges. "Come to our meetings and we can learn to trust each other."
paras.zh: 布拉史蒂夫笑了。 “我们必须谈论这些事情，”他敦促道。 “参加我们的会议，我们可以学会互相信任。”

paras.en: Maseko tells me that she now takes an e-hailing taxi everywhere in the hope that it is safer.
paras.zh: 马塞科告诉我，她现在到处都乘坐电召车，希望这样更安全。

paras.en: Back at the tavern, the men's meeting is wrapping up.
paras.zh: 回到酒馆，男人们的会议即将结束。

paras.en: "As we try to stop gender-based violence," says Zizipho, "each and every man needs to know that they need to play a part in this.
paras.zh: “当我们试图制止基于性别的暴力时，”齐齐弗说，“每个男人都需要知道他们需要在其中发挥作用。

paras.en: "And if they wouldn't allow these things to happen to their own daughters or own mothers, they mustn't allow it to be done to someone else's daughter, which is their wives or their girlfriends."
paras.zh: “如果他们不允许这些事情发生在自己的女儿或自己的母亲身上，他们也不能允许这种事情发生在别人的女儿身上，也就是他们的妻子或女朋友身上。”

paras.en: Mathekga is impressed with what he has heard.
paras.zh: 马泰加对他所听到的内容印象深刻。

paras.en: "I would love them to keep on practising what we have learned, because we no longer have role models," he says. "Our fathers and our uncles, they are there in prison. We must now become role models and help make this country better."
paras.zh: “我希望他们继续实践我们所学到的知识，因为我们不再有榜样，”他说。 “我们的父亲和叔叔都在监狱里。我们现在必须成为榜样，帮助这个国家变得更好。”

articles.title: Cornell frat house rape accuser 'under siege' online, says lawyer

paras.en: The lawyer for the woman who alleges she was raped at a Cornell University fraternity house says she is "not doing well" as she finds herself "under siege" from online sleuths seeking to identity her.
paras.zh: 这名女子声称自己在康奈尔大学兄弟会所被强奸，她的律师表示，她“表现不佳”，因为她发现自己受到了试图识别她身份的在线侦探的“围攻”。

paras.en: Thomas Giuffra said the woman known in legal documents as Jane Doe was "incapable of consent" because she was "completely, grossly intoxicated" when she turned up at the home where she says the assault took place.
paras.zh: 托马斯·朱弗拉(Thomas Giuffra)表示，法律文件中被称为“无名氏”(Jane Doe)的女子“无法同意”，因为当她出现在她所说的袭击发生的家中时，她“完全、严重陶醉”。

paras.en: The woman alleges she was assaulted by seven men at the campus in Ithaca, New York, in 2024.
paras.zh: 该女子声称，2024 年，她在纽约伊萨卡校园遭到七名男子的袭击。

paras.en: No charges were initially filed in the case. It has reopened since she filed a civil lawsuit that thrust the claims into the national spotlight, reigniting the possibility of criminal charges.
paras.zh: 此案最初没有提出任何指控。自从她提起民事诉讼，使这些指控成为全国关注的焦点，重新引发刑事指控的可能性以来，该案件已重新开放。

paras.en: In an interview on Friday with CNN, Giuffra said: "She's under siege on social media where people are trying to identify her."
paras.zh: 朱夫拉周五接受美国有线电视新闻网采访时说：“她在社交媒体上受到围攻，人们试图识别她的身份。”

paras.en: He said that postings have "incorrectly" identified other woman as Doe.
paras.zh: 他说，帖子“错误地”将另一名女性识别为“Doe”。

paras.en: In an interview with CBS, the BBC's US partner, Giuffra argued that his client, aged 20 at the time, was unable to provide consent because she was intoxicated when she arrived at the fraternity house.
paras.zh: BBC美国合伙人朱夫拉在接受哥伦比亚广播公司采访时辩称，他当时20岁的当事人无法表示同意，因为她到达兄弟会时喝醉了。

paras.en: Giuffra said she had been pressured into taking the drug ketamine before she was allegedly raped.
paras.zh: 朱弗拉说，在据称遭到强奸之前，她被迫服用氯胺酮。

paras.en: His comments came as New York Governor Kathy Hochul appointed the state's top prosecutor, Attorney General Letitia James, to take over the investigation.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之际，纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔任命该州最高检察官、司法部长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯接手调查。

paras.en: At a news conference on Friday, Hochul said she had "lost faith" in the county prosecutor's ability to oversee the case.
paras.zh: 在周五的新闻发布会上，霍楚尔表示，她对县检察官监督此案的能力“失去了信心”。

paras.en: "This young woman had already endured something that is utterly unspeakable, and then at every turn she was failed by people and institutions with an obligation to protect her," Hochul said.
paras.zh: 霍赫尔说：“这位年轻女子已经经历了一些完全无法形容的事情，然后每一次都有义务保护她的人和机构都辜负了她。”

paras.en: She also vowed to close a "loophole" of state law that makes it difficult to press rape charges if an alleged victim voluntarily consumes alcohol or drugs.
paras.zh: 她还发誓要堵住州法律的一个“漏洞”，如果据称的受害者自愿饮酒或吸毒，就很难提出强奸指控。

paras.en: During an interview with investigators, Doe told campus police investigators: "I was a sex doll for all intents and purposes, which is sad but, unfortunately, something I'm not used to, or something that I haven't experienced before."
paras.zh: 在接受调查人员采访时，多伊告诉校园警察调查人员：“无论出于何种意图和目的，我都是一个性玩偶，这很悲伤，但不幸的是，这是我不习惯的事情，或者是我以前从未经历过的事情。”

paras.en: She also said that she "felt like bait" as the attackers were "like lions around me", according to records from the school's disciplinary investigation, obtained by US media.
paras.zh: 根据美国媒体获得的学校纪律调查记录，她还表示，她“感觉就像是诱饵”，因为袭击者“就像我周围的狮子”。

paras.en: Social media feeds are filled with women trying to shield the Cornell accuser's identity by posting videos of themselves under the title "I am Jane Doe".
paras.zh: 社交媒体上充斥着试图通过以“我是无名氏”为标题发布自己视频来保护康奈尔大学原告身份的女性。

paras.en: As well as seeking to complicate internet searches for her name, the messages of solidarity included clips of women detailing their own experiences of sexual assault.
paras.zh: 除了试图让互联网上对她名字的搜索变得复杂之外，这些声援信息还包括一些女性详细讲述自己遭受性侵犯经历的视频。

paras.en: Efforts to rally round Jane Doe gathered pace after a political commentator vowed to unmask her, arguing it was unfair for her to remain anonymous while the men are publicly named despite not being charged with a crime.
paras.zh: 在一名政治评论员发誓要揭开无名氏的面纱后，支持无名氏的努力加快了步伐，他认为，当这些人尽管没有被指控犯罪，但仍被公开点名时，她保持匿名是不公平的。

paras.en: Online sleuths have also tried to locate the addresses of the so-called Cornell Seven, leading to at least one case of mistaken identity.
paras.zh: 在线侦探还试图找到所谓的康奈尔七人组的地址，导致至少一起身份错误的案件。

paras.en: An active-duty US Marine Corps sergeant who had the same name as one of the men was incorrectly served the woman's lawsuit, leading to a torrent of abuse and threats, according to the Free Press, external.
paras.zh: 据外部自由新闻报道，一名与其中一名男子同名的现役美国海军陆战队中士被错误地送达了该女子的诉讼，导致了一系列辱骂和威胁。

articles.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat

paras.en: The G7 has announced 100 million barrels of oil and diesel will be released to ease supply concerns that have caused prices to skyrocket.
paras.zh: G7已宣布将释放1亿桶石油和柴油，以缓解导致价格飙升的供应担忧。

paras.en: It includes a "substantial release" of diesel within 20 days, with discussions around "additional diesel releases as necessary", G7 leaders said in a statement.
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人在一份声明中表示，其中包括在 20 天内“大量释放”柴油，并围绕“必要时释放更多柴油”进行讨论。

paras.en: The group of advanced economies, including the US, said the move would begin immediately and would last for four months.
paras.zh: 包括美国在内的发达经济体表示，此举将立即开始，并将持续四个月。

paras.en: Under the measures, which come after US President Donald Trump had threatened to ban diesel exports, there will not be any "export restrictions on energy and energy products" between G7 members.
paras.zh: 根据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁禁止柴油出口之后出台的措施，七国集团成员之间不会有任何“能源和能源产品的出口限制”。

paras.en: The G7 includes the US, UK, Canada, Japan, Germany, Italy and France, with the EU also represented at its meetings.
paras.zh: 七国集团包括美国、英国、加拿大、日本、德国、意大利和法国，欧盟也派代表出席其会议。

paras.en: Donald Trump had warned he would ban diesel exports from the US if European countries did not agree to put more of their own stocks onto the market. That would have eased pressure on prices for US consumers ahead of November's midterm elections, but pushed up prices elsewhere.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普曾警告称，如果欧洲国家不同意将更多自己的库存投放市场，他将禁止美国柴油出口。这本来可以在 11 月中期选举之前缓解美国消费者的价格压力，但会推高其他地方的价格。

paras.en: On Friday, he said on social media: "Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil. The process will begin immediately."
paras.zh: 周五，他在社交媒体上表示：“欧洲刚刚同意释放大量库存的柴油。这一过程将立即开始。”

paras.en: His Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had argued US farmers, truckers, and businesses "should not be left carrying the burden" as prices soar.
paras.zh: 他的财政部长斯科特·贝森特曾表示，随着物价飞涨，美国农民、卡车司机和企业“不应该承受负担”。

paras.en: Speaking later at the White House, Trump said an export ban on diesel was "never really on the table".
paras.zh: 特朗普后来在白宫发表讲话时表示，柴油出口禁令“从未真正提上台面”。

paras.en: Referring to the decision by the G7 to release fuel from reserves, he added that "what Europe did was a great thing."
paras.zh: 在谈到七国集团从储备中释放燃料的决定时，他补充说，“欧洲所做的是一件伟大的事情。”

paras.en: "Europe has a lot of diesel and they're going to be making a major world contribution - and so are we," he said.
paras.zh: “欧洲拥有大量柴油，他们将为世界做出重大贡献 - 我们也是如此，”他说。

paras.en: "And we're not going to be doing the export ban, we're going to be doing what we're supposed to do."
paras.zh: “我们不会实施出口禁令，我们会做我们应该做的事情。”

paras.en: Trump had first said he backed a diesel export ban early last week, and was still considering it on Thursday, as his administration put pressure on Europe to tap its supplies.
paras.zh: 特朗普上周早些时候首次表示，他支持柴油出口禁令，周四仍在考虑这一禁令，因为他的政府向欧洲施压，要求其利用其供应。

paras.en: Diesel is used heavily by the haulage industry and in agriculture, meaning rises in the cost of the fuel feed through into essentials such as food.
paras.zh: 运输业和农业大量使用柴油，这意味着食品等必需品的燃料成本上升。

paras.en: Following a meeting of G7 leaders, French President Emmanuel Macron said the bloc had agreed to release reserves of "up to 100 million barrels" within four months under the co-ordination of the International Energy Agency (IEA).
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人会议后，法国总统马克龙表示，该集团已同意在国际能源署（IEA）的协调下，在四个月内释放“最多 1 亿桶”的储备。

paras.en: The UK was represented at the meeting by Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, who said the measures would "stabilise energy supplies, build resilience in supply chains and shield households and businesses from price shocks".
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德代表英国出席了会议，他表示这些措施将“稳定能源供应，增强供应链的弹性，并保护家庭和企业免受价格冲击”。

paras.en: Macron said the co-ordinated action would "bring down the prices of petroleum products, particularly diesel". Highlighting the agreement not to pursue export bans, Macron said "President Trump, in particular, was very clear on this point".
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，协调行动将“降低石油产品，特别是柴油的价格”。马克龙强调不实行出口禁令的协议，表示“尤其是特朗普总统在这一点上非常明确”。

paras.en: In the joint statement, G7 leaders said: "We will implement our commitments with a co-ordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels to begin immediately over four months, including a frontloaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners."
paras.zh: G7领导人在联合声明中表示：“我们将履行我们的承诺，在四个月内立即开始通过IEA协调释放1亿桶石油，其中包括G7成员和合作伙伴在头20天内预先释放大量柴油。”

paras.en: It is not yet clear which partner countries will release stocks, nor how quickly.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚哪些伙伴国家将释放库存，也不清楚释放的速度。

paras.en: The 100 million barrels will comprise a mix of diesel and crude oil. The price of global benchmark Brent crude oil briefly dropped below $100 a barrel, but rose back to around $102 by Friday evening. Before the US and Israel invaded Iran, it was trading at around $73.
paras.zh: 这 1 亿桶将包括柴油和原油的混合物。全球基准布伦特原油价格短暂跌破每桶 100 美元，但到周五晚间回升至 102 美元左右。在美国和以色列入侵伊朗之前，其交易价格约为 73 美元。

paras.en: Matt Smith, director of commodities research at Kpler, said oil had risen again due to renewed strikes between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis in Yemen.
paras.zh: Kpler大宗商品研究主管马特·史密斯表示，由于沙特阿拉伯和也门胡塞武装之间再次发动袭击，油价再次上涨。

paras.en: "Oil prices were selling off strongly due to the announcement of strategic stock releases in Europe, but they reversed course on rumours of Saudi Arabia planning an offensive into Yemen as it looks to re-establish a safe path via Bab-Al Mandeb," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“由于欧洲宣布释放战略库存，油价遭到强烈抛售，但沙特阿拉伯计划进攻也门的传言扭转了油价，因为它希望通过巴布-曼德布重新建立一条安全道路。”

paras.en: European countries had pushed back against US threats to turn off American diesel, against a backdrop of the US-led war in the Middle East and reduced supplies from Russia and China.
paras.zh: 在美国领导的中东战争以及俄罗斯和中国供应减少的背景下，欧洲国家对美国关闭美国柴油的威胁进行了反击。

paras.en: The G7 leaders said they will also co-ordinate maintenance schedules to avoid multiple refineries being shut down at the same time, while encouraging countries with the capacity to do so to ramp up refining of diesel in particular.
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人表示，他们还将协调维护计划，以避免多个炼油厂同时关闭，同时鼓励有能力的国家特别加大柴油炼油力度。

paras.en: Avoiding a ban on US diesel exports will offer significant relief to countries which are reliant on imports of the fuel, including the UK, where prices at the pump topped Â£2 a litre for the first time on Friday.
paras.zh: 避免美国柴油出口禁令将为依赖燃料进口的国家带来重大缓解，其中包括英国，该国的加油站价格周五首次突破每升 2 英镑。

paras.en: Over half of the UK's diesel is imported, with 31% of those imports coming from the US.
paras.zh: 英国一半以上的柴油是进口的，其中 31% 来自美国。

paras.en: The US is one of the world's leading diesel suppliers, with domestic refineries churning out roughly four to five million barrels every day, according to the US Energy Information Administration (EIA).
paras.zh: 根据美国能源情报署 (EIA) 的数据，美国是世界领先的柴油供应国之一，国内炼油厂每天生产约四到五百万桶。

paras.en: Americans consume about 3.6 million barrels of that. Refiners export the remaining 1.2 to 1.5 million barrels per day, making the US a vital supplier to the global market.
paras.zh: 美国人消费了大约 360 万桶。炼油厂每天出口剩余的 1.2 至 150 万桶石油，使美国成为全球市场的重要供应国。

paras.en: Supplies of diesel internationally have been heavily constrained by the conflict in the Middle East, which has restricted the flow of both crude oil and refined diesel onto global markets.
paras.zh: 国际柴油供应受到中东冲突的严重限制，这限制了原油和精炼柴油进入全球市场的流动。

paras.en: Russia, which is also a major producer, has implemented its own export ban on diesel, following attacks on its refineries by Ukraine, further limiting supply. The G7 leaders stressed that they will maintain sanctions against Russia amid its ongoing war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯也是主要生产国，在乌克兰袭击其炼油厂后，俄罗斯也实施了自己的柴油出口禁令，进一步限制了供应。七国集团领导人强调，在乌克兰战争持续期间，他们将维持对俄罗斯的制裁。

paras.en: Diesel is harder to refine than petrol and, because of its use in the haulage industry and agriculture, it is very difficult to reduce demand.
paras.zh: 柴油比汽油更难精炼，而且由于其用于运输工业和农业，因此很难减少需求。

articles.title: Stray Kids Join BTS in Withholding Music From 2027 Grammy Consideration
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Stray Kids is joining BTS in straying from the Grammys, with label JYP Entertainment telling outlets such as BBC and Variety on Friday (Oct. 2) that the boy band did not submit anything for consideration at the 2027 awards.
paras.zh: Stray Kids与BTS一起偏离了格莱美颁奖典礼， JYP娱乐公司周五（ 10月2日）告诉BBC和Variety等媒体，男孩乐队没有提交任何东西供2027年颁奖典礼考虑。

paras.en: The company reportedly did not elaborate on the eight-piece group’s decision to skip out on Grammy submissions, but it seems likely that it comes in response to the Recording Academy’s recent installation of a best Asian pop music performance category. In July, the members of BTS announced that they would not be participating in the Grammys — despite their massive year with three-week Billboard 200-topping album ARIRANG — in protest of the awards “being divided by region or language.”
paras.zh: 据报道，该公司没有详细说明八人小组决定跳过格莱美奖的提交，但似乎是为了回应录音学院最近安装的最佳亚洲流行音乐表演类别。7月， BTS的成员宣布他们不会参加格莱美颁奖典礼—尽管他们在为期三周的Billboard 200顶级专辑ARIRANG中表现出色—以抗议“按地区或语言划分”的奖项。

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to reps for Stray Kids and the Grammys for comment.
paras.zh: Billboard已联系Stray Kids和The Grammys的代表征求意见。

paras.en: The addition of best Asian pop music performance to ballots has been a hot topic for months leading up to now. At the time of BTS’ boycott announcement, Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. stated, “I am saddened to hear that BTS has chosen not to participate in the Grammy Awards process this year, but as a music creator, I understand and respect their decision.”
paras.zh: 几个月来，将最佳亚洲流行音乐表演添加到选票中一直是一个热门话题。在BTS宣布抵制时， Recording Academy首席执行官Harvey Mason Jr.表示： “我很难过听到BTS选择不参加今年的格莱美颁奖典礼，但作为一名音乐创作者，我理解并尊重他们的决定。”

paras.en: “I do want to clarify something that seems to be getting lost in the conversation,” he continued, emphasizing that submitting in localized genre-based categories does not bar artists from consideration in the general categories. “The Asian pop category was created to celebrate the depth, diversity and extraordinary growth of pop artistry coming out of Asia. The spirit of this new category is to shine a dedicated spotlight on these important artists. More categories mean more artists’ work is recognized. It’s never to divide, but to expand who is recognized by our 15,000 Grammy voters.”
paras.zh: “我确实想澄清一些似乎在谈话中迷失的东西，”他继续说道，并强调以基于流派的本地化类别提交并不妨碍艺术家在一般类别中进行考虑。“亚洲流行音乐类别的创立是为了庆祝亚洲流行艺术的深度、多样性和非凡增长。这个新类别的精神是专门关注这些重要的艺术家。更多的类别意味着更多的艺术家作品得到认可。它永远不会分裂，而是扩大我们15,000名格莱美选民的认可。”

paras.en: As recently reported by Billboard, the academy has continued its discussions about the category in light of the controversy. In early September, there was a virtual call with 80-plus artists, executives and stakeholders from the Asian music community with trustees and governors from the Recording Academy to review the efficacy of the new award.
paras.zh: 正如Billboard最近报道的那样，鉴于争议，该学院继续就该类别进行讨论。9月初，来自亚洲音乐界的80多位艺术家、高管和利益相关者与唱片学院的受托人和州长进行了虚拟电话会议，以审查新奖项的功效。

paras.en: On Thursday (Oct. 1), however, the academy confirmed its intentions to move forward with the best Asian pop music performance recognition.
paras.zh: 然而，周四（ 10月1日） ，学院确认了推进亚洲最佳流行音乐表演表彰的意图。

paras.en: “Over the past several weeks the academy has been conducting listening sessions and have been in dialogue with leaders of the Asian music community,” Mason Jr. stated. “In this case, we heard candid feedback from people in our community who don’t support the continuation of this category. We also heard from people who didn’t have accurate information about the category, and having space to clear up misperceptions has been especially valuable. But by far, the loudest feedback we heard was from people who were enthusiastic supporters of the category, fellow music creators expressing their encouragement for keeping it.”
paras.zh: Mason Jr.表示： “在过去的几周里，学院一直在举办听证会，并与亚洲音乐界的领导人进行对话。”「在这种情况下，我们听到了社区中不支持继续保留此类别用户的坦诚反馈。我们还听取了对该类别没有准确信息的人的意见，有足够的空间来消除误解尤其有价值。但到目前为止，我们听到的最响亮的反馈来自该类别的热情支持者，其他音乐创作者表达了他们对保留该类别的鼓励。”

paras.en: “We understand this conclusion will not satisfy everyone, and that never feels good,” he added. “But at the same time, we are confident it’s the right conclusion for the music community overall.”
paras.zh: 他补充说： “我们理解这一结论不会让所有人满意，而且永远不会感觉良好。” “但与此同时，我们相信这对整个音乐界来说是正确的结论。”

paras.en: Though going without Grammy recognition, Stray Kids have had an incredible run as of late. In the past year alone, the group has topped the Billboard 200 twice with November EP DO IT and August’s THIS & THAT. The title track from the latter reached No. 38 on the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 虽然没有获得格莱美奖，但流浪儿童最近的表现令人难以置信。仅在过去的一年里，该集团就以11月的EP DO IT和August的THIS & THAT两次登上Billboard 200榜首。后者的冠军曲目在Billboard Hot 100上排名第38位。

articles.title: Doja Cat’s Tour Ma Vie Setlist: Every Song Played at the First U.S. Show
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Doja Cat kicked off the North American Leg of her Tour Ma Vie world tour on Thursday night (Oct. 1) at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit.
paras.zh: Doja Cat于周四晚上（ 10月1日）在底特律的小凯撒竞技场（ Little Caesars Arena ）开始了她的北美巡回演唱会Ma Vie世界巡回演唱会。

paras.en: The U.S. is the last to see Doja on the trek, which has taken her across the globe, making stops in Australia, Asia, South America and Europe before coming stateside.
paras.zh: 美国是最后一个在长途跋涉中看到Doja的人，这使她走遍了全球，在来到美国之前在澳大利亚，亚洲，南美洲和欧洲停留。

paras.en: Latto is on board as an opener on the North American dates. After teaming up on the Atlanta native’s Big Mama album, Doja and Latto delivered the live debut of their “Okayyy” collaboration on Thursday.
paras.zh: Latto是北美日期的揭幕战。Doja和Latto在亚特兰大本地人的Big Mama专辑中合作后，于周四现场首次亮相他们的“Okayyy”合作。

paras.en: Doja has revamped the setlist for the U.S. with additions such as “Cyber Sex,” “You Right,” “Shutcho,” “97,” “Balut” and a fresh remix of “Boss Bitch.” Filled with plenty of wardrobe changes and anthems spanning Doja’s decorated catalog, which boasts nine top 10 Billboard Hot 100 hits (two No. 1s), the dynamic show is broken into four acts.
paras.zh: Doja通过增加“Cyber Sex” ， “You Right” ， “Shutcho” ， “97” ， “Balut”和新的“Boss Bitch”混音，对美国的歌曲列表进行了改进。“Doja的装饰目录中充满了大量的衣柜变化和国歌，其中包括九首十大Billboard Hot 100热门歌曲（两首第一名） ，动态表演分为四幕。

paras.en: Next up, the Grammy-winning artist will be taking her talents to Chicago, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Houston, Orlando, Atlanta, Boston, Toronto and Philadelphia before wrapping up on Dec. 1 with a headlining show at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
paras.zh: 接下来，这位获得格莱美奖的艺术家将把她的才华带到芝加哥、盐湖城、旧金山、洛杉矶、休斯顿、奥兰多、亚特兰大、波士顿、多伦多和费城，然后于12月1日在纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行的头条新闻节目结束。

paras.en: The tour comes in support of Doja Cat’s Vie album, which arrived in September 2025 and debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 with 57,000 total album-equivalent units earned, according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 根据Luminate的说法，这次巡演是为了支持Doja Cat的Vie专辑，该专辑于2025年9月到达，并在Billboard 200上排名第四，总共获得了57,000张专辑等效单位。

paras.en: It’s been three years since Doja last launched a full-length tour run in the U.S. She previously trekked throughout North America in late 2023 as part of The Scarlet Tour, which also included a 2024 Coachella performance.
paras.zh: 自Doja上次在美国推出全长巡演以来，已经过去三年了。她曾于2023年底在北美各地徒步旅行，作为The Scarlet Tour的一部分，其中还包括2024年的科切拉表演。
