For instance, over the southern part of the United States we tend to see rainier conditions, whereas it’s typically drier than normal over the Pacific Northwest and warmer than average over the northern United States and Canada.
paras.zh: 当我们进入深秋时，我们通常会在距离赤道稍远的地方看到更多的影响。例如，在美国南部地区，我们往往会看到更多的降雨，而太平洋西北部地区通常比正常情况更干燥，而美国北部和加拿大则比正常情况更温暖。

paras.en: Lenssen: An important detail is that just because this El Niño is so powerful, that doesn’t necessarily mean we’re more confident about these impacts. The global warming of the oceans has made some of the historical mid-latitude impacts less likely, so there’s a kind of twist there. For example, the El Niño in 2023 and 2024 didn’t lead to as much wet weather in California as expected, and some research has shown that was due to other warming ocean patterns. That clouds the picture a little.
paras.zh: 伦森：一个重要的细节是，仅仅因为这次厄尔尼诺现象如此强大，并不一定意味着我们对这些影响更有信心。全球海洋变暖使得一些历史上的中纬度影响不太可能发生，因此存在着某种扭曲。例如，2023 年和 2024 年的厄尔尼诺现象并没有给加州带来预期那样的潮湿天气，一些研究表明，这是由于其他海洋变暖模式造成的。这让画面有点模糊。

paras.en: Johnson: El Niños typically last just a year, so we’ll probably see it weaken after winter and be over by spring or early summer. But when we have big El Niño like this, we’re more likely to see a shift in the following year to La Niña [which can also have global impacts on weather]. So that’s definitely something we’ll be keeping our eye on.
paras.zh: 约翰逊：厄尔尼诺现象通常只持续一年，因此我们可能会看到它在冬季后减弱，并在春季或初夏结束。但是，当出现这样的大厄尔尼诺现象时，我们更有可能在接下来的一年看到拉尼娜现象的转变（这也可能对全球天气产生影响）。所以这绝对是我们会密切关注的事情。

paras.en: Lenssen: It’s possible that this event could be followed by a double La Niña, which is when we get back-to-back events separated by a brief period of neutral conditions. That happened in 2016 and 2017, after the strong El Niño of 2014 and 2015.
paras.zh: 伦森：这个事件之后可能会出现双拉尼娜现象，即我们会连续发生事件，中间间隔一段短暂的中性条件。这发生在 2014 年和 2015 年强烈厄尔尼诺现象之后的 2016 年和 2017 年。

paras.en: SN: Aside from its strength, what sets this event apart from others in the past?
paras.zh: SN：除了其实力之外，这次活动与以往的其他活动有何不同？

paras.en: Johnson: We’ve seen such a dramatic change in the equatorial Pacific Ocean over the course of the year. The transition has been very rapid, from a La Niña last winter to a very strong El Niño in less than a year. That might be the fastest transition that we’ve seen.
paras.zh: 约翰逊：这一年我们看到赤道太平洋发生了如此巨大的变化。这种转变非常迅速，从去年冬天的拉尼娜现象到不到一年的时间就出现了非常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象。这可能是我们见过的最快的转变。

paras.en: SN: Is there any sort of silver lining here?
paras.zh: SN：这里有一线希望吗？

paras.en: Lenssen: Though more work is needed to understand this, some research suggests that future El Niños may actually become more predictable as the world continues to warm. That could potentially give us months of additional lead time to prepare for the impacts, which would be great.
paras.zh: 伦森：虽然需要做更多的工作来理解这一点，但一些研究表明，随着世界持续变暖，未来的厄尔尼诺现象实际上可能变得更加可预测。这可能会给我们带来几个月的额外准备时间来应对影响，这会很棒。

articles.title: Are hypernovas real?
articles.author: Mara Johnson-Groh

paras.en: Chemical traces in some oddball stars hinted at the existence of hypernovas — a type of hyper-energetic supernova. But new mathematical models are questioning the hype on hypernovas.
paras.zh: 一些奇怪恒星中的化学痕迹暗示了超新星的存在——一种高能超新星。但新的数学模型正在质疑超新星的炒作。

paras.en: Models of how elements mix across generations of stars suggests the parentage of stars attributed to hypernova events might have been standard supernovas and other relatively common cataclysmic stellar events instead, researchers report in the September Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
paras.zh: 研究人员在《皇家天文学会月刊》上报告称，元素如何在各代恒星中混合的模型表明，超新星事件造成的恒星可能是标准超新星和其他相对常见的灾难性恒星事件。

paras.en: “The evidence for [hypernovas] is now very seriously challenged,” says astrophysicist Ralph Schönrich of University College London.
paras.zh: “[超新星]的证据现在受到非常严重的挑战，”伦敦大学学院的天体物理学家拉尔夫·舍恩里奇说。

paras.en: Not everyone is fully convinced of the change in the stars’ proposed origins, including astronomer Anna Frebel of Massachusetts Institute of Technology, who thinks both supernovas and hypernovas remain plausible candidates as the stars’ parents. Frebel notes, however, that the findings are a good reminder for astronomers to be careful about claiming uniqueness.
paras.zh: 并不是所有人都完全相信恒星起源的变化，包括麻省理工学院的天文学家安娜·弗雷贝尔（Anna Frebel），她认为超新星和超新星仍然是恒星父母的合理候选者。然而，弗雷贝尔指出，这些发现很好地提醒天文学家在声称独特性时要小心。

paras.en: Astronomers look for clues to a star’s origins in the elements it contains. When an earlier star dies, it releases elements into space, sometimes in a supernova explosion. That material mixes with gas that may eventually form new stars. Different kinds of explosions leave different chemical patterns, so the relative amounts of elements in a star can help astronomers work out what happened before it formed.
paras.zh: 天文学家从恒星所含的元素中寻找恒星起源的线索。当较早的恒星死亡时，它会将元素释放到太空中，有时会发生超新星爆炸。这种物质与气体混合，最终可能形成新的恒星。不同类型的爆炸会留下不同的化学模式，因此恒星中元素的相对含量可以帮助天文学家弄清楚它形成之前发生的情况。

paras.en: But tracing a star’s origins this way depends on knowing how elements from an earlier explosion spread through space. Models have often treated a supernova’s expelled material as though it mixes evenly with the gas that forms new stars. The new research accounts for observations and computer models that have shown that these explosions can spread elements asymmetrically. For example, a clump of a supernova’s oxygen might go preferentially in one direction and nickel another. While the ejected elements get mixed with other dust and gases in interstellar space, the overabundance in some areas isn’t likely to average out, especially in the earliest generations of stars, which have fewer heavy elements, Schönrich says. As a result, two stars forming on opposite sides of a supernova site could have different compositions.
paras.zh: 但以这种方式追踪恒星的起源取决于了解早期爆炸中的元素如何在太空中传播。模型通常将超新星排出的物质视为与形成新恒星的气体均匀混合。新的研究解释了观察结果和计算机模型，这些模型表明这些爆炸可以不对称地扩散元素。例如，一团超新星的氧可能会优先流向一个方向，而镍则可能会优先流向另一个方向。舍恩里奇说，虽然喷射出的元素与星际空间中的其他尘埃和气体混合，但某些区域的过量元素不太可能达到平均水平，尤其是在最早几代恒星中，这些恒星的重元素较少。因此，在超新星地点相对两侧形成的两颗恒星可能具有不同的成分。

paras.en: This isn’t surprising for astrophysicist Adam Burrows of Princeton University, who studies supernovas and was not involved in the research. Burrows says that the idea of irregular mixing from these events is well known among supernova researchers but not well shared with astronomers who study the evolution of galaxies and generations of stars. “They’re taking seriously what we have seen for a long time,” Burrows says.
paras.zh: 对于普林斯顿大学的天体物理学家亚当·伯罗斯来说，这并不奇怪，他研究超新星，但没有参与这项研究。伯罗斯说，这些事件造成的不规则混合的想法在超新星研究人员中是众所周知的，但研究星系演化和恒星世代的天文学家却不太认同。 “他们正在认真对待我们长期以来所看到的情况，”伯罗斯说。

paras.en: Accounting for this uneven spread of materials, the researchers created a mathematical model to see if the element ratios produced from lopsided explosions could match the mix seen in some unusual stars in the Milky Way’s halo, the galaxy’s outer sphere of stars that contains a lot of old stars that are low in heavy elements. Previously, researchers thought the ratios of elements in these stars couldn’t have formed by regular events alone and proposed hypernovas as their source. But the researchers found their model matched the observed element ratios as well as or better than the hypernova model.
paras.zh: 考虑到材料的这种不均匀分布，研究人员创建了一个数学模型，看看不平衡爆炸产生的元素比例是否可以与银河系光环中一些不寻常恒星中看到的混合相匹配，银河系的恒星外层球体包含许多重元素含量较低的老恒星。此前，研究人员认为这些恒星中的元素比例不可能仅由常规事件形成，并提出超新星作为其来源。但研究人员发现他们的模型与观察到的元素比例的匹配程度与超新星模型一样好，甚至更好。

paras.en: “A good fit tells us that a particular enrichment scenario is possible, but it does not necessarily tell us that it is the only scenario,” Frebel says. While ordinary supernovas may explain these stars’ chemistry, she says, the new models don’t rule out hypernovas.
paras.zh: “良好的拟合告诉我们，特定的富集场景是可能的，但它并不一定告诉我们这是唯一的场景，”弗雷贝尔说。她说，虽然普通的超新星可以解释这些恒星的化学反应，但新模型并不排除超新星的存在。

paras.en: Regardless of where these oddball stars came from, astronomers agree the results show that more studies on supernovas and gas mixing are needed.
paras.zh: 无论这些奇怪的恒星来自哪里，天文学家都同意研究结果表明需要对超新星和气体混合进行更多研究。

articles.title: Young Yosemite toads survive winter, then emerge with a deadly fungus
articles.author: Erin Garcia de Jesús

paras.en: A toad’s winter refuge could be a biohazard.
paras.zh: 蟾蜍的冬季避难所可能是一个生物危害。

paras.en: Some young Yosemite toads emerge from their first winter underground infected with the deadly chytrid fungus Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis, or Bd, researchers report September 23 in Functional Ecology. Although the fungus typically spreads through water, the finding points to an unexpectedly risky period as toads wait out harsh winters in burrows beneath feet of snow.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 23 日在《功能生态学》杂志上报道，一些年轻的约塞米蒂蟾蜍在地下度过的第一个冬天就感染了致命的壶菌 Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis（Bd）。尽管真菌通常通过水传播，但这一发现表明，蟾蜍在雪脚下的洞穴中等待严冬的到来，这是一个意想不到的危险时期。

paras.en: Bd has hit amphibian populations hard. The fungus attacks amphibians’ skin, preventing electrolytes and fluids from entering the body, and often leads to heart failure. Infections, which can kill the frogs, are responsible for declines in at least 500 species and 90 possible extinctions, according to a 2019 estimate.
paras.zh: Bd 严重打击了两栖动物种群。这种真菌会攻击两栖动物的皮肤，阻止电解质和液体进入体内，并常常导致心力衰竭。根据 2019 年的估计，感染可以杀死青蛙，导致至少 500 种青蛙数量减少，90 种可能灭绝。

paras.en: The disease is one reason why Yosemite toads (Anaxyrus canorus) are listed as threatened under the U.S. Endangered Species Act. The toads live in California’s Sierra Nevada mountains, where the toads spend most of their time on dry land. Mature adults breed in shallow pools of water. But high-elevation living also means they spend roughly half the year underground during brumation, a hibernation-like state for reptiles and amphibians.
paras.zh: 这种疾病是优胜美地蟾蜍（Anaxyrus canorus）被《美国濒危物种法》列为受威胁物种的原因之一。这些蟾蜍生活在加利福尼亚州的内华达山脉，在那里，蟾蜍大部分时间都在干燥的土地上度过。成熟的成虫在浅水池中繁殖。但高海拔生活也意味着它们在冬眠期间大约有半年时间在地下度过，对于爬行动物和两栖动物来说，这是一种类似冬眠的状态。

paras.en: How a water-loving fungus sticks around even after toads spend a long, cold winter underground is a mystery, says David Daversa, an ecologist at UCLA. “It’s a waterborne pathogen; how does that happen?”
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的生态学家戴维·达维萨 (David Daversa) 表示，即使蟾蜍在地下度过了漫长而寒冷的冬天，喜水真菌如何仍然存在，仍然是一个谜。 “这是一种水传播的病原体；这是怎么发生的？”

paras.en: To find out, Daversa and colleagues trekked to Yosemite National Park. The team captured Yosemite toads of all ages — including the youngest toads both before they went into their burrows and after they emerged — and swabbed their skin to test for Bd.
paras.zh: 为了找到答案，达维萨和同事长途跋涉来到优胜美地国家公园。研究小组捕获了各个年龄段的优胜美地蟾蜍，包括在​​进入洞穴之前和出来之后最年轻的蟾蜍，并擦拭它们的皮肤以测试 Bd。

paras.en: Surprisingly, the fungus was more prevalent in juvenile toads after their first winter than in adults breeding in the water. An average of roughly 23 percent of juveniles tested positive for Bd before their first brumation. In the spring, more than 90 percent of those young toads emerged from their burrows with sometimes severe infections. Less than half of breeding adults tested positive.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，在第一个冬天之后，这种真菌在幼年蟾蜍中比在水中繁殖的成年蟾蜍中更普遍。平均大约 23% 的青少年在第一次爆发前 Bd 检测呈阳性。春天，超过 90% 的幼蟾蜍从洞穴中出来，有时会出现严重感染。不到一半的繁殖成虫检测呈阳性。

paras.en: Daversa says it’s unclear why the fungus thrives underground. It’s possible that young toads burrow with undetectable infections that grow over time, or that the fungus spreads when many toads burrow together.
paras.zh: 达维萨说，目前还不清楚为什么这种真菌在地下繁衍生息。年轻的蟾蜍挖洞时可能会携带无法检测到的感染，这些感染会随着时间的推移而增长，或者当许多蟾蜍一起挖洞时真菌就会传播。

paras.en: Also unknown is whether other brumating amphibians face similar risks during the winter. Still, the findings have already had some practical implications. A reintroduction program with the San Francisco Zoo and U.S. National Park Service that aims to boost Yosemite toad populations now focuses on releasing mature toads that are past those first Bd-vulnerable years.
paras.zh: 同样未知的是其他易怒的两栖动物在冬季是否面临类似的风险。尽管如此，研究结果已经产生了一些实际意义。旧金山动物园和美国国家公园管理局共同开展了一项放归计划，旨在增加优胜美地蟾蜍的数量，目前重点是释放已经过了 Bd 易感期的成熟蟾蜍。

paras.en: By thinking beyond the water, Daversa says, perhaps conservationists “could nip chytrid in the bud in these early life stages when it seems to proliferate most.”
paras.zh: 达维萨说，通过超越水的思维，也许自然资源保护主义者“可以在壶菌似乎繁殖最快的生命早期阶段将其消灭在萌芽状态。”

articles.title: No Longer Just North And South: A New Material Joins The Third Type of Magnetism
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Unlike what a certain donut company suggests, the world actually runs on magnetism.
paras.zh: 与某家甜甜圈公司的说法不同，世界实际上是靠磁力运转的。

paras.en: It's essential for generating power, building (electric) vehicles, and powering life-saving medical technologies like cyberpunk-style titanium hearts with levitating rotors.
paras.zh: 它对于发电、制造（电动）车辆以及为赛博朋克风格的带有悬浮转子的钛合金心脏等救生医疗技术提供动力至关重要。

paras.en: Magnetism comes in multiple variations, but two are instantly relatable.
paras.zh: 磁性有多种变化，但有两种是立即相关的。

paras.en: In ferromagnetism, the magnetic moments (tiny fields) of a material's constituent particles align in a certain direction to create a bigger magnetic field – the classic north-and-south-pole setup of a fridge magnet. But this generates stray fields that can interfere with computer chips and other electronics.
paras.zh: 在铁磁性中，材料组成颗粒的磁矩（微小磁场）沿特定方向排列以产生更大的磁场——冰箱磁铁的经典南北磁极设置。但这会产生杂散场，可能会干扰计算机芯片和其他电子设备。

paras.en: In antiferromagnetism, the magnetic moments point in opposite directions and cancel out, so there's no overall north or south pole at all. This squashes the stray fields but also the attractive properties that (literally and figuratively) may make a material useful.
paras.zh: 在反铁磁性中，磁矩指向相反的方向并相互抵消，因此根本不存在整体的北极或南极。这不仅可以抑制杂散场，还可以抑制材料具有的吸引人的特性（字面上和比喻上的），使材料变得有用。

paras.en: If one could, perhaps, combine the best of both worlds in, say, a versatile yet thin material, it could prove prominent in a world of ever-shrinking electromagnetic technologies.
paras.zh: 如果人们能够将两个世界的优点结合到一种多功能而薄的材料中，那么它可能会在电磁技术不断萎缩的世界中脱颖而出。

paras.en: Surprisingly, scientists have reported doing just that, achieving the first experimental evidence of altermagnetism – a recently confirmed type of magnetism – in a sandwich-like material with numerous future applications.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，科学家报告称，他们正是这样做的，在类似三明治的材料中获得了交变磁性（一种最近被证实的磁性类型）的第一个实验证据，并具有许多未来的应用。

paras.en: In a paper published in the journal Nature Communications, a team of physicists created crystals of a material called Co₁/₄TaSe₂. This sounds incredibly abstruse but only comprises three elements: cobalt, tantalum, and selenium (and their ratios).
paras.zh: 在《自然通讯》杂志上发表的一篇论文中，物理学家团队创造了一种名为 Co₁/₄TaSe2 的材料晶体。这听起来非常深奥，但只包含三种元素：钴、钽和硒（及其比例）。

paras.en: Combining them in an experimentally useful way required 'baking' them at more than 900 degrees Celsius (1,700 degrees Fahrenheit) across two weeks.
paras.zh: 以一种实验上有用的方式将它们组合起来需要在超过 900 摄氏度（1,700 华氏度）的温度下“烘烤”它们两周。

paras.en: "These materials are distinguished from more conventional antiferromagnets by their ability to generate and detect spin currents without the negative effect of producing stray fields," explains Madhab Neupane, a professor of physics at the University of Central Florida (UCF) and the study's corresponding author.
paras.zh: “这些材料与更传统的反铁磁体的区别在于它们能够产生和检测自旋电流，而不会产生杂散场的负面影响，”中佛罗里达大学 (UCF) 物理学教授、该研究的通讯作者 Madhab Neupane 解释道。

paras.en: "This new property makes them very well positioned for use in many different applications – including spintronics, ultrafast memory devices, terahertz networks and energy-efficient electronics."
paras.zh: “这一新特性使它们非常适合用于许多不同的应用，包括自旋电子学、超快存储设备、太赫兹网络和节能电子产品。”

paras.en: The Co₁/₄TaSe₂ material, which is not itself new to science, is made of layers that are composed of the metal tantalum and the non-metal selenium.
paras.zh: Co₁/₄TaSe2 材料本身对科学来说并不新鲜，它由金属钽和非金属硒组成的层组成。

paras.en: Between these layers, the researchers sprinkled atoms of the magnetic metal cobalt, to structurally create a quantum jungle gym that could alter the electrons as they run through it.
paras.zh: 在这些层之间，研究人员撒上了磁性金属钴的原子，从结构上创建了一个量子丛林健身房，可以在电子穿过它时改变它们。

paras.en: To confirm the altermagnetism, the researchers used a quantum modeling method and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES).
paras.zh: 为了证实交变磁性，研究人员使用了量子建模方法和角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。

paras.en: The latter basically hits a material with a beam of light, causing it to eject an electron so scientists can determine its energy and its direction.
paras.zh: 后者基本上是用光束击中材料，使其喷射电子，以便科学家可以确定其能量和方向。

paras.en: They thus revealed the material's energetic band structure, a map of where its electrons can and can't exist.
paras.zh: 因此，他们揭示了该材料的能带结构，即电子可以存在和不可以存在的位置的地图。

paras.en: In doing so they noticed it was split, and that the split states carried opposite spin polarizations, which refer to how an elementary particle's spin is aligned to a certain direction – conveniently, particles can only spin "up" or "down."
paras.zh: 在这样做的过程中，他们注意到它被分裂了，并且分裂态带有相反的自旋极化，这指的是基本粒子的自旋如何与某个方向对齐——方便的是，粒子只能“向上”或“向下”旋转。

paras.en: Of course, the electrons don't actually spin, as Earth does on its axis or a seven-layered sandwich spins on Scooby-Doo's claw before being devoured. Instead, it's more of a mathematically defined angular momentum.
paras.zh: 当然，电子实际上并不旋转，就像地球在其轴上旋转或七层三明治在被吞噬之前在史酷比的爪子上旋转一样。相反，它更多的是数学上定义的角动量。

paras.en: But it is an essential quantum property and, importantly, the researchers showed that the Co₁/₄TaSe₂ material splits the electrons by their spin.
paras.zh: 但这是一种重要的量子特性，重要的是，研究人员表明 Co₁/₄TaSe2 材料通过自旋分裂电子​​。

paras.en: This is vital in the context of the two previously mentioned magnetic types.
paras.zh: 这对于前面提到的两种磁性类型至关重要。

paras.en: Ferromagnetism is good at splitting spins, because its magnetic moments point in the same direction, but it produces stray fields.
paras.zh: 铁磁性擅长分裂自旋，因为它的磁矩指向同一方向，但它会产生杂散场。

paras.en: Antiferromagnetism produces no stray fields but is not a good spin splitter, because its magnetic moments point in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 反铁磁性不会产生杂散场，但不是一个好的自旋分裂器，因为它的磁矩指向相反的方向。

paras.en: This combination of qualities may make this easily tunable material a magnificent medium to probe magnetic mysteries:
paras.zh: 这种特性的结合可能使这种易于调节的材料成为探索磁性奥秘的绝佳媒介：

paras.en: "Evidence for altermagnetism in a versatile materials platform opens a lot of new possibilities," notes Milo Sprague, an experimental quantum physicist at UCF and the study's lead author.
paras.zh: “多功能材料平台中交变磁性的证据开启了许多新的可能性，”中佛罗里达大学实验量子物理学家、该研究的主要作者米洛·斯普拉格（Milo Sprague）指出。

paras.en: "There's currently a lot of debate in altermagnetic theory about how the spin-polarized electronic states interact with other magnetic phenomena. Now we have a material that we can easily modify to explore these new questions," Sprague adds.
paras.zh: “目前，关于自旋极化电子态如何与其他磁现象相互作用，交变磁理论存在很多争论。现在我们有了一种可以轻松修改的材料来探索这些新问题，”斯普拉格补充道。

paras.en: For example, altermagnetism's origins are ostensible. Further research is required to see how they rise over other forms of magnetism, as electron interactions compete amongst one another.
paras.zh: 例如，交变磁力的起源是表面上可见的。由于电子相互作用相互竞争，因此需要进一步的研究来了解它们如何超越其他形式的磁性。

paras.en: Finally, in practical terms, while modern hardware may physically transport electrons to process data, emerging spintronics could manipulate data by transferring the electrons' spin states through a 'current' – like a soccer-stadium wave – to increase data storage while reducing the odds of espionage.
paras.zh: 最后，实际上，虽然现代硬件可以物理传输电子来处理数据，但新兴的自旋电子学可以通过“电流”（如足球场波浪）转移电子的自旋状态来操纵数据，以增加数据存储，同时降低间谍活动的可能性。

paras.en: Thanks to the versatility and small scale of such recently described layered materials, our technological fate may be minuscule and sandwich-shaped.
paras.zh: 由于最近描述的层状材料的多功能性和小规模，我们的技术命运可能是微小的和三明治形状的。

paras.en: But why not? Sandwiches have never failed us before.
paras.zh: 但为什么不呢？三明治以前从来没有让我们失望过。

paras.en: As Neupane lays out, "If this approach proves viable, then layered altermagnets will be at the forefront of electronics development."
paras.zh: 正如 Neupane 所指出的，“如果这种方法被证明是可行的，那么分层交替磁体将处于电子产品开发的最前沿。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然通讯》上。

articles.title: This One Exercise 3x a Week Could Keep Your Blood Pressure Down – And It Doesn't Take Long
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: We all know exercise is good for us – but we don't all have the time, motivation, or mobility to put in regular workout sessions. Researchers are trying to help by looking for activities that bring the most benefits for the least amount of time and effort.
paras.zh: 我们都知道锻炼对我们有好处，但我们并不是都有时间、动力或活动能力来进行定期锻炼。研究人员试图通过寻找以最少的时间和精力带来最大收益的活动来提供帮助。

paras.en: In a new study published in BMJ Open Sport & Exercise Medicine, a team led by researchers from Canterbury Christ Church University in the UK has identified isometric exercise training (IET) as a way of reducing blood pressure with just a couple of sessions a week.
paras.zh: 在《BMJ 开放运动与运动医学》上发表的一项新研究中，由英国坎特伯雷基督教会大学的研究人员领导的团队发现，等长运动训练 (IET) 是一种每周只需进行几次即可降低血压的方法。

paras.en: That's any training where one position is held for a few minutes at a time. Staying in a squat, holding a plank pose, or doing a hand grip exercise would all count.
paras.zh: 这是一种每次保持一个姿势几分钟的训练。保持深蹲、保持平板支撑姿势或进行握力练习都可以。

paras.en: These exercises are simple and quick to do, require no equipment, and the researchers suggest they're a worthwhile option for those who can't manage longer, more comprehensive workouts.
paras.zh: 这些练习简单快捷，不需要任何设备，研究人员表示，对于那些无法进行更长时间、更全面的锻炼的人来说，它们是一个值得的选择。

paras.en: Over the course of the study period, IET was linked to drops in systolic blood pressure – the top number in a reading like 130/85, showing peak artery pressure as your heart pumps blood out, and the average pressure in the arteries overall.
paras.zh: 在研究期间，IET 与收缩压下降有关——收缩压是读数中最高的数字，如 130/85，显示心脏泵血时的峰值动脉压力，以及整体动脉的平均压力。

paras.en: "Lower-frequency IET can help maintain short-term blood pressure reductions, providing a pragmatic option for individuals with limited time or adherence challenges," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“较低频率的 IET 可以帮助维持短期血压降低，为时间有限或难以坚持的个人提供实用的选择。”

paras.en: IET has already been associated with lowering blood pressure in previous studies, but before now no one had really investigated how much of it was needed – the duration and frequency required for the biggest benefits.
paras.zh: 在之前的研究中，IET 已经与降低血压联系在一起，但在此之前，没有人真正研究过需要多少 IET，即获得最大益处所需的持续时间和频率。

paras.en: Here, the researchers recruited 100 adults with an average age of 37, who weren't meeting minimum exercise guidelines and had normal to high-normal systolic blood pressure (that's in the range 120–140 mm Hg).
paras.zh: 在这里，研究人员招募了 100 名平均年龄为 37 岁的成年人，他们没有达到最低运动指南，收缩压正常至正常高值（范围在 120-140 毫米汞柱）。

paras.en: For four weeks, 80 of these volunteers were asked to do wall squats three times a week (four squats each session), while the other 20 acted as a control group. For the four weeks after that, the exercise participants were asked to keep up the three weekly sessions, or drop down to two, one, or none.
paras.zh: 在四个星期内，其中 80 名志愿者被要求每周进行 3 次靠墙深蹲（每次深蹲 4 次），而另外 20 名志愿者则作为对照组。在那之后的四个星期里，锻炼参与者被要求继续每周进行三次训练，或者减少到两次、一次或没有。

paras.en: After the first four weeks, systolic blood pressure in the exercising group had dropped by an average of 9.45 mm Hg, compared to the control group. For those who kept up the three sessions for eight weeks, the average drop increased to 13.73 mm Hg.
paras.zh: 前 4 周后，与对照组相比，运动组的收缩压平均下降了 9.45 毫米汞柱。对于那些连续八周坚持三个疗程的人来说，平均下降幅度增加到 13.73 毫米汞柱。

paras.en: For those who went down to a couple of sessions or a single session, the overall average drop after eight weeks was around 6.5–7 mm Hg. The blood pressure of those who gave up the exercises after four weeks, meanwhile, was back to its previous level after four weeks.
paras.zh: 对于那些参加几次疗程或一次疗程的人来说，八周后的总体平均下降幅度约为 6.5-7 毫米汞柱。与此同时，四个星期后放弃锻炼的人的血压在四个星期后恢复到之前的水平。

paras.en: "For optimal blood pressure reductions and the maintenance of a broader range of physiological adaptations, a frequency of three times per week may be recommended," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“为了达到最佳的血压降低效果并维持更广泛的生理适应，可能建议每周三次的频率。”

paras.en: It's strong evidence for the benefit of IET when it comes to blood pressure: systolic, diastolic, and mean arterial pressure all improved significantly compared to the control group after four weeks, though how often participants did the training didn't make a meaningful difference to the results.
paras.zh: 这是 IET 对血压有益的有力证据：四周后，与对照组相比，收缩压、舒张压和平均动脉压均显着改善，尽管参与者进行训练的频率并未对结果产生有意义的影响。

paras.en: The researchers think that the exercises may be relaxing and widening blood vessels, and putting the nervous system into a calmer mode – but more detailed, longer-term studies will be needed to know for sure.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些练习可能会放松和扩张血管，并使神经系统进入更平静的模式——但还需要更详细、更长期的研究才能确定。

paras.en: "While causality cannot be confirmed, the observed alignment between the mechanistic decline and the loss of blood pressure reduction suggests that training frequency plays a critical role in sustaining the cardiovascular adaptations necessary for blood pressure control following IET," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“虽然因果关系无法得到证实，但观察到的机械性下降和血压降低效果消失之间的一致性表明，训练频率在维持 IET 后血压控制所需的心血管适应方面发挥着关键作用。”

paras.en: The team also suggests that extending the IET beyond a couple of months may lead to actual structural changes in blood pressure, meaning the benefits wouldn't disappear as soon as the exercise stopped, as happened here.
paras.zh: 研究小组还建议，将 IET 延长几个月可能会导致血压发生实际的结构性变化，这意味着一旦运动停止，好处不会消失，就像这里发生的那样。

paras.en: It's another reminder that when it comes to staying healthier through exercise, you don't always need a lot of activity to improve your fitness.
paras.zh: 这再次提醒我们，当谈到通过锻炼保持健康时，您并不总是需要大量活动来改善健康状况。

paras.en: "[The study] may inform policy discussions around feasible, scalable exercise interventions for populations with low adherence or limited exercise tolerance," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“[这项研究]可能会为政策讨论提供信息，以针对依从性低或运动耐量有限的人群进行可行的、可扩展的运动干预措施。”

paras.en: The research has been published in BMJ Open Sport & Exercise Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《BMJ 开放运动与运动医学》杂志上。

articles.title: Finally: Rose-Tinted Solar Panels Could Let Crops And Electricity Share The Same Land
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Plants are the original solar panels, and they're very good at converting light into energy – red and blue light, that is.
paras.zh: 植物是最初的太阳能电池板，它们非常擅长将光转化为能量——即红光和蓝光。

paras.en: But what if a solar panel could co-exist with plants, capturing the light that they aren't using while allowing those red and blue wavelengths through?
paras.zh: 但是，如果太阳能电池板可以与植物共存，捕获它们不使用的光，同时允许红色和蓝色波长通过呢？

paras.en: That's what a team led by Silvia Ma Lu of Mälardalen University in Sweden has tested in a new study, using semi-transparent, rose-tinted solar panels that let specific wavelengths of light through to plants growing below, while also capturing solar energy for electricity.
paras.zh: 瑞典梅拉达伦大学的 Silvia Ma Lu 领导的团队在一项新研究中对此进行了测试，他们使用半透明的玫瑰色太阳能电池板，让特定波长的光透过到下面生长的植物，同时还能捕获太阳能发电。

paras.en: They've presented their prototype in the scientific journal Cell Reports Physical Science.
paras.zh: 他们在科学杂志《细胞报告物理科学》上展示了他们的原型。

paras.en: "The basic concept is quite straightforward," Ma Lu says.
paras.zh: “基本概念非常简单，”马路说。

paras.en: "The solar panels use part of the incoming sunlight to generate renewable electricity while allowing part of the light to pass through to the crops growing underneath."
paras.zh: “太阳能电池板利用部分入射阳光来产生可再生电力，同时允许部分光线穿过下面生长的农作物。”

paras.en: Perhaps we could be harvesting sunlight more efficiently by allocating different portions of the solar spectrum to crop growth and electricity generation, she says.
paras.zh: 她说，也许我们可以通过将太阳光谱的不同部分分配给农作物生长和发电来更有效地收集阳光。

paras.en: The magenta panels tested in this study, however, are more like a prototype than the final product. Their magenta color filters light in the green spectrum, but at present, that green light energy is not actually captured by the solar cells.
paras.zh: 然而，本研究中测试的洋红色面板更像是原型而不是最终产品。它们的洋红色滤除绿色光谱中的光，但目前，太阳能电池实际上并未捕获绿光能量。

paras.en: But the experiments suggest this could be a possibility in the future.
paras.zh: 但实验表明这在未来可能是可能的。

paras.en: Ma Lu and team chose broccoli as their crop of choice to test the magenta cells.
paras.zh: 马璐和他的团队选择西兰花作为测试洋红色细胞的作物。

paras.en: Broccoli, being a cultivar of Brassica oleracea, is the same species as many other commercial crops, including cabbage, cauliflower, kale, Brussels sprouts, and kohlrabi. If broccoli could grow well in the rosy shade of the solar cells, perhaps others in its species will, too.
paras.zh: 西兰花是甘蓝的一个品种，与许多其他经济作物是同一物种，包括卷心菜、花椰菜、羽衣甘蓝、球芽甘蓝和大头菜。如果西兰花能够在太阳能电池的玫瑰色阴影下生长良好，也许该品种的其他植物也能生长良好。

paras.en: The researchers set up three different 20-square-meter plots of land to grow the broccoli.
paras.zh: 研究人员开辟了三块不同的 20 平方米土地来种植西兰花。

paras.en: In one plot, the broccoli was grown in full Sun, to provide a comparison point for 'normal' growth, sans solar cell.
paras.zh: 在一块地块中，西兰花在充足的阳光下生长，为没有太阳能电池的“正常”生长提供了比较点。

paras.en: On the other two plots, the broccoli plants were reared beneath magenta solar cells: on one plot, the cells had 50 percent transparency, while on the other, transparency was 70 percent.
paras.zh: 在另外两块地块上，西兰花植物在洋红色太阳能电池下种植：在一块地块上，电池的透明度为 50%，而在另一块地块上，透明度为 70%。

paras.en: "One of the most interesting findings was how similarly the broccoli performed under the two solar panel systems despite their different transparency levels," says Ma Lu.
paras.zh: “最有趣的发现之一是西兰花在两个太阳能电池板系统下的表现非常相似，尽管它们的透明度水平不同，”马鲁说。

paras.en: "However, these findings are specific to our experimental conditions and should be validated across additional growing seasons and system configurations."
paras.zh: “然而，这些发现是针对我们的实验条件的，应该在额外的生长季节和系统配置中进行验证。”

paras.en: The broccoli plants all had similar yields when it came time to harvest, but the ones grown under the magenta panels took 25 days longer to reach that point.
paras.zh: 西兰花植株在收获时的产量相似，但在洋红色面板下生长的西兰花植株要多花 25 天才能达到这一产量。

paras.en: Given that these plants received far less light than those grown in the full Sun, this actually means they were making more efficient use of the available light: 4.5 times greater under the denser, 50-percent-transparency panels, and 2.8 times greater under the 70-percent panels.
paras.zh: 考虑到这些植物接收到的光照比在全日照下生长的植物少得多，这实际上意味着它们对可用光照的利用效率更高：在密度更高的 50% 透明度面板下，光照效率提高了 4.5 倍；在 70% 透明度面板下，光照效率提高了 2.8 倍。

paras.en: It's not just the magenta tint that alters the light reaching those plants.
paras.zh: 改变到达这些植物的光线的不仅仅是洋红色调。

paras.en: The active component of these cells, opaque cadmium telluride (CdTe), is embedded in strips across the glass panel.
paras.zh: 这些电池的活性成分是不透明的碲化镉 (CdTe)，嵌入玻璃面板上的条带中。

paras.en: It's this element of the design that truly makes for a solar panel that light can pass through. If the strips are more densely spaced, then the cell can soak up more sunlight to produce electricity – but it also means less light gets through to the plants below.
paras.zh: 正是这个设计元素真正造就了光可以穿过的太阳能电池板。如果条带的间距更密集，那么电池可以吸收更多的阳光来发电，但这也意味着到达下面植物的光线更少。

paras.en: That raises an interesting question: why do the panels need to be magenta at all, if the strips of CdTe let light through anyway, regardless of the glass color?
paras.zh: 这就提出了一个有趣的问题：如果不管玻璃颜色如何，CdTe 条无论如何都能让光透过，为什么面板需要是洋红色的？

paras.en: Well, they don't, really. The glass could just as well be neutral.
paras.zh: 嗯，他们真的不知道。玻璃也可以是中性的。

paras.en: These magenta panels were actually originally intended for building design, to offer a rosy glow to a building's interior while also capturing some electricity. They ended up in this experiment purely because they were already commercially available, ripe for repurposing.
paras.zh: 这些洋红色面板实际上最初是用于建筑设计，为建筑物内部提供玫瑰色的光芒，同时还捕获一些电力。他们最终参加这个实验纯粹是因为它们已经商业化，适合重新利用。

paras.en: The magenta filter lets through two important light spectra for plant growth: red and blue. The leftover green light that the filter blocks isn't necessarily captured by the solar cell.
paras.zh: 洋红色滤光片可让植物生长的两种重要光谱通过：红色和蓝色。滤光片阻挡的剩余绿光不一定会被太阳能电池捕获。

paras.en: As a result, it's not entirely clear from this study whether it's the magenta filter into which the CdTe strips are inlaid, or the overall light levels, that affected the broccoli's growth. And there's the greenhouse effect of laying glass over a growing vegetable: something this experiment does not account for.
paras.zh: 因此，从这项研究中尚不完全清楚是镶嵌 CdTe 条的洋红色滤光片还是整体光照水平影响了西兰花的生长。在正在生长的蔬菜上放置玻璃会产生温室效应：这个实验没有考虑到这一点。

paras.en: More detailed experiments will be needed to tease out all those variables.
paras.zh: 需要更详细的实验来弄清楚所有这些变量。

paras.en: But since these rose-tinted panels are already on the market, Ma Lu says they could readily offer households and community groups a way to make the most out of a small space.
paras.zh: 但由于这些玫瑰色面板已经上市，马陆表示，它们可以很容易地为家庭和社区团体提供一种充分利用狭小空间的方法。

paras.en: "Configurations similar to our prototype may currently be suitable for smaller-scale applications, such as community gardens, or for integration into greenhouse roofs rather than immediate deployment over large agricultural areas," she says.
paras.zh: “与我们的原型类似的配置目前可能适合较小规模的应用，例如社区花园，或集成到温室屋顶，而不是立即部署在大型农业地区，”她说。

paras.en: The idea of filtering different spectra of light to allocate the energy to separate goals – growing plants and generating electricity – makes sense in theory. However, it seems there's still a way to go in creating a solar panel that would be worth it for larger commercial applications.
paras.zh: 过滤不同光谱的光以将能量分配给不同的目标——种植植物和发电——的想法在理论上是有意义的。然而，要制造出适合大型商业应用的太阳能电池板，似乎还有很长的路要走。

paras.en: "From an engineering point of view, this is about getting the best overall use from sunlight and land," explains power systems engineering expert Ramesh Rayudu, who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: “从工程角度来看，这是为了充分利用阳光和土地，”未参与这项研究的电力系统工程专家拉梅什·拉尤杜 (Ramesh Rayudu) 解释道。

paras.en: In terms of energy harvested, in the experiment the magenta cells produced around 224.7 MWh of electricity per hectare over the growing period – about 100 MWh per hectare less than conventional solar panels of similar size.
paras.zh: 就收获的能量而言，在实验中，洋红色电池在生长期每公顷产生约 224.7 MWh 的电力，比类似尺寸的传统太阳能电池板每公顷少约 100 MWh。

paras.en: "Depending on the value of electricity and the price received for broccoli, that lost electricity could require roughly 1.2 to 3.2 tonnes of additional broccoli per hectare to offset its value," Rayudu says.
paras.zh: Rayudu 说：“根据电力价值和西兰花的价格，每公顷失去的电力可能需要大约 1.2 至 3.2 吨额外的西兰花来抵消其价值。”

paras.en: "The real question is whether the extra complexity of wavelength-selective solar panels produces enough additional agricultural value to compensate for lower electricity generation. That is the comparison I would like to see next."
paras.zh: “真正的问题是波长选择性太阳能电池板的额外复杂性是否能产生足够的额外农业价值来弥补发电量的下降。这就是我接下来想看到的比较。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cell Reports Physical Science.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《细胞报告物理科学》上。

articles.title: Caltech physicists finally measure a quantum energy ladder predicted 40 years ago

paras.en: Caltech physicists finally measure a quantum energy ladder predicted 40 years ago
paras.zh: 加州理工学院物理学家最终测量了 40 年前预测的量子能梯

paras.en: - Researchers have experimentally observed energy patterns that physicists have predicted for about 40 years. By arranging laser-trapped atoms into a quantum simulator, they recreated two different quantum tipping points and watched the atoms fall into the exact energy ratios predicted by theory. The technique could now be used to explore mysterious quantum systems where scientists do not already know the answer.
paras.zh: - 研究人员通过实验观察了物理学家预测了大约 40 年的能量模式。通过将激光捕获的原子放入量子模拟器中，他们重新创建了两个不同的量子临界点，并观察原子落入理论预测的精确能量比率。该技术现在可用于探索科学家尚不知道答案的神秘量子系统。

paras.en: When materials undergo major changes, such as water boiling or a magnet losing its magnetism, very different systems can sometimes start behaving according to the same mathematical rules.
paras.zh: 当材料发生重大变化时，例如水沸腾或磁铁失去磁性，截然不同的系统有时会开始根据相同的数学规则运行。

paras.en: "Physicists call this trait universality -- the messy, microscopic details wash out and only a few essential features survive," explains Jason Alicea, William K. Davis Professor of Theoretical Physics.
paras.zh: “物理学家将这种特征称为普遍性——杂乱的微观细节被冲走，只有少数基本特征得以保留，”威廉·K·戴维斯理论物理学教授杰森·艾丽西亚解释道。

paras.en: Physicists often describe this universal behavior using a mathematical framework known as conformal field theory.
paras.zh: 物理学家经常使用称为共形场论的数学框架来描述这种普遍行为。

paras.en: Quantum simulators test fundamental physics
paras.zh: 量子模拟器测试基础物理

paras.en: In a study published in Nature, researchers carried out the first experiments of their kind on two different conformal field theories using quantum simulators. These specialized systems are simpler than general purpose quantum computers and are designed to reproduce particular quantum behaviors.
paras.zh: 在《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究中，研究人员使用量子模拟器对两种不同的共形场论进行了首次实验。这些专用系统比通用量子计算机更简单，旨在重现特定的量子行为。

paras.en: The collaboration brought together the experimental group of Caltech's Manuel Endres, professor of physics, Alicea's theory group, and theorists at Université Paris-Saclay and the Technical University of Munich.
paras.zh: 此次合作汇集了加州理工学院物理学教授曼努埃尔·恩德雷斯（Manuel Endres）的实验小组、艾丽西亚（Alicea）的理论小组以及巴黎萨克雷大学和慕尼黑工业大学的理论家。

paras.en: Using newly developed quantum simulator technology, the researchers made the first direct measurements of energy levels in synthetic quantum matter predicted by the Ising and tricritical Ising conformal field theories. (Ising refers to Ernst Ising, a physicist who, in the 1920s, solved an early model of magnetism.)
paras.zh: 利用新开发的量子模拟器技术，研究人员首次直接测量了伊辛和三临界伊辛共形场理论预测的合成量子物质的能级。 （伊辛指的是物理学家恩斯特·伊辛 (Ernst Ising)，他在 20 年代解决了早期的磁性模型。）

paras.en: Both theories describe universal behavior that can appear when a quantum system with unusual properties such as entanglement and superposition reaches a critical point between two states, with one state being more ordered than the other.
paras.zh: 这两种理论都描述了当具有纠缠和叠加等不寻常特性的量子系统达到两种状态之间的临界点时可能出现的普遍行为，其中一种状态比另一种状态更有序。

paras.en: A quantum tipping point near absolute zero
paras.zh: 接近绝对零的量子临界点

paras.en: Unlike an ordinary phase transition such as water becoming steam, this transition is not caused by temperature. Instead, it arises entirely from quantum effects at temperatures close to absolute zero.
paras.zh: 与水变成蒸汽等普通相变不同，这种转变不是由温度引起的。相反，它完全是由接近绝对零温度下的量子效应产生的。

paras.en: At this critical point, lasers can excite the system into a sequence of specific energy states. The researchers compare those levels to the rungs of a ladder.
paras.zh: 在这个临界点，激光可以将系统激发到一系列特定的能量状态。研究人员将这些水平与梯子的梯级进行比较。

paras.en: "The energy levels predicted by these theories are important because they encode profound information about the theories themselves," Alicea says.
paras.zh: “这些理论预测的能级很重要，因为它们编码了有关理论本身的深刻信息，”艾丽西亚说。

paras.en: For about 40 years, physicists have used conformal field theories to calculate how far apart those energy rungs should be. The levels are expected to appear in precise ratios, but until this experiment, those predictions had never been directly measured.
paras.zh: 大约 40 年来，物理学家一直使用共形场论来计算这些能量梯级之间的距离。这些水平预计会以精确的比例出现，但在这次实验之前，这些预测从未被直接测量过。

paras.en: "Our new tools borrow from quantum computing platforms," says Xiangkai Sun, a co-lead author of the new study and a graduate student working in the Endres lab. "Over the past 10 years, people have been learning to control these systems, and now we are at the point where we can use them to do fundamental physics research."
paras.zh: “我们的新工具借鉴了量子计算平台，”这项新研究的共同主要作者、恩德雷斯实验室的研究生孙向凯说。 “在过去的十年里，人们一直在学习控制这些系统，现在我们已经可以利用它们进行基础物理研究了。”

paras.en: The experiment builds on technology that the Endres lab also uses for developing quantum computers. The system relies on arrays of neutral atoms held in place by tightly focused lasers known as optical tweezers.
paras.zh: 该实验建立在恩德雷斯实验室也用于开发量子计算机的技术之上。该系统依赖于由紧密聚焦的激光（称为光镊）固定到位的中性原子阵列。

paras.en: A related neutral atom platform in the lab recently reached a major milestone by trapping 6,100 atoms in a single array.
paras.zh: 实验室中的一个相关中性原子平台最近实现了一个重要里程碑，在单个阵列中捕获了 6,100 个原子。

paras.en: Although optical tweezer arrays were developed largely for quantum computing, the researchers instead used the technology to investigate a fundamental question in physics.
paras.zh: 尽管光镊阵列主要是为了量子计算而开发的，但研究人员却利用该技术来研究物理学中的一个基本问题。

paras.en: They arranged strontium atoms in a line using optical tweezers. Additional lasers then pushed the atoms into highly excited energy levels known as Rydberg states. In these states, neighboring atoms interact very strongly.
paras.zh: 他们使用光镊将锶原子排成一行。然后，额外的激光将原子推入被称为里德堡态的高度激发能级。在这些状态下，相邻原子的相互作用非常强烈。

paras.en: Those interactions caused the chain of atoms to behave collectively rather than as separate individual particles. The researchers then adjusted the lasers until the entire system reached the critical tipping point they wanted to study.
paras.zh: 这些相互作用导致原子链集体行为，而不是作为单独的粒子。然后研究人员调整激光器，直到整个系统达到他们想要研究的临界点。

paras.en: To detect the predicted energy levels, the researchers developed a technique called many body modulation spectroscopy.
paras.zh: 为了检测预测的能量水平，研究人员开发了一种称为多体调制光谱的技术。

paras.en: They gently disturbed the entire atomic chain by changing the lasers at a particular frequency and then measured how strongly the atoms responded. By scanning through many frequencies and looking for peaks in the response, the researchers could identify the different energy levels.
paras.zh: 他们通过改变特定频率的激光来轻轻扰乱整个原子链，然后测量原子响应的强度。通过扫描许多频率并寻找响应的峰值，研究人员可以识别不同的能量水平。

paras.en: The basic idea is similar to running a wet finger around the rim of a wine glass. When the motion matches the glass's natural frequency, the glass resonates and produces a sound. At other frequencies, little happens.
paras.zh: 基本思想类似于用湿手指在酒杯边缘滑动。当运动与玻璃的固有频率相匹配时，玻璃就会产生共振并发出声音。在其他频率下，几乎没有发生。

paras.en: "We repeated the experiment on chains of up to 35 atoms, and the rungs came out as predicted by the Ising conformal field theory: the spectra collapsed onto a single universal curve once rescaled for size," Sun says. "We then tuned to the tricritical point and measured the lowest levels of its distinct spectrum, which came out in the different ratios theory predicts."
paras.zh: “我们在多达 35 个原子的链上重复了实验，结果正如伊辛共形场理论所预测的那样：一旦重新调整尺寸，光谱就会塌陷到一条通用曲线上，”孙说。 “然后我们调整到三临界点并测量其独特光谱的最低水平，该光谱以理论预测的不同比率出现。”

paras.en: Hidden patterns emerge from individual atoms
paras.zh: 隐藏的模式从单个原子中显现出来

paras.en: Because the scientists could control each atom separately, they were able to perform measurements that would be much more difficult with conventional materials.
paras.zh: 由于科学家可以单独控制每个原子，因此他们能够进行使用传统材料困难得多的测量。

paras.en: The team classified the excitations by their symmetry, exposing a second set of energy rungs that was hidden in the initial measurement.
paras.zh: 研究小组根据激发的对称性对激发进行分类，暴露了初始测量中隐藏的第二组能量梯级。

paras.en: They also changed the behavior of the atoms at either end of the chain. Doing so rearranged the energy ladder, producing different patterns that matched predictions from the tricritical Ising theory.
paras.zh: 他们还改变了链两端原子的行为。这样做重新排列了能量阶梯，产生了与三临界伊辛理论预测相匹配的不同模式。

paras.en: "Even though we believed these theories to be true, it's important to have an experimental realization, something you can poke and prod," Alicea says. "To see those predictions borne out is a beautiful thing."
paras.zh: “尽管我们相信这些理论是正确的，但重要的是要有实验认识，你可以戳戳和戳戳，”艾丽西亚说。 “看到这些预测得到证实是一件美好的事情。”

paras.en: Pushing quantum simulations into new territory
paras.zh: 将量子模拟推向新领域

paras.en: The researchers now plan to expand the experiments to larger quantum systems. Rather than arranging atoms only in a line, they hope to study grids of atoms as well.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在计划将实验扩展到更大的量子系统。他们希望研究原子网格，而不是仅仅将原子排列成一条线。

paras.en: "In two dimensions, the conformal field theories are not as well understood, so this is an exciting opportunity," Sun says.
paras.zh: “在二维中，共形场论还没有得到很好的理解，所以这是一个令人兴奋的机会，”孙说。

paras.en: That could allow scientists to investigate quantum systems whose behavior cannot yet be calculated precisely, potentially including problems too difficult for classical computers.
paras.zh: 这可以让科学家研究其行为尚无法精确计算的量子系统，可能包括经典计算机难以解决的问题。

paras.en: "What excites me is that the technique doesn't require knowing the answer in advance. Here we could check our measurements against exact predictions," Endres says. "The next step is to point this at systems where nobody knows the response of the system quantitatively -- including regimes that classical computers can't reach."
paras.zh: “令我兴奋的是，该技术不需要提前知道答案。在这里，我们可以根据准确的预测来检查我们的测量结果，”恩德雷斯说。 “下一步是将其指向没有人定量地知道系统响应的系统——包括传统计算机无法达到的状态。”

paras.en: The Nature study, "Observation of conformal field theory spectra in a quantum simulator," was funded by the US Department of Energy, including its Quantum Systems Accelerator and its Quantum Science Center; the National Science Foundation, including the Institute for Quantum Information and Matter at Caltech (IQIM); the Army Research Office; the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency; the Air Force Office of Scientific Research; the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation; and the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft.
paras.zh: 《自然》杂志的研究“在量子模拟器中观察共形场论光谱”由美国能源部（包括其量子系统加速器和量子科学中心）资助；美国国家科学基金会，包括加州理工学院量子信息与物质研究所 (IQIM)；陆军研究办公室；国防高级研究计划局；空军科学研究办公室；戈登和贝蒂摩尔基金会；和德国研究协会。

paras.en: Other Caltech authors include Yuan Le, Stephen Naus, Richard Bing-Shiun Tsai, and Lewis Picard, who is now working at the Caltech-linked startup Oratomic. Additional authors are Sara Murciano of the Université Paris-Saclay (previously a postdoctoral scholar at Caltech) and Michael Knap of the Technical University of Munich and the Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology.
paras.zh: 加州理工学院的其他作者包括 Yuan Le、Stephen Naus、Richard Bing-Shiun Tsai 和 Lewis Picard，后者目前在与加州理工学院相关的初创公司 Oratomic 工作。其他作者包括巴黎萨克雷大学的 Sara Murciano（之前是加州理工学院的博士后学者）以及慕尼黑工业大学和慕尼黑量子科学技术中心的 Michael Knap。

articles.title: Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 may have a reversible weakness

paras.en: Alzheimerâs risk gene APOE4 may have a reversible weakness
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病风险基因 APOE4 可能存在可逆弱点

paras.en: - The Mount Sinai Hospital / Mount Sinai School of Medicine
paras.zh: - 西奈山医院/西奈山医学院

paras.en: - The Alzheimerâs risk gene APOE4 may actively damage brain blood vessels and sabotage the cellular systems that remove harmful proteins. Researchers were able to reverse some of these effects in experiments, revealing promising new targets for Alzheimerâs, Parkinsonâs, and other neurodegenerative diseases.
paras.zh: - 阿尔茨海默病风险基因 APOE4 可能会主动损害脑血管并破坏清除有害蛋白质的细胞系统。研究人员能够在实验中逆转其中一些影响，揭示了治疗阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和其他神经退行性疾病的有希望的新靶点。

paras.en: Mount Sinai researchers have uncovered new details about how APOE4, the strongest known genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, may contribute to brain damage. Two studies published in Cell and Cell Stem Cell show that the gene can damage blood vessels in the brain and encourage the accumulation of abnormal proteins associated with neurodegenerative disease. The findings point to disease processes that may be reversible and also highlight a new human brain tissue platform derived from stem cells that could speed up the search for treatments.
paras.zh: 西奈山研究人员发现了有关 APOE4（已知最强的阿尔茨海默病遗传风险因素）如何导致脑损伤的新细节。发表在《细胞》和《细胞干细胞》上的两项研究表明，该基因会损害大脑中的血管，并促进与神经退行性疾病相关的异常蛋白质的积累。研究结果指出疾病过程可能是可逆的，并强调了一种源自干细胞的新人类脑组织平台，可以加快治疗方法的寻找。

paras.en: Alzheimer's disease gradually damages memory, thinking, and behavior and affects more than 7 million older adults in the United States. Researchers have known for years that blood vessels in the brain deteriorate as Alzheimer's progresses, especially in people who carry APOE4. What has been less clear is why this happens and whether the vascular damage contributes directly to the disease. Because of that uncertainty, damage to the brain's circulation has often been treated as a consequence of Alzheimer's rather than as a process that could help drive it.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病逐渐损害记忆、思维和行为，影响着美国超过 700 万老年人。研究人员多年来就知道，随着阿尔茨海默病的进展，大脑中的血管会恶化，尤其是携带 APOE4 的人。目前尚不清楚的是为什么会发生这种情况以及血管损伤是否直接导致该疾病。由于这种不确定性，大脑循环受损通常被视为阿尔茨海默氏症的后果，而不是一个可能有助于驱动它的过程。

paras.en: Mapping How APOE4 Damages Brain Blood Vessels
paras.zh: 绘制 APOE4 如何损害脑血管的图谱

paras.en: For the Cell study published on September 24, Mount Sinai scientists combined existing datasets to build a single cell transcriptomic atlas of blood vessels in the human brain. The resulting map showed patterns of gene activity across the different cells that create and support the brain's vascular system, giving researchers a detailed way to examine how APOE4 contributes to vascular degeneration.
paras.zh: 对于 9 月 24 日发表的 Cell 研究，西奈山科学家结合现有数据集构建了人脑血管的单细胞转录组图谱。由此产生的图谱显示了创建和支持大脑血管系统的不同细胞的基因活动模式，为研究人员提供了一种详细的方法来检查 APOE4 如何导致血管变性。

paras.en: The team found that APOE4 altered the behavior of pericytes. These cells normally help stabilize small blood vessels and support the blood brain barrier. In the presence of APOE4, however, the pericytes changed into myofibroblast-like cells that produce scar tissue.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现 APOE4 改变了周细胞的行为。这些细胞通常有助于稳定小血管并支持血脑屏障。然而，在 APOE4 存在的情况下，周细胞转变为肌成纤维细胞样细胞，产生疤痕组织。

paras.en: That transformation promoted vascular fibrosis and increased the buildup of amyloid around blood vessels. These changes could interfere with blood flow and create conditions that encourage neurodegeneration.
paras.zh: 这种转变促进了血管纤维化，并增加了血管周围淀粉样蛋白的积聚。这些变化可能会干扰血液流动并创造促进神经退行性变的条件。

paras.en: The researchers also found evidence that this process could be reversed. Blocking TGF-β signaling, which plays a role in communication between cells and in tissue remodeling, restored pericyte coverage while reducing fibrosis and amyloid around blood vessels. The researchers reproduced the result in aged APOE4 mice, showing that the vascular degeneration associated with APOE4 can be therapeutically reversed.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现了证据表明这一过程可以逆转。阻断在细胞间通讯和组织重塑中发挥作用的 TGF-β 信号传导可以恢复周细胞覆盖，同时减少血管周围的纤维化和淀粉样蛋白。研究人员在老年 APOE4 小鼠中重现了这一结果，表明与 APOE4 相关的血管变性可以通过治疗逆转。

paras.en: "Damage to the brain's blood vessels is not simply a late consequence of Alzheimer's disease; it is a biologically active process caused by APOE4 that may be reversible," said corresponding author Joel W. Blanchard, PhD, Associate Professor of Neuroscience, and Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine, at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai. "These findings reveal new therapeutic targets for preserving vascular function and limiting amyloid accumulation."
paras.zh: 西奈山伊坎医学院神经科学、干细胞生物学和再生医学副教授、通讯作者 Joel W. Blanchard 博士说：“大脑血管损伤不仅仅是阿尔茨海默病的晚期后果；它是由 APOE4 引起的生物活性过程，可能是可逆的。” “这些发现揭示了保护血管功能和限制淀粉样蛋白积累的新治疗靶点。”

paras.en: "We show that APOE4 converts blood-vessel support cells into scar-producing cells, causing amyloid or abnormal protein buildup to accumulate around the brain's vessels. Through our experiments, we were able to block this protein buildup process, revealing possible new therapeutic treatment options and strategies for protecting the brain's circulation in people at high genetic risk for Alzheimer's disease," said first author Braxton R. Schuldt, MD/PhD candidate in Neuroscience and researcher in the Blanchard Laboratory at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai.
paras.zh: “我们发现 APOE4 将血管支持细胞转化为疤痕生成细胞，导致淀粉样蛋白或异常蛋白质积聚在大脑血管周围积聚。通过我们的实验，我们能够阻止这种蛋白质积聚过程，揭示了可能的新治疗方案和策略，以保护阿尔茨海默病高遗传风险人群的大脑循环，”第一作者、神经科学博士生、伊坎布兰查德实验室研究员 Braxton R. Schuldt 说。西奈山医学院。

paras.en: Human miBrains Reveal Disease Mechanisms
paras.zh: 人类大脑揭示疾病机制

paras.en: A major part of the research relied on miBrains, three dimensional human brain tissue developed by the Mount Sinai team from induced pluripotent stem cells. The model reproduces important features of human brain tissue, including its network of blood vessels.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要部分依赖于 miBrains，这是西奈山团队利用诱导多能干细胞开发的三维人脑组织。该模型再现了人类脑组织的重要特征，包括血管网络。

paras.en: The Blanchard laboratory combined findings from miBrains with preclinical models, postmortem human brain tissue, and transcriptomic data. Each approach helped confirm and expand on observations made with the others.
paras.zh: 布兰查德实验室将 miBrains 的研究结果与临床前模型、死后人类脑组织和转录组数据相结合。每种方法都有助于确认和扩展与其他方法的观察结果。

paras.en: By bringing these systems together, the scientists were able to recreate events that occur before the severe vascular abnormalities seen in postmortem human brain tissue. They could then identify the mechanisms behind those changes and quickly test possible treatments.
paras.zh: 通过将这些系统整合在一起，科学家们能够重现死后人类脑组织中出现严重血管异常之前发生的事件。然后他们可以确定这些变化背后的机制并快速测试可能的治疗方法。

paras.en: APOE4 May Also Disrupt the Brain's Protein Cleanup
paras.zh: APOE4 也可能破坏大脑的蛋白质清理

paras.en: In the Cell Stem Cell study, researchers used miBrains to explore another effect of APOE4: its role in the accumulation of abnormal proteins associated with neurodegenerative disease.
paras.zh: 在 Cell Stem Cell 研究中，研究人员使用 miBrains 探索 APOE4 的另一个作用：它在与神经退行性疾病相关的异常蛋白积累中的作用。

paras.en: Abnormal protein buildup is a defining feature of conditions such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. However, investigating exactly how these deposits form inside a living human brain is extremely difficult. The miBrain system gives scientists a way to observe related processes in complex human brain-like tissue under laboratory conditions.
paras.zh: 异常的蛋白质积累是阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等疾病的一个决定性特征。然而，准确研究这些沉积物如何在活人大脑内形成是极其困难的。 miBrain 系统为科学家提供了一种在实验室条件下观察复杂人脑样组织中相关过程的方法。

paras.en: miBrains include all of the major cell types present in the human brain, including neurons, supporting glial cells, myelin producing cells, and cells that make up blood vessels. Similar to what happens in the human brain, miBrains carrying APOE4 developed higher amounts of abnormal alpha-synuclein. This protein is most strongly associated with Lewy body dementia and Parkinson's disease.
paras.zh: miBrains 包括人脑中存在的所有主要细胞类型，包括神经元、支持神经胶质细胞、髓鞘生成细胞和构成血管的细胞。与人脑中发生的情况类似，携带 APOE4 的 miBrain 产生了更多数量的异常 α-突触核蛋白。这种蛋白质与路易体痴呆和帕金森病密切相关。

paras.en: Although alpha-synuclein has major clinical importance, researchers have not fully understood the cellular processes that cause it to accumulate.
paras.zh: 尽管α-突触核蛋白具有重要的临床重要性，但研究人员尚未完全了解导致其积累的细胞过程。

paras.en: Cholesterol Buildup Disrupts Cellular Waste Removal
paras.zh: 胆固醇积聚扰乱细胞废物的清除

paras.en: The experiments revealed that APOE4 causes cholesterol to accumulate inside astrocytes, support cells that perform several essential functions in maintaining brain health.
paras.zh: 实验表明，APOE4 会导致胆固醇在星形胶质细胞内积聚，而星形胶质细胞是在维持大脑健康方面执行多种基本功能的支持细胞。

paras.en: That excess cholesterol interfered with the astrocytes' lysosomal waste-disposal system. As a result, the cells became less effective at breaking down alpha-synuclein. Instead of being cleared away, the protein accumulated and spread to neurons, where it contributed to harmful deposits.
paras.zh: 过量的胆固醇会干扰星形胶质细胞的溶酶体废物处理系统。结果，细胞分解α-突触核蛋白的效率降低。这种蛋白质没有被清除，而是积累并扩散到神经元，在那里形成有害的沉积物。

paras.en: These findings suggest that cholesterol metabolism inside astrocytes, along with lysosomal function, could become important treatment targets for both Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明星形胶质细胞内的胆固醇代谢以及溶酶体功能可能成为阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病的重要治疗目标。

paras.en: Using miBrains, the researchers were able to follow the chain of events in complex human brain-like tissue. Their experiments connected APOE4 with lipid buildup in astrocytes, weaker clearance of alpha-synuclein, and the formation of toxic protein deposits.
paras.zh: 使用 miBrains，研究人员能够追踪复杂的类人脑组织中的事件链。他们的实验将 APOE4 与星形胶质细胞中的脂质堆积、α-突触核蛋白清除能力减弱以及有毒蛋白质沉积物的形成联系起来。

paras.en: The results point to both lipid metabolism and cellular waste removal systems as potential therapeutic targets in neurodegenerative disease.
paras.zh: 结果表明脂质代谢和细胞废物清除系统都是神经退行性疾病的潜在治疗靶点。

paras.en: A Platform for Testing Personalized Treatments
paras.zh: 测试个性化治疗的平台

paras.en: Another advantage of the miBrain system is that researchers can preserve the tissue for future experiments.
paras.zh: miBrain 系统的另一个优点是研究人员可以保存组织以供将来的实验使用。

paras.en: "A key advance of our technology is that miBrains with predefined cellular compositions and disease-related factors can be cryopreserved," said Louise Mesentier-Louro, PhD, Assistant Professor of Neuroscience, and Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine, at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai and first author of the Cell Stem Cell study. "This capability improves reproducibility and scalability of complex disease modeling and supports more efficient drug development and validation."
paras.zh: 西奈山伊坎医学院神经科学、干细胞生物学和再生医学助理教授、细胞干细胞研究的第一作者 Louise Mesentier-Louro 博士说：“我们技术的一个关键进步是，具有预先确定的细胞组成和疾病相关因子的 miBrains 可以被冷冻保存。” “这种能力提高了复杂疾病模型的可重复性和可扩展性，并支持更有效的药物开发和验证。”

paras.en: Mount Sinai researchers are also developing miBrains derived from individual patients, which could eventually allow scientists to investigate how neurodegenerative disease develops differently from person to person and how patients might respond to particular treatments.
paras.zh: 西奈山的研究人员还在开发源自个体患者的 miBrains，这最终可以让科学家们研究神经退行性疾病如何因人而异，以及患者对特定治疗的反应如何。

paras.en: "At Mount Sinai we are creating and cryopreserving miBrains from patients," Dr. Blanchard added. "This will enable personalized studies into how neurodegenerative disease develops and how individuals may respond to therapies. By enabling potential therapies to be tested earlier and more efficiently, the miBrain platform could help bridge the gap between laboratory discoveries and treatments for a broad range of disorders."
paras.zh: “在西奈山，我们正在从患者身上创造并冷冻保存 miBrains，”布兰查德博士补充道。 “这将使对神经退行性疾病如何发展以及个人对治疗的反应如何进行个性化研究成为可能。通过更早、更有效地测试潜在的疗法，miBrain 平台可以帮助缩小实验室发现与多种疾病治疗之间的差距。”

paras.en: The Cell study examining vascular degeneration in the brain received support from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (80ARC022CA004), the National Institute on Aging at the National Institutes of Health (R01AG089533, UH3NS115064, U54AG090669, T32GM146636), The SWT Foundation, and the CureAlz Fund.
paras.zh: 检查大脑血管变性的 Cell 研究得到了美国国家航空航天局 (80ARC022CA004)、美国国立卫生研究院国家衰老研究所 (R01AG089533、UH3NS115064、U54AG090669、T32GM146636)、SWT 基金会和 CureAlz 基金的支持。

paras.en: The Cell Stem Cell study examining abnormal protein buildup in the brain received support from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (80ARC022CA004), Aligning Science Across Parkinson's (ASAP-024297) through the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research, the National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke and the National Institute on Aging at the National Institutes of Health (R01NS114239, UH3NS115064, 1U54AG090669-01, T32AG04968, F31NS13090), the CureAlz Fund, and The SWT Foundation.

articles.title: Could quitting ultra-processed food boost your mental health?

paras.en: Could quitting ultra-processed food boost your mental health?
paras.zh: 戒掉超加工食品可以改善您的心理健康吗？

paras.en: - University of California - San Francisco
paras.zh: - 加州大学旧金山分校

paras.en: - People with depression who dramatically cut ultra-processed foods experienced notable improvements in their symptoms in a small preliminary study. Researchers suspect healthier eating may benefit the brain partly by reducing gut damage and chronic inflammation.
paras.zh: - 在一项小型初步研究中，大幅减少超加工食品的抑郁症患者的症状得到显着改善。研究人员怀疑，更健康的饮食可能通过减少肠道损伤和慢性炎症而对大脑有益。

paras.en: A small preliminary study from UC San Francisco adds to mounting evidence that eating fewer ultra-processed foods may help reduce symptoms of depression.
paras.zh: 加州大学旧金山分校的一项小型初步研究进一步证明，少吃超加工食品可能有助于减轻抑郁症状。

paras.en: Published Sept. 23 in JAMA Psychiatry, the study was funded by the National Institutes of Health. Researchers believe it is the first study to compare depression symptoms in the same participants before and after they moved from their usual ultra-processed diet to healthier foods.
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院资助，于 9 月 23 日发表在《美国医学会杂志精神病学》上。研究人员认为，这是第一项比较同一参与者从通常的超加工饮食转向更健康食品之前和之后抑郁症状的研究。

paras.en: The pilot study included only 20 people, but senior author Andrew Krystal, MD, Ray and Dagmar Dolby Distinguished Professor in UCSF's departments of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences and Neurology, said it "successfully established the viability of carrying out this research in a larger-scale trial."
paras.zh: 该试点研究仅包括 20 人，但加州大学旧金山分校精神病学、行为科学和神经病学系的资深作者、医学博士、雷和达格玛·杜比杰出教授 Andrew Krystal 表示，该研究“成功地确定了在更大规模试验中开展这项研究的可行性”。

paras.en: Depression Symptoms Improved After a Major Diet Shift
paras.zh: 重大饮食改变后抑郁症状得到改善

paras.en: Participants cut their intake of ultra-processed foods by more than 85%. After doing so, they showed moderate to large improvements across three different measures of depression. Anxiety scores also improved modestly.
paras.zh: 参与者将超加工食品的摄入量减少了 85% 以上。这样做之后，他们在三种不同的抑郁症指标上都表现出了中度到大幅度的改善。焦虑分数也略有改善。

paras.en: Ultra-processed foods include products such as packaged snacks, fast food, sugary drinks, and other industrially manufactured foods. These products may contain ingredients including preservatives, artificial coloring, flavor enhancers, and emulsifiers.
paras.zh: 超加工食品包括包装零食、快餐、含糖饮料和其他工业制造食品等产品。这些产品可能含有防腐剂、人工色素、增味剂和乳化剂等成分。

paras.en: "Reducing the amount of ultra-processed food in our diet can be challenging, because it's highly palatable, cheap, and convenient," said corresponding author Nyasha Chagwedera, MD, PhD, assistant professor in the UCSF Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences. "Ultra-processed food triggers dopamine, the pleasure hormone, which promotes craving. Food companies work with scientists to find just the right amount of sugar, salt, and fat that make you want to eat more and more."
paras.zh: “减少饮食中超加工食品的含量可能具有挑战性，因为它非常美味、便宜且方便，”加州大学旧金山分校精神病学和行为科学系助理教授、通讯作者 Nyasha Chagwedera 博士说。 “超加工食品会引发多巴胺，一种快乐荷尔蒙，会促进食欲。食品公司与科学家合作，寻找适量的糖、盐和脂肪，让你想吃得越来越多。”

paras.en: The participants had an average age of 44, and 70% were female. Along with depression, 14 participants also had anxiety. Everyone in the study had a high BMI and at least one metabolic disorder -- such as hypertension, diabetes, or elevated LDL cholesterol.
paras.zh: 参与者平均年龄为 44 岁，其中 70% 为女性。除抑郁症外，14 名参与者还患有焦虑症。研究中的每个人都有较高的体重指数和至少一种代谢疾病，例如高血压、糖尿病或低密度脂蛋白胆固醇升高。

paras.en: Researchers divided the participants into two groups. One group stayed on its usual diet for four weeks, while the other switched to a diet low in ultra-processed foods. Participants selected and bought their own food with guidance from the research team. After four weeks, the groups switched diets.
paras.zh: 研究人员将参与者分为两组。一组保持正常饮食四个星期，而另一组则改用低加工食品的饮食。参与者在研究团队的指导下选择并购买自己的食物。四个星期后，各组改变饮食。

paras.en: Chagwedera, who founded the UCSF Metabolic and Mental Health Program, said one possible explanation for the connection between ultra-processed food and depression involves what she described as a "leaky, out-of-balance gut." According to this idea, ultra-processed foods may damage the protective lining of the gut.
paras.zh: 加州大学旧金山分校代谢和心理健康项目的创始人查格韦德拉表示，对于超加工食品与抑郁症之间的联系，一种可能的解释是她所说的“肠道渗漏、失衡”。根据这个想法，超加工食品可能会损害肠道的保护层。

paras.en: "This gut damage can create low-grade, chronic inflammation throughout the body that either directly causes depression or makes people more vulnerable to it."
paras.zh: “这种肠道损伤会在全身产生低度慢性炎症，要么直接导致抑郁症，要么使人们更容易受到抑郁症的影响。”

paras.en: "In other words, junky processing may harm your gut in ways that ripple up to your brain."
paras.zh: “换句话来说，垃圾处理可能会损害你的肠道，并波及你的大脑。”

paras.en: Because the study was small, the findings are still preliminary. The researchers now plan to investigate the effect in a larger group, with enrollment for phase 2 expected to begin in 2028.
paras.zh: 由于研究规模较小，研究结果仍处于初步阶段。研究人员现在计划在更大的群体中调查这一效应，第二阶段的入组预计将于 2028 年开始。

paras.en: Authors: Additional UCSF authors include Eliana Kim, MD, Dorothy T. Chiu, PhD, Chengshi Jin, PhD, Catherine Lee PhD. Other authors are Susannah Tye, PhD, of the University of Queensland, Australia, Mayo Clinic, and Emory University.
paras.zh: 作者：加州大学旧金山分校的其他作者包括 Eliana Kim 医学博士、Dorothy T. Chiu 博士、Chengshi Jin 博士、Catherine Lee 博士。其他作者包括澳大利亚昆士兰大学、梅奥诊所和埃默里大学的 Susannah Tye 博士。

paras.en: Funding: National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences, National Institutes of Health, through UCSF-CTSI Grant Number UL1 TR001872; NHLBI grant R38AG070171, NIMH grant R38AG070171, and the UCSF Weill Institute of Neurosciences.
paras.zh: 资助：国立卫生研究院国家转化科学促进中心，通过 UCSF-CTSI 拨款号 UL1 TR001872； NHLBI 拨款 R38AG070171、NIMH 拨款 R38AG070171 和加州大学旧金山分校威尔神经科学研究所。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of California - San Francisco. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加州大学旧金山分校提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - D. Nyasha Chagwedera, Eliana Kim, Dorothy T. Chiu, Chengshi Jin, Catherine Lee, Susannah Tye, Andrew Krystal. Reducing Ultraprocessed Foods From the Diets of Patients With Depression. JAMA Psychiatry, 2026; DOI: 10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2026.2320
paras.zh: - D. Nyasha Chagwedera、Eliana Kim、Dorothy T. Chiu、Chengshi Jin、Catherine Lee、Susannah Tye、Andrew Krystal。减少抑郁症患者饮食中的超加工食品。 《美国医学会杂志》精神病学，2026； DOI：10.1001/jamappsychiatry.2026.2320

articles.title: Ethereal Space Awarded NOAA SBEM Task Order 1
articles.author: Ethereal Space, Inc.

paras.en: DENVER, Colorado – September 2026 – Ethereal Space, Inc. today announced that it has been awarded Task Order 1 under NOAA’s ProTech 2.0 Space-Based Environmental Monitoring (SBEM) program, following NOAA’s official announcement of the award.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州丹佛 – 2026 年 9 月 – 继 NOAA 正式宣布该奖项后，Ethereal Space, Inc. 今天宣布，该公司已获得 NOAA ProTech 2.0 天基环境监测 (SBEM) 计划的 1 号任务订单。

paras.en: The 24-month Task Order has a total contract value of approximately $27.4 million, with initial data deliveries scheduled to begin December 1, 2026.
paras.zh: 该任务订单为期 24 个月，合同总价值约为 2740 万美元，初始数据交付计划于 2026 年 12 月 1 日开始。

paras.en: Under the SBEM program, Ethereal Space will provide commercial space-based environmental observations supporting NOAA’s operational mission. Ethereal’s capabilities span GNSS radio occultation for atmospheric and ionospheric observations, thermospheric neutral-density measurements, and multispectral visible and infrared imagery.
paras.zh: 根据 SBEM 计划，Ethereal Space 将提供商业天基环境观测，支持 NOAA 的业务任务。 Ethereal 的功能涵盖用于大气和电离层观测的 GNSS 无线电掩星、热层中性密度测量以及多光谱可见光和红外图像。

paras.en: “This award represents an important transition for Ethereal Space from building and demonstrating new observing capabilities to delivering operational environmental data at scale,” said Shawn Cochran, CEO and Co-Founder of Ethereal Space. “We are proud to support NOAA’s mission and to contribute commercial observations that improve our understanding of the atmosphere, ionosphere, and space environment.”
paras.zh: Ethereal Space 首席执行官兼联合创始人 Shawn Cochran 表示：“该奖项代表了 Ethereal Space 从构建和展示新观测能力到大规模提供运营环境数据的重要转变。” “我们很自豪能够支持 N​​OAA 的使命，并贡献商业观测，以提高我们对大气、电离层和太空环境的了解。”

paras.en: Ethereal Space is deploying a growing constellation of small satellites and specialized sensors designed to transform space-based observations into actionable environmental intelligence for government, commercial, and scientific users.
paras.zh: Ethereal Space 正在部署越来越多的小型卫星和专用传感器，旨在将天基观测结果转化为政府、商业和科学用户可操作的环境情报。

paras.en: Ethereal Space develops and operates commercial satellite systems, environmental sensors, and data products focused on Earth and space weather observation. The company’s mission is to provide timely, affordable observations and turn those measurements into actionable environmental intelligence.
paras.zh: Ethereal Space 开发和运营专注于地球和空间天气观测的商业卫星系统、环境传感器和数据产品。该公司的使命是提供及时、经济的观测结果，并将这些测量结果转化为可操作的环境情报。

articles.title: Moog Completes ISO Class 8 Clean Room at Niagara Falls Facility to Expand Thruster Production
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, NY — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) announced the completion and commissioning of a new ISO Class 8 certified clean room at its Niagara Falls facility. This advanced manufacturing environment is now fully operational and will accelerate Moog’s assembly, integration, and testing of thrusters to support a growing portfolio of defense and commercial spaceflight programs.
paras.zh: 纽约东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）宣布其尼亚加拉瀑布工厂一座新的 ISO 8 级认证洁净室竣工并投入使用。这一先进的制造环境现已全面投入运行，将加速穆格推进器的组装、集成和测试，以支持不断增长的国防和商业航天项目组合。

paras.en: Completed on schedule, the expansion increases dedicated clean room capacity by more than 80% and is specifically designed for continuous, multi-shift operations for thrusters and propulsion systems. The new environment seamlessly supports the full production flow, from precision subassembly and integration through hot-fire testing, enabling Moog to shorten lead times and respond more rapidly to evolving mission requirements.
paras.zh: 该扩建项目如期完成，专用洁净室容量增加了 80% 以上，专为推进器和推进系统的连续、多班次操作而设计。新环境无缝支持整个生产流程，从精密分装和集成到热测试，使穆格能够缩短交货时间并更快地响应不断变化的任务要求。

paras.en: “As national security priorities evolve, we are rapidly transforming our manufacturing footprint to enable faster, higher-volume delivery of critical defense capabilities,” said Mark Covelli, senior vice president, Moog Space Division. “Our investments in capacity, workforce, and advanced production technologies ensure we can support the accelerated timelines demanded by missile defense, space-based interceptor, and Golden Dome programs.”
paras.zh: 穆格航天事业部高级副总裁马克·科维利 (Mark Covelli) 表示：“随着国家安全优先事项的发展，我们正在迅速改变我们的制造足迹，以实现更快、更大批量地交付关键防御能力。” “我们在产能、劳动力和先进生产技术方面的投资确保我们能够支持导弹防御、天基拦截器和金顶计划所需的加速时间表。”

paras.en: “Our Niagara Falls clean room is a foundational enhancement for our propulsion business,” said Mike Popadick, general manager, Propulsion Systems. “With this expanded, purpose-built space, we are equipped to ramp up production while maintaining the precise quality and reliability our customers expect, whether for satellites, lunar landers, or defense applications.”
paras.zh: “我们的尼亚加拉瀑布洁净室是我们推进业务的基础增强，”推进系统总经理 Mike Popadick 说。 “通过这个扩大的专用空间，我们有能力提高产量，同时保持客户期望的精确质量和可靠性，无论是卫星、月球着陆器还是国防应用。”

paras.en: The new clean room integrates seamlessly with the broader Niagara Falls site, home to four in-house high-altitude hot-fire test chambers and extensive engineering capabilities, reinforcing Moog’s vertically integrated propulsion expertise. Since breaking ground on this expansion, Moog has also added dozens of new operations and engineering roles to support continued growth while upholding best-in-class quality and safety standards.
paras.zh: 新的洁净室与更广阔的尼亚加拉大瀑布场地无缝集成，拥有四个内部高空热火测试室和广泛的工程能力，增强了穆格的垂直集成推进专业知识。自此次扩建破土动工以来，穆格还增加了数十个新的运营和工程职位，以支持持续增长，同时坚持一流的质量和安全标准。

paras.en: Moog’s propulsion systems have powered missions throughout the solar system. This latest clean room completion further solidifies Moog’s 75-year legacy of innovation, precision engineering, and commitment to enabling exploration and defense.
paras.zh: 穆格的推进系统为整个太阳系的任务提供了动力。最新的洁净室竣工进一步巩固了穆格 75 年的创新、精密工程以及对勘探和防御的承诺的传统。
