Football | Andy Burnham’s intervention in the Manchester City debate has revived tensions between the Premier League and the prime minister.
Our critics’ roundup of the best things to watch, read, play and listen to right now

This Northern Ireland-set police drama has always been modern but never explicitly topical. Until now. Race riots, organised crime and institutional politics bring it bang up to date. Read Jack Seale’s full review.

In the jazz-soul singer’s ‘expression of queer liberation’, stars from Chaka Khan to Bill Callahan to Cynthia Erivo duet on equally varied songs from Cher to the Human League and beyond. Read Alexis Petridis’s full review.
Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie (in cinemas now) | ★★★★☆
Alex Gibney’s documentary follows the celebrated author’s life up to and after the attack, but what shines through is Rushdie’s remarkable courage. Read Peter Bradshaw’s full review.
Renoir and Love (National Gallery, London, from tomorrow) | ★★★★★

Grab your straw boater – and revel in the Impressionist’s light-as-souffle masterpieces that celebrate life’s pleasures, from picnics to dances to frolics in the bushes. Read Jonathan Jones’s full review.

The Guardian splashes with “Welfare changes may axe disability benefit for young”. The Times leads with “Emergency diesel talks after Trump ultimatum” and the Telegraph says “Trump tells Europe to release diesel”. The Mail runs with “Labour frees first of 10 tidal waves of convicts”, while The i Paper has “Burnham leaving the door open to snap general election in 2027”. The Sun, on Andy Burnham’s Manchester City comments, says “Own goal”. The Financial Times goes with “Global bond sell-off leaves US trapped in vicious loop”, and the Mirror leads on an interview with a survivor of the Manchester synagogue attack, saying “He stabbed me 3 times but I had to stop him”.
US woman on death row survives two lethal injections in Tennessee

A woman convicted of murdering a schoolmate 30 years ago has been taken to hospital after surviving two rounds of lethal injections in Tennessee. Christa Pike would have been the first woman to be executed in the state in 200 years. Pike, 50, has spent three decades on death row after she was convicted of the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in 1995. A last-minute appeal to stop the lethal injection was overturned by the supreme court, but the state governor, Bill Lee, has suspended executions in Tennessee for the rest of the year. Lucy Hough speaks to the attorney and anti-capital punishment campaigner Clive Stafford Smith.
A bit of good news to remind you that the world’s not all bad
Eleven-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan has become the youngest ever ‘woman grandmaster’ at the Chess Olympiad in Uzbekistan – while playing on a car booster seat so she could reach the board.

Sivanandan, who lives in Harrow, was taught to play by her father when she was five. Within a year, she was beating him and by eight she had beaten the former British champion Peter Lee. If she reaches a rating of 2,500 in the next 11 months, she will become the world’s youngest ever outright grandmaster.

She fits her chess career around school, but takes everything in her stride. “Now that I’m in secondary school there might be more homework,” she says, “but I should be able to manage”. Her ultimate ambition, she says, is simply to be the best chess player in the world.
And finally, the Guardian’s puzzles are here to keep you entertained throughout the day. Until tomorrow.

articles.title: Australia news live: Union leader says PM ‘vastly underpaid’; Shoebridge pledges members will ‘have a say’ in next leader
articles.author: Achol Arok (now) and Nick Visser (earlier)

paras.en: Jeff Lapidos, who leads a branch of the Australian Services Union that represents Tax Office staff, has spent more than a decade fighting for better pay and conditions. He has also seen significant job cuts.
paras.zh: 杰夫·拉皮多斯（ Jeff Lapidos ）领导着代表税务局工作人员的澳大利亚服务联盟的一个分支机构，他花了十多年的时间争取更好的薪酬和条件。他还看到了大幅裁员。

paras.en: When asked about the Future Fund salaries, Lapidos said he did not believe in common salary levels across the public service. He said officials should instead be paid for the value of their work.
paras.zh: 当被问及未来基金的薪酬时， Lapidos表示，他不相信整个公共服务部门的共同薪酬水平。他说，官员的工作价值应该得到报酬。

paras.en: After inflation, the value of ATO employees’ salaries has fallen by 9.55% over the last 13 years. This is disgraceful exploitation by successive Coalition and Labor governments.
paras.zh: 在通货膨胀之后， ATO员工的工资价值在过去13年中下降了9.55%。这是历届联盟和工党政府的可耻剥削。

paras.en: The ASU is campaigning for pay justice for all ATO staff. The prime minister deserves pay justice too. His office is vastly underpaid.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州立大学正在为所有ATO员工争取薪酬公正。总理也应该得到公正的待遇。他的办公室薪水严重偏低。

paras.en: A big four bank is ending its relationship with its auditor of nearly six decades in the latest fallout from a whistleblower scandal,AAP reports.
paras.zh: 据AAP报道，一家四大银行正在结束与其审计师近六十年的关系，这是举报人丑闻的最新后果。

paras.en: KPMG has been ANZ’s auditor since 1969 and while the partners who worked on the audit have regularly rotated, the bank is looking for a new firm.
paras.zh: 毕马威自1969年以来一直担任澳新银行的审计师，虽然参与审计的合伙人定期轮换，但该银行正在寻找一家新公司。

paras.en: KPMG earned $21.4 million for auditing and reviewing ANZ’s accounts in 2024/25, with its total fees including non-audit services coming to $29.6 million for that financial year.
paras.zh: 毕马威在2024/25年度审计和审查澳新银行账户赚取了2140万$ ，包括非审计服务在内的总费用在该财政年度达到2960万$。

paras.en: A tenure of this length is no longer considered appropriate and has been under consideration by the board for some time.
paras.zh: 如此长的任期不再被认为是合适的，董事会已经考虑了一段时间。

paras.en: The tender process would end in April and KPMG won’t be eligible to participate, the bank said.
paras.zh: 该银行表示，招标过程将于4月结束，毕马威将没有资格参加。

paras.en: ANZ will start a competitive tender process to select a new auditor beginning with the 2028/29 financial year.
paras.zh: 澳新银行将启动竞争性招标流程，从2028/29财政年度开始挑选新审计师。

paras.en: Federal court justice Jonathan Beach heard evidence on Friday to help decide whether two separate cases against Medibank will be held jointly or as separate trials, AAP reports.
paras.zh: 据AAP报道，联邦法院法官乔纳森·比奇（ Jonathan Beach ）周五听取了证据，以帮助决定针对Medibank的两起单独案件是将联合举行还是作为单独的审判进行。

paras.en: The health insurer is facing both a class action by affected customers and civil penalties brought by the privacy watchdog over the 2022 hack.
After Medibank declined to pay a ransom, personal data was leaked on the dark web under malicious file names, including boozy, STD and psycho.
A lawyer for the class action argued it was in the interests of justice to hear the cases together. Wendy Harris KC said.
The technical issues here overlap and intersect at multiple stages … in terms of the architecture of Medibank’s cybersecurity systems [and] the control deficiencies in them.

Neil Young KC, who is representing Medibank in both matters, called the class action a “total mess”, saying it went well beyond the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner’s case in its allegations of cybersecurity failures.
There are many new allegations of breach.
In order for us to address those new allegations, that’s going to require time.
Beach adjourned the matter until 16 October, in part to allow the class action party to consolidate its statement of claim.

Jeff Lapidos, who leads a branch of the Australian Services Union that represents Tax Office staff, has spent more than a decade fighting for better pay and conditions. He has also seen significant job cuts.
paras.zh: 杰夫·拉皮多斯（ Jeff Lapidos ）领导着代表税务局工作人员的澳大利亚服务联盟的一个分支机构，他花了十多年的时间争取更好的薪酬和条件。他还看到了大幅裁员。

paras.en: When asked about the Future Fund salaries, Lapidos said he did not believe in common salary levels across the public service. He said officials should instead be paid for the value of their work.
paras.zh: 当被问及未来基金的薪酬时， Lapidos表示，他不相信整个公共服务部门的共同薪酬水平。他说，官员的工作价值应该得到报酬。

paras.en: After inflation, the value of ATO employees’ salaries has fallen by 9.55% over the last 13 years. This is disgraceful exploitation by successive Coalition and Labor governments.
paras.zh: 在通货膨胀之后， ATO员工的工资价值在过去13年中下降了9.55%。这是历届联盟和工党政府的可耻剥削。

paras.en: The ASU is campaigning for pay justice for all ATO staff. The prime minister deserves pay justice too. His office is vastly underpaid.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州立大学正在为所有ATO员工争取薪酬公正。总理也应该得到公正的待遇。他的办公室薪水严重偏低。

paras.en: A big four bank is ending its relationship with its auditor of nearly six decades in the latest fallout from a whistleblower scandal, AAP reports.
KPMG has been ANZ’s auditor since 1969 and while the partners who worked on the audit have regularly rotated, the bank is looking for a new firm.
paras.zh: 毕马威自1969年以来一直担任澳新银行的审计师，虽然参与审计的合伙人定期轮换，但该银行正在寻找一家新公司。

paras.en: “A tenure of this length is no longer considered appropriate and has been under consideration by the board for some time,” ANZ said in a statement on Friday.
ANZ will begin a competitive tender process to select a new auditor beginning with the 2028-29 financial year.

The tender process will wind up in April and KPMG won’t be eligible to participate, the bank said. KPMG earned $21.4m for auditing and reviewing ANZ’s accounts in 2024-25, with its total fees, including non-audit services, coming to $29.6m for that financial year.
Shoebridge says party members will get input into leadership changes
New Greens leader David Shoebridge says ordinary party members will have input into the next leadership decision, pledging a “conversation” to occur across branches and membership.

The Greens’ party room chooses its federal leader, which is the same as the Liberal and Nationals, but unlike Labor, which has a party room and membership vote. Shoebridge said this week, in announcing his leadership tilt, that he supported membership having a say; Mehreen Faruqi, who was unsuccessful in her leadership candidacy, said after the party room vote that she wanted members to have input.
In a social media video this afternoon, with the caption “your say on Greens leadership”, Shoebridge said: “You absolutely should have a say in the leadership for the Greens”.
“The good news is Steph [Hodgins-May] and I are gonna make this happen,” he said.

Shoebridge didn’t commit to any specific type of model, but said it would be “a conversation we’re going to have right across the Greens. Every state and territory, hundreds and hundreds of branches, thousands and thousands of members, because members want to be engaged in this.”

Shoebridge committed that the change would happen “before we make the next decision on the federal leadership”, which under Greens rules, happens after every federal election – so, in other words, in this term of parliament.
City of Yarra mayor cleared of assault allegation at election party
A prominent mayor has been cleared of punching a community activist who had gatecrashed his election after-party, Australian Associated Press reports.
The City of Yarra mayor Stephen Jolly, 64, said he was relieved to be acquitted of unlawful assault after Melbourne magistrate Jill Prior handed down her decision on Friday.

Jolly, whose council includes Carlton North, Collingwood and Richmond, fought the charge at a contested hearing, denying he intentionally struck activist Estella Burrows in the face on 1 November 2024.
Burrows and two other masked protesters had gatecrashed Jolly’s election after-party at a Collingwood venue, holding a banner and using a megaphone to accuse Jolly of abuse.

It was alleged Jolly punched Burrows to the face as he and other attendees forced the group to leave. The mayor denied intentionally hitting Burrows and separately argued he was acting in self-defence.
The magistrate on Friday determined Jolly did strike the left side of Burrows but she could not be satisfied he did so intentionally.
It was possible Jolly had been trying to disarm the group of their megaphone or he was reaching forward to move them away, the magistrate determined.
As a result, she found Jolly not guilty of the unlawful assault charge.
Outside court, Burrows told reporters she was disappointed but not surprised at the decision, claiming the justice system only worked in the favour of powerful white men.
Death row inmate Christa Pike survives two lethal injections in Tennessee – The Latest
The convicted murderer Christa Pike, sentenced to death, has survived two lethal injections and was taken to hospital.

Pike, 50, has spent three decades on death row after she was convicted of the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in 1995. She would have been the first woman to be executed in Tennessee in 200 years.
A last-minute appeal to stop the lethal injection was overturned by the supreme court, but the state governor, Bill Lee, has suspended executions in Tennessee for the rest of the year.
Lucy Hough speaks to the attorney and anti-capital punishment campaigner Clive Stafford Smith about the case in The Latest.

articles.title: Australia says platforms like Steam and Roblox have 'significant' child safety gaps

paras.en: Australia's online safety regulator has found "significant gaps" in how popular gaming platforms protect children online.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的在线安全监管机构发现，流行的游戏平台在如何保护儿童在线方面存在“重大差距”。

paras.en: In a new report it found inconsistent approaches in how Steam, Roblox, Fortnite and Minecraft implement child safety measures as research shows nine out of 10 children aged 8 to 17 in Australia have played online games.
paras.zh: 在一份新报告中，它发现Steam、Roblox、Fortnite和Minecraft实施儿童安全措施的方式不一致，因为研究表明，澳大利亚8至17岁的10名儿童中有9名玩过在线游戏。

paras.en: "Australian children have a right to play online without being exposed to predators, sexual extortionists, violent extremist content or other harmful material," eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant said.
paras.zh: eSafety专员朱莉·英曼·格兰特（ Julie Inman Grant ）说： “澳大利亚儿童有权在网上玩耍，而不会接触到掠夺者、性勒索者、暴力极端主义内容或其他有害材料。”

paras.en: Roblox said it "prioritises the safety of our Australian community, especially the youngest users". The other platforms have been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: Roblox表示，它“优先考虑我们澳大利亚社区的安全，特别是最年轻的用户”。已联系其他平台征求意见。

paras.en: Weak safety on platforms allow "predatory adults" to make contact with children before grooming them, Inman Grant said, for sexual exploitation or radicalisation.
paras.zh: 英曼·格兰特（ Inman Grant ）说，平台上的安全薄弱，允许“掠夺性成年人”在培养儿童之前与他们接触，以进行性剥削或激进化。

paras.en: The report found that Valve - the US gaming giant that owns Steam and Steam Chat - was the only provider that did not use a type of technology widely used by the industry to detect and remove known harmful content.
paras.zh: 该报告发现，拥有Steam和Steam Chat的美国游戏巨头Valve是唯一一家没有使用业界广泛使用的技术来检测和删除已知有害内容的供应商。

paras.en: Valve also did not "proactively" use tools to detect child sexual exploitation or violent material in chats, with current systems mainly flagging scams, the report found.
paras.zh: 报告发现， Valve也没有“主动”使用工具来检测聊天中的儿童性剥削或暴力材料，目前的系统主要是标记诈骗。

paras.en: Roblox, along with Valve, were noted in the report as using only internal datasets to train language detection systems and for not regularly retraining these models.
paras.zh: 报告中指出， Roblox和Valve仅使用内部数据集来训练语言检测系统，并且没有定期重新训练这些模型。

paras.en: "We expect these services to lift their game to identify and combat serious harms such as child sexual exploitation, sexual extortion and material and activity which promotes, incites or instructs violence," Inman-Grant said.
paras.zh: 英曼-格兰特说： “我们希望这些服务能够提升他们的游戏水平，以识别和打击严重的伤害，如儿童性剥削、性勒索以及促进、煽动或指示暴力的材料和活动。”

paras.en: Minecraft and Fortnite, which does offer child accounts, generally let users self-declare their age, the report highlighted, meaning anyone who said they were adults could access "higher-risk communication features".
paras.zh: 报告强调，《我的世界》（ Minecraft ）和《堡垒之夜》（ Fortnite ）确实提供儿童账户，通常允许用户自我声明他们的年龄，这意味着任何声称自己是成年人的人都可以使用“高风险沟通功能”。

paras.en: Steam also relied on users self-declaring their age but the report acknowledged the platform had recently introduced age checks using credit cards, and that Roblox had put in stronger age checks since last December.
paras.zh: Steam还依赖用户自我声明他们的年龄，但报告承认该平台最近引入了使用信用卡的年龄检查，并且Roblox自去年12月以来已经实施了更严格的年龄检查。

paras.en: Another issue raised by the report was the inconsistent manner in which the four gaming platforms shared information and participated in industry initiatives.
paras.zh: 该报告提出的另一个问题是，四个游戏平台共享信息和参与行业举措的方式不一致。

paras.en: Mojang Studios, developer of Minecraft, and Roblox shared industry expertise in combating child sexual exploitation as well as violent extremism online, but Valve did not.
paras.zh: Minecraft的开发商Mojang Studios和Roblox在打击儿童性剥削和暴力极端主义方面分享了行业专业知识，但Valve没有这样做。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Fortnite maker Epic Games failed to share instances of breaches with other platforms under a global programme that was designed to combat online child sexual exploitation and abuse.
paras.zh: 在其他地方， Fortnite制造商Epic Games未能根据旨在打击在线儿童性剥削和性虐待的全球计划与其他平台分享违规行为的实例。

paras.en: The report was based on information collected by Australia's eSafety Commission on how the platforms were protecting users from serious online harm between October 2025 and March 2026.
paras.zh: 该报告基于澳大利亚电子安全委员会收集的信息，涉及平台如何在2025年10月至2026年3月期间保护用户免受严重的在线伤害。

paras.en: Australia has made global headlines in recent years for its stance on online safety, after it introduced its world-leading social media ban for under-16s last December - which did not include gaming platforms - and a more recent push to force tech giants to offer users a chance to opt-out of social media algorithms.
paras.zh: 去年12月，澳大利亚推出了针对16岁以下儿童的世界领先的社交媒体禁令（不包括游戏平台） ，以及最近迫使科技巨头为用户提供退出社交媒体算法的机会，此后，澳大利亚近年来因其在在线安全方面的立场而成为全球头条新闻。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Roblox said it had "invested heavily" in its safeguards for children which include mandatory age checks.
paras.zh: Roblox的一位发言人表示，它已“大力投资”其儿童保障措施，包括强制性年龄检查。

paras.en: Valve, Fortnite, and Microsoft - which owns Minecraft - have been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: Valve、Fortnite和微软（拥有Minecraft ）已被联系以征求意见。

articles.title: US pressures Europe over diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban

paras.en: Donald Trump has said he may ask European countries to release some of their diesel reserves as he mulls a ban on US exports of the fuel amid a global shortage.
paras.zh: 唐纳德特朗普表示，他可能会要求欧洲国家释放部分柴油储备，因为在全球短缺的情况下，他正在考虑禁止美国出口这种燃料。

paras.en: The comments followed his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urging Europe to immediately ready and release such supplies, arguing that US "farmers, truckers, and businesses should not be left carrying the burden" as prices soar.
paras.zh: 此前，他的财政部长斯科特·贝森特（ Scott Bessent ）敦促欧洲立即准备好并释放此类供应，称随着价格飙升，美国的“农民、卡车司机和企业不应背负负担”。

paras.en: The US has threatened to restrict diesel exports amid surging costs due to the war in Iran. The issue is top of mind for US voters ahead of the crucial midterm elections.
paras.zh: 在伊朗战争导致成本飙升的情况下，美国威胁要限制柴油出口。在关键的中期选举之前，这个问题是美国选民的首要考虑因素。

paras.en: On Thursday, the UK held talks with European partners about the potential release of diesel reserves in response to any ban.
paras.zh: 周四，英国与欧洲合作伙伴就针对任何禁令释放柴油储备的可能性举行了会谈。

paras.en: The US is a vital supplier of diesel to the world, exporting between 1.2 and 1.5 million barrels per day, with experts warning a ban on shipments abroad could put further pressure on prices in other countries.
paras.zh: 美国是全球重要的柴油供应国，每天出口120万至150万桶，专家警告说，禁止向国外出口可能会对其他国家的价格造成进一步压力。

paras.en: "We're thinking about it very seriously," Trump said of an export ban at the weekend.
paras.zh: “我们正在认真考虑这个问题，”特朗普在周末谈到出口禁令时说。

paras.en: On Thursday Trump added that he may ask European countries to release some of their diesel reserves, while Bessent said they should do so "immediately".
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普补充说，他可能会要求欧洲国家释放部分柴油储备，而贝森特表示，他们应该“立即”这样做。

paras.en: "Our European partners should accelerate delivery on their existing commitments and make additional supplies immediately available to address ongoing disruptions," Bessent said in a post on social media.
paras.zh: 贝森特在社交媒体上的一篇帖子中说： “我们的欧洲合作伙伴应该加快履行现有承诺，并立即提供更多供应，以应对持续的中断。”

paras.en: The plans come weeks ahead of November elections in the US, where control of Congress will be up for grabs. The president is set to travel across the US campaigning for Republicans in hopes of keeping control of the House and Senate.
paras.zh: 这些计划将在美国11月大选前几周出台，届时国会的控制权将被争夺。总统将前往美国各地为共和党人竞选，希望保持对众议院和参议院的控制。

paras.en: Diesel prices in the UK hit record highs this week and are hovering just under 200p per litre, according to motoring organisation the RAC.
paras.zh: 根据汽车组织RAC的数据，英国柴油价格本周创下历史新高，目前徘徊在每升200便士以下。

paras.en: UK Energy Minister Martin McCluskey was on a call with European counterparts on Thursday to discuss the potential ban.
paras.zh: 英国能源大臣马丁·麦克卢斯基（ Martin McCluskey ）周四与欧洲同行通话，讨论潜在的禁令。

paras.en: A source familiar with the discussions told the BBC it was prudent to prepare a co-ordinated response with other countries, including those across EU, but added that there were still European reserves left from a coordinated release of strategic fuel stocks earlier in the year.
paras.zh: 一位熟悉讨论情况的消息人士告诉英国广播公司，与其他国家（包括欧盟各国）准备协调应对是谨慎的，但他补充说，今年早些时候协调释放战略燃料库存后，仍有欧洲储备。

paras.en: "We have a diverse and resilient supply.â¯We continue to engage with our international partners and the UK fuel industry," a government spokesperson said. The government has stressed that there is no cause for concern about potential diesel shortages, though prices are expected to rise further.
paras.zh: 政府发言人表示： “我们拥有多样化且有弹性的供应。”我们将继续与国际合作伙伴和英国燃料行业合作。政府强调，尽管价格预计将进一步上涨，但没有理由担心潜在的柴油短缺。

paras.en: A European Commission spokesperson said today that there were "lots of calls, lots of meetings" taking place on the diesel situation, including with "high level contacts" in the US administration.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会发言人今天表示，就柴油问题进行了“大量电话和会议” ，包括美国政府的“高级别接触”。

paras.en: Potentially adding to the pressure on the global diesel market, Chinese refiners have reportedly halted October exports of some fuel products as Beijing prioritises domestic supplies.
paras.zh: 据报道，由于北京优先考虑国内供应，中国炼油厂已停止10月份部分燃料产品的出口，这可能会增加全球柴油市场的压力。

paras.en: The BBC has contacted the Chinese embassy in Washington for comment.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司已联系中国驻华盛顿大使馆征求意见。

paras.en: Prices of petrol and diesel globally have skyrocketed since the outbreak of the US-Israel war in Iran in February. The closure of the vital Strait of Hormuz, which typically transports around a fifth of the world's oil and gas, has pushed up the price of products made from oil.
paras.zh: 自2月美以战争爆发以来，全球汽油和柴油价格飙升。重要的霍尔木兹海峡的关闭推高了石油产品的价格，该海峡通常运输全球约五分之一的石油和天然气。

paras.en: An export ban from Russia, also a major supplier of diesel, has added to the pressure on prices.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯也是柴油的主要供应国，其出口禁令加剧了价格压力。

paras.en: Trump has argued that keeping any surplus barrels of diesel in the US would lower pump prices domestically, offering immediate relief to drivers, truckers, and businesses ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 特朗普认为，在中期选举之前，在美国保留任何过剩的柴油桶将降低国内油价，从而为司机、卡车司机和企业提供即时救济。

paras.en: But David Fyfe, chief economist at Argus Media, said cutting off American supply would likely cause international prices to skyrocket.
paras.zh: 但阿格斯传媒(Argus Media)首席经济学家戴维•法伊夫(David Fyfe)表示，切断美国供应可能会导致国际价格飙升。

paras.en: Diesel prices have hit an all-time high in the UK, with the latest RAC figures showing average pump prices at 199.79p per litre, up from 142.38p
paras.zh: 英国柴油价格创历史新高，最新的RAC数据显示平均泵价为每升199.79便士，高于142.38便士

paras.en: Diesel is harder to refine than gasoline and, because it is used by the haulage industry and in agriculture, it is very difficult to reduce demand.
paras.zh: 柴油比汽油更难提炼，由于运输业和农业使用柴油，因此很难减少需求。

paras.en: The UK is heavily reliant on imports. Although the four refineries in the UK make more than enough petrol to meet demand, they do not make enough diesel for the country's needs.
paras.zh: 英国严重依赖进口。尽管英国的四个炼油厂生产的汽油足以满足需求，但它们没有足够的柴油来满足该国的需求。

paras.en: There were 15.1 million diesel vehicles on UK roads at the end of June, according to the Department for Transport. That is a drop from 15.7 million a year before.
paras.zh: 根据交通部的数据，截至6月底，英国道路上有1510万辆柴油车。这比一年前的1570万有所下降。

paras.en: There were 9.8 million diesel cars, down year on year from 10.4 million.
paras.zh: 有980万辆柴油车，同比下降1040万辆。

articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as northern conflict escalates

paras.en: Ethiopia and Eritrea have severed diplomatic relations as renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia raises fears of a wider regional conflict.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚断绝了外交关系，因为埃塞俄比亚北部重新爆发的战斗引发了对更广泛地区冲突的担忧。

paras.en: On Thursday, Ethiopia announced that it was closing its embassy in the Eritrean capital, Asmara, and ordered 10 Eritrean diplomats to leave the country within 48 hours, accusing them of activities that threatened national security.
paras.zh: 周四，埃塞俄比亚宣布关闭其在厄立特里亚首都阿斯马拉的大使馆，并命令10名厄立特里亚外交官在48小时内离开该国，指责他们从事威胁国家安全的活动。

paras.en: Eritrea responded by cutting diplomatic relations, saying Ethiopia's decision had left it with no choice but to take reciprocal action.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚的回应是切断外交关系，称埃塞俄比亚的决定使其别无选择，只能采取对等行动。

paras.en: The diplomatic confrontation came hours after powerful explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopian capital, Addis Ababa, including near Ethiopia's military headquarters.
paras.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴（ Addis Ababa ） ，包括埃塞俄比亚军事总部附近，隔夜听到强烈爆炸声数小时后，发生了外交对抗。

paras.en: It follows a sharp deterioration in relations between the neighbours, with Addis Ababa accusing Eritrea of supporting an alliance of armed groups fighting the Ethiopian government â an allegation Asmara has repeatedly denied.
paras.zh: 在此之前，邻国之间的关系急剧恶化，亚的斯亚贝巴指责厄立特里亚支持与埃塞俄比亚政府作战的武装团体联盟-阿斯马拉一再否认这一指控。

paras.en: Ethiopia said it was expelling 10 Eritrean diplomats who "pose a direct threat to Ethiopia's national security" and would shut its embassy in Asmara.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚表示，它正在驱逐10名“对埃塞俄比亚国家安全构成直接威胁”的厄立特里亚外交官，并将关闭其在阿斯马拉的大使馆。

paras.en: In response, Eritrea announced on late Thursday that it was severing diplomatic ties with Ethiopia, describing Addis Ababa's decision as "astounding".
paras.zh: 作为回应，厄立特里亚周四晚些时候宣布与埃塞俄比亚断绝外交关系，称亚的斯亚贝巴的决定“令人震惊”。

paras.en: "Eritrea has no option but to reciprocate in kind and sever all diplomatic ties with Ethiopia," its foreign ministry said, warning of "negative corollaries" from the decision.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚外交部表示， “厄立特里亚别无选择，只能以实物回报并切断与埃塞俄比亚的所有外交关系” ，并警告该决定会产生“负面推论”。

paras.en: The diplomatic fallout comes as Ethiopian federal forces battle fighters from the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and its allies across parts of Tigray, Afar and Amhara.
paras.zh: 外交影响来自埃塞俄比亚联邦部队与提格雷人民解放阵线（ TPLF ）及其盟友在提格雷、阿法尔和阿姆哈拉部分地区的战斗。

paras.en: The latest hostilities are the most serious since a peace agreement ended the devastating Tigray war in 2022. An African Union mediator previously estimated that about 600,000 people died during that two-year conflict.
paras.zh: 自2022年和平协议结束了毁灭性的提格雷战争以来，最近的敌对行动最为严重。一位非洲联盟调解员此前估计，在这场为期两年的冲突中，约有60万人死亡。

paras.en: Last month, the TPLF joined six other armed movements, including the Fano militia from Amhara, to form an alliance whose stated objective is to remove Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government from power.
paras.zh: 上个月，蒂格雷人阵加入了其他六个武装运动，包括来自阿姆哈拉的法诺民兵，组成了一个联盟，其公开目标是将总理阿比·艾哈迈德的政府赶下台。

paras.en: Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of helping the alliance.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚指责厄立特里亚帮助该联盟。

paras.en: A pro-government militia commander fighting in Tigray also told the BBC that Eritrean soldiers had been involved on the front lines. The BBC has not independently verified the allegation.
paras.zh: 在提格雷作战的一名亲政府民兵指挥官也告诉英国广播公司，厄立特里亚士兵参与了前线。英国广播公司尚未独立核实这一指控。

paras.en: But in a rare interview with the BBC before diplomatic relations were severed, Eritrea's Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel rejected the accusations.
paras.zh: 但在外交关系断绝之前，厄立特里亚新闻部长叶马尼·格布雷梅斯克尔（ Yemane Gebremeskel ）罕见地接受了英国广播公司的采访，驳斥了这些指控。

paras.en: He told BBC Tigrinya that Ethiopia's governing Prosperity Party was blaming neighbouring countries to divert attention from conflicts and other problems within Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 他告诉BBC提格里尼亚，埃塞俄比亚执政的繁荣党指责邻国转移对埃塞俄比亚内部冲突和其他问题的注意力。

paras.en: The two countries were allies during the 2020-2022 Tigray war, when Eritrean troops fought alongside Ethiopian federal forces against the TPLF.
paras.zh: 在2020-2022年提格雷战争期间，两国是盟友，当时厄立特里亚军队与埃塞俄比亚联邦部队一起对抗蒂格雷人民解放阵线。

paras.en: But relations have deteriorated significantly since then, particularly over Ethiopia's push for direct access to the Red Sea. Asmara accuses Ethiopia of pursuing what it describes as an increasingly hostile policy over the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 但自那时以来，两国关系严重恶化，特别是在埃塞俄比亚推动直接进入红海的情况下。阿斯马拉指责埃塞俄比亚在红海问题上奉行日益敌对的政策。

paras.en: Landlocked Ethiopia lost its coastline when Eritrea became independent in 1993.
paras.zh: 1993年厄立特里亚独立后，内陆埃塞俄比亚失去了海岸线。

paras.en: Abiy has repeatedly argued that access to the sea is essential to Ethiopia's long-term economic and security interests, while Eritrea has accused his government of harbouring ambitions over its ports.
paras.zh: 阿比一再辩称，出海对埃塞俄比亚的长期经济和安全利益至关重要，而厄立特里亚则指责其政府对其港口抱有野心。

paras.en: The latest diplomatic confrontation came hours after loud explosions were heard on Wednesday night in Addis Ababa, close to the headquarters of the intelligence service.
paras.zh: 最近的外交对抗是在周三晚上在靠近情报部门总部的亚的斯亚贝巴听到巨大爆炸声几小时后发生的。

paras.en: A source linked to the opposition alliance told Reuters news agency that its forces had carried out drone attacks in the capital. Ethiopian authorities have not confirmed what caused the explosions, and there have been no official reports of casualties or significant damage.
paras.zh: 一名与反对派联盟有关的消息人士告诉路透社，其部队在首都进行了无人机袭击。埃塞俄比亚当局尚未证实造成爆炸的原因，也没有关于人员伤亡或重大损失的官方报告。

paras.en: Residents in two areas of Addis Ababa separately told the BBC that they heard powerful explosions during the night. One resident near the intelligence headquarters said the blast was loud enough to trigger car alarms.
paras.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴两个地区的居民分别告诉英国广播公司，他们在夜间听到了强烈的爆炸声。情报总部附近的一名居民说，爆炸的声音足以触发汽车警报。

paras.en: The explosions came hours after Ethiopia's National Intelligence and Security Service imposed an indefinite ban on drone flights over Addis Ababa and surrounding areas, citing the need to protect senior officials, important infrastructure and public events.
paras.zh: 爆炸发生在埃塞俄比亚国家情报和安全局无限期禁止无人机飞越亚的斯亚贝巴及其周边地区数小时后，理由是需要保护高级官员、重要基础设施和公共活动。

paras.en: Meanwhile, fighting continues across northern Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 与此同时，埃塞俄比亚北部各地的战斗仍在继续。

paras.en: Federal forces and their allies appear to have made gains in southern Tigray and are advancing towards Mekelle, the regional capital. In Alamata, a doctor told the BBC earlier this week that at least 52 civilians had been killed during three days of intense fighting.
paras.zh: 联邦部队及其盟友似乎已经在提格雷南部取得了进展，并正在向该地区首府梅克勒推进。在阿拉马塔，一名医生本周早些时候告诉英国广播公司，在为期三天的激烈战斗中，至少有52名平民被杀。

paras.en: The TPLF has also been fighting in neighbouring Afar, which lies along Ethiopia's crucial transport corridor to Djibouti and the sea. Tens of thousands of people are estimated to have fled their homes there.
paras.zh: 蒂格雷人阵还在邻近的阿法尔进行战斗，阿法尔位于埃塞俄比亚通往吉布提和海洋的重要运输走廊沿线。据估计，成千上万的人逃离了家园。

paras.en: Both the Ethiopian government and the TPLF accuse the other of starting the latest hostilities. Tigrayan authorities say their forces were responding to a federal offensive and drone strikes, while Addis Ababa says Tigrayan fighters launched attacks after taking control of federally administered airports in Tigray.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚政府和蒂格雷人阵都指责对方挑起了最近的敌对行动。提格雷当局表示，他们的部队正在应对联邦进攻和无人机袭击，而亚的斯亚贝巴表示，提格雷武装分子在控制提格雷联邦政府管理的机场后发动了袭击。

paras.en: Independent verification remains difficult because journalists have limited access to the conflict areas and communications across much of Tigray have been disrupted.
paras.zh: 独立核查仍然很困难，因为记者进入冲突地区的机会有限，提格雷大部分地区的通信也受到干扰。

paras.en: The African Union has urged Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to exercise restraint and resolve their differences through diplomatic channels, warning against actions that could further destabilise the region.
paras.zh: 非洲联盟敦促埃塞俄比亚、厄立特里亚和埃及保持克制，通过外交渠道解决分歧，并警告不要采取可能进一步破坏该地区稳定的行动。

paras.en: The UN has also warned that the deteriorating security situation is severely disrupting humanitarian work in northern Ethiopia. UN spokesman StÃ©phane Dujarric said drone activity and air strikes were putting civilians, vital infrastructure and aid operations at risk, while insecurity and road closures were restricting humanitarian movements.
paras.zh: 联合国还警告说，不断恶化的安全局势严重扰乱了埃塞俄比亚北部的人道主义工作。联合国发言人Stéphane Dujarric表示，无人机活动和空袭使平民、重要基础设施和援助行动面临风险，而动荡和道路封锁则限制了人道主义行动。

paras.en: The UN has called on all sides to guarantee safe and unhindered access to people in need.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁各方确保安全无阻地接触需要帮助的人。

articles.title: Anthony Anderson to Host 2026 Soul Train Awards: ‘I’m Thrilled to Be Back’
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: Anthony Anderson is set to host the 2026 Soul Train Awards, airing Friday, Nov. 27, at 8 p.m. ET/PT on BET and CBS. This is the first Soul Train Awards since 2023 and the first ever to air on CBS. The two-hour show will tape on Thursday, Nov. 5, at Harris Theater in Chicago.

“I’m thrilled to be back with BET and especially excited to host Soul Train Awards in Chicago, where the Soul Train legacy began,” Anderson said in a statement. “Soul Train is more than a television show or an awards franchise; it’s a piece of our cultural history. Don Cornelius created a platform that gave Black artists a place to shine, and generations later, that spirit is still alive. I’m looking forward to celebrating the legends, the artists shaping R&B and soul today, and bringing a whole lot of fun to the night.”

Anderson, best known for his role on ABC’s long-running Black-ish, previously hosted the Soul Train Awards in 2013. The actor-comedian has an extensive resume as an awards show host. He hosted the NAACP Image Awards for nine consecutive years (2014-22) and the 75th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards in 2024. He cohosted the BET Awards in 2015 and 2016 with his Black-ish costar Tracee Ellis Ross.

“Anthony brings an incredible combination of comedic instinct, musical knowledge and genuine love for this culture,” said Connie Orlando, evp of specials, music programming and music strategy for BET. “His longstanding relationship with BET, coupled with his experience hosting some of television’s biggest award shows, makes him a natural fit for this new chapter of Soul Train Awards.”

“Anthony Anderson is an exceptional entertainer with a genuine connection to BET and the culture that Soul Train represents,” said Louis Carr, president of BET. “He understands the legacy, the music and the importance of creating a moment that brings people together. As we return Soul Train Awards to Chicago, the birthplace of the franchise, we’re excited to have Anthony at the center of this celebration.”

For his work on Black-ish, Anderson received seven consecutive Primetime Emmy nominations for outstanding lead actor in a comedy series (2015-21), four Primetime Emmy nominations for outstanding comedy series as an executive producer, three Golden Globe nominations and three Critics’ Choice nominations. He has won eight Image Awards and received six BET Award nominations.

articles.title: Pophouse Acquires Half Sia’s Music Catalog
articles.author: Elizabeth Dilts Marshall

paras.en: Pophouse Entertainment said on Thursday (Oct. 1) it acquired a 50% stake of Australian singer-songwriter Sia’s publishing and master music rights, according to a joint statement from the artist and Swedish entertainment company that owns rights to music by KISS, Cyndi Lauper, Iron Maiden and Tina Turner.

“I’m really excited to be working with Pophouse,” the “Elastic Heart” artist said in the statement. “These songs mean so much to me, and I love that they really understand that and want to take care of them. I’ve been making music for a very long time now, and it feels exciting to think about all the new and different ways these songs might get to live on and find people. I’m really looking forward to seeing what we can dream up together.”

Sia and Pophouse declined to disclose terms of the deal, which included her Billboard Hot 100 chart topper “Cheap Thrills,” which features Sean Paul. TMZ reported the artist will receive $165 million for rights to the songs she wrote before 2022, with an additional $15 million for songs written after 2022 that will be held in escrow, according to its story on Tuesday (Sept. 29).

Born Sia Furler, the pop star gained acclaim for her contributions to hits like Rihanna‘s “Diamonds” and Beyoncé‘s “Pretty Hurts.” The pop star’s unmistakable voice rose to international prominence following the release of her 2014 album 1000 Forms of Fear and its Top 10 hit “Chandelier.”

Pophouse acquired Sia’s catalog with its Pophouse Fund I, which it closed with $1.3 billion in 2025 and tapped to fund the acquisition of rights to songs by KISS, Cyndi Lauper, Avicii and Swedish House Mafia.

“Sia is an artist whose extraordinary catalog and unique creative identity offer exceptional opportunities to celebrate and build on her remarkable body of work,” Pophouse CEO Jessica Koravos said in the statement. “This partnership will further empower Sia with strategic support and creative resources to continue pursuing her artistic ambitions while preserving and expanding her influence.”

Sia continues to make music, releasing “Awake Tonight” in April with Afrojack and David Guetta 15 years after the trio’s hit “Titanium.” Another Sia-Guetta collaboration, “Beautiful People” topped Spotify’s Australian Music Global Impact List in February. The chart ranks the most globally streamed songs by Australian artists.

The transaction follows what the artist has publicly called the “difficult year” defined by her bitter divorce with ex-David Bernhad and custody settlement requiring her to pay $42,500 according to month in child support.

articles.title: Bruno Mars Asks Karol G to ‘Dance With Me’ in New Music Video
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Bruno Mars may have just found the perfect way to get Karol G back.

Just days after joking that he needed to “get” the Colombian superstar back from Drake, Mars has recruited Karol G for the new music video for his lovely The Romantic track “Dance With Me,” released Thursday (Oct. 1).

The video opens with Mars strumming an electric guitar all by his lonesome, pleading the lyrics into a pay phone. Karol is on the other line, sulking in bed in a lace outfit. Mars moves on from the telephone booth to where Karol resides, serenading her from below her balcony with a full band behind him. It’s a dreamy, old-fashioned serenade, with Mars singing to Karol as the instruments flourish. Karol makes her way below, jumping into Mars’ arms as fireworks explode in the sky. The duo stares into each other’s eyes as the video comes to a close, ending the night on a wholesome — and, quite literally, a romantic — note.
It’s a fitting visual for “Dance With Me,” which finds Mars leaning into the kind of swooning romance that has become a signature theme within his discography.

And Karol G’s appearance comes at a bit of a funny time in their ongoing musical friendship. On Monday (Sept. 28), Mars reacted to a viral video of Drake dancing with Karol G during the rapper’s surprise appearance at her Houston concert. Posting a photo of himself staring dramatically out of the window of a private jet, Mars jokingly wrote, “I have to get her back! I must get her back! I will get her back!”

Mars and Karol G already have some musical history together, as the pair teamed up on “Still,” an all-English-synth-pop ballad from Karol G’s sixth studio album, No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto. The collaboration reached No. 41 on the Billboard Hot 100, while the album debuted at No. 8 on the Billboard 200.
They also took “Still” to the stage together for the first time when Mars surprised fans during Karol G’s Aug. 15 concert at Los Angeles’ SoFi Stadium.

For Mars, “Dance With Me” is the closing track on The Romantic, his first solo album in nearly a decade. The album debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, while “Dance With Me” opened at No. 42 on the Billboard Hot 100.

articles.title: Talia Ryder Joins Tom Holland in Fred Astaire Biopic (Exclusive)
articles.author: Mia Galuppo

paras.en: Talia Ryder is the latest star lacing up their dance shoes for Tom Holland’s Fred Astaire biopic.

The Sony production about the legendary dancer and actor of Hollywood’s Golden Age has already tapped Margaret Qualley to play Adele Astaire, Fred’s older sister and Broadway partner, and Sabrina Carpenter as Ginger Rogers, Fred Astaire’s frequent film co-star. Ryder, a classically trained dancer, will play June Allyson, a dancer and MGM actress who was originally set to star opposite Astaire in the musical film Royal Wedding.
Paddington filmmaker Paul King is directing from a screenplay he wrote with Steven Levenson based on the book The Astaires: Fred & Adele by Kathleen Riley.

Amy Pascal and Rachel O’Connor produce for Pascal Pictures along with Ben Holden and Josh Hyams for Lightbulb Pictures and Holland for Billy17. Steven Levenson and King penned the script based on the book The Astaires: Fred & Adele by Kathleen Riley.
The film has support from some Astaire family members, including Fred’s daughter, Ava Astaire McKenzie. Her son, Tyler McKenzie, serves as a consultant and co-producer.

Ryder‘s onscreen credits include a breakout in Sundance indie Never Rarely Sometimes Always and Ethan Coen’s Honey Don’t, where she appeared opposite Qualley. As for musical cred, Ryder had a role in Steven Speilberg’s adaptation of West Side Story and began her career in Broadway‘s Matilda the Musical.
Ryder, who is repped by UTA, LBI and Vainshtein Law, will next be seen in Amazon MGM’s 4 Kids Walk Into A Bank and the second season of Amazon Prime’s Mr. & Mrs. Smith.

articles.title: Ted Sarandos Explains Why the ‘Stranger Things’ Team Left Netflix
articles.author: James Hibberd

paras.en: Netflix CEO Ted Sarandos is breaking down why he thinks his streamer lost Stranger Things creators The Duffer Bros. and the hit show’s executive producer and director Shawn Levy to rival studios.

Matt and Ross Duffer surprised the industry by announcing they were jumping ship to Paramount last August in a four-year exclusive deal that covered film and TV. They officially made the switch in April.

Then Levy, who is directing the upcoming Star Wars: Starfighter for Lucasfilm, was announced as leaving for Disney’s 20th Television after a decade spent at Netflix. His deal via his 21 Laps Entertainment production company beings next October.
The Hollywood Reporter asked Sarandos about the high-profile defections of three men who were responsible for what’s arguably the streamer’s biggest hit series.

“The Duffers have worked with us for [a] decade and did not want to make more TV shows right now,” Sarandos said. “They really want to make big tentpole theatrical movies. And I said to Matt and Ross, ‘You guys are great at what you do, and I think you should go do that. You’re 40. Don’t wake up when you’re 60 wishing you did that 20 years later.’ And I’m thrilled for them. They’re going to have great success.”

Sarandos pointed out that Netflix still owns the Stranger Things franchise, which could have still some additional content to come. “We — the Stranger Things universe — are going to continue to be a part of [that success] forever,” he added.
As for Levy, Sarandos suggested the director likewise wanted to make major theatrical films — and suggested that Levy will make more Star Wars movies after Starfighter is released next year.

“Shawn also was kind of doing the same thing. And the problem when you have an overall deal with someone who has commitments in other places, you’re in constant conflict for their time. And Shawn is going to be making Star Wars movies for a while. So the fact that his deal is with Disney makes a lot of sense. I’m thrilled for Shawn. We’re going to do a ton of things together.”
Sarandos added Netflix still has shows in development with Levy, including an upcoming hockey drama titled Sticks. “We have a lot of that stuff’s going to stick around,” he said.

The Duffer Brothers have similarly explained that movies were their reason for leaving Netflix, with Matt Duffer saying, “The biggest draw to us was just to be able to do something theatrical, which is not something Netflix does.”
Levy’s statement about his Disney deal was more vague, saying he has “always felt a kindred spirit in Disney and their storytelling ethos” and noting the studio “feels like home.”

articles.title: Bradley Cooper to Star in New G.I. Joe Movie for Paramount
articles.author: Borys Kit

paras.en: Paramount Pictures and Danny McBride are putting up their Duke.
Bradley Cooper has signed on for military duty to star in Paramount’s new and untitled G.I. Joe feature.
McBride, known primarily as an actor and for his work as creator of HBO’s The Righteous Gemstones, is directing the project. He also wrote the script, along with Jeff Fradley and John Carcieri.

Little is known about the new take on the Hasbro property, a toy line that gained its modern relevance from a relaunch that included a cartoon series and a Marvel Comics comic in the 1980s. (It was first launched in mid-1960s as a realistic soldier toy.)

It was this version that not only introduced a commando strike force featuring soldiers with monikers such as Duke, Roadblock and Snake Eyes but also its over-the-top, hi-tech adversary, the terrorist organization known as Cobra, with key bad guys including Cobra Commander, Baroness, Destro and Zartan.

Cooper will play Duke, the nominal leader of the Joes. The character was played by Channing Tatum in the live-action movies G.I. Joe: Rise of Cobra and G.I. Joe: Retaliation, released by Paramount in 2009 and 2013, respectively.

The Joe feature has been one of the big priorities at the studio, which, under new owner David Ellison, has been ramping up development of major IP and brands such as Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and Star Trek. Securing Cooper as the lead of what will be an ensemble signals that, among the IP plays, the project may be the one that gets before cameras and presumably theaters first.
Producing are Lorenzo di Bonaventura, Mark Vahradian and Zev Foreman of Hasbro Entertainment.

G.I. Joe is a rare IP play for Cooper, whose last major role was starring as Leonard Bernstein in Maestro, the ambitious biopic he also co-wrote and directed, earning four Oscar nominations in the process.

Cooper is known as the voice of Rocket in Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy movies and had a cameo in James Gunn’s Superman movie last year. He worked with McBride previously when he appeared in episode of Gemstones.
